title: Accessories

You can equip an accessory for stats, use another accessory as vanity, and hide an equipped accessory if you only want the effects. You can access your Accessory Inventory by clicking the fourth button on the top left of your screen. Rarities Common • Rare • Legendary • Godly Exotics All accessories from Accessory Crates can be Exotic . Traits See all traits here: Traits . Non-droppable accessories are marked . One known non-droppable item is Exalted Armor , which is obtained by purchasing the Soul Lord role on the official Peroxide Discord. You keep it after you stop paying. title: Adjuchas
content:
Description Adjuchas are the third Evolution Stage of the Race , Hollow . Adjuchas NPCs can spawn in Hueco Mundo . They are the post-evolution of the Hollow Evolution Stage, Menos and the pre-evolution of Vasto Lorde . Non-Player Adjuchas(s) leave behind their body when they are killed. Their bodies take a long time to eat, so if a Hollow wants to eat one, they should make sure no other NPCs are around to interrupt their meal. Obtainment Following the Hollow Starter Guide , after being alive as a Gillian for 30 minutes AND getting 30 kills (must have the killing blow to receive kill credit), the Gillian will automatically turn into an Adjuchas . Progression There are two different ways to continue from here: Following the Hollow Starter Guide , after surpassing 1700 Evolution EXP, the Adjuchas will automatically turn into a Vasto Lorde . An Adjuchas can bypass the first method by pressing G, which afterwards would give them an Arrow Mini-Game. Should an Adjuchas complete this Mini-Game, they will have their mask taken off. This turns them into the second stage of the Arrancar , the Adjucar. This method is unrecommended as you can't reverse this action, doing this will sacrifice the ability to progress any further to vastocar, which have significantly better buffs. Adjuchas Skills Hollow Skills Miscellaneous Skills These are skills used by Adjuchas. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Hollow Charge Guardbreak An enraged charge that devastates anyone who dare steps in it's path, when it hits a wall it will create a deadly shock to those nearby. Strength Acid Spit Spit acid from your mouth towards your mouse which can stun. Spirit Raging Blows Sudo Guardbreak Quickly release a barrage of punches towards where you're facing finishing it with a strong jab. Strength Flying Kick Guardbreak Charge up and flash forward knee first pulverizing anyone who would stand in your path. Strength Acidic Touch Support Coat your arms with acid causing all m1s to do an added on poison effect. No Scaling Cero Guardbreak Fire a concentrated beam of reiatsu from your mouth that deals devastating damage to anything that steps in its way. Spirit These are unique skills used by Hollows . Media Skill Name Description Scaling Garganta Allows the user to open a pathway to Hueco Mundo (Pressing M1) or Menos Forest (Pressing M2 Non Arrancar ). No Scaling Trivia Facts NPC Adjuchas have a chance to spawn with the “Ancient” title, which does not change their looks but makes them a lot tougher and stronger. “Ancient” Adjuchas also give more kills towards Vasto Lorde Progression than regular Adjuchas. Community Tips After reaching about level 90 or greater, an Adjuchas should be able to solo Storm Vastocars in Hueco Mundo , which is the fastest way to give an Adjuchas Vasto Lorde Progression. If you still fail at this, resort to fighting Adjuchas Find a friend that can help you, and farm either the gourge or the cave. NewPP limit report

title: Aizen Raid
content:
Aizen is one of the five Raid Bosses in the game. This boss scales with the player´s level and the amount of player´s fighting him. He has 3 phases he is guaranteed to drop time relics , he also has a 2% chance to drop his outfit that gives boost to your stats. Phases Phase 1: Aizen starts off normal. He uses a few abilities and goes easy on the player. That is, until you anger him. Phase 2 : Aizen decides to finally get rid of you. He enables his Shikai "Kyōka Suigetsu" and starts summoning tons of clones to help him fight the player. If all fails, he has a plan. Phase 3 : Enough games. Aizen uses the power of the Hogyoku to power himself up and attack the player with all he's got. Using unique abilities like the Final Kurohitsugi (Kurohitsugi but bigger and stronger, not obtainable for players) and a Purple Lanza del Relampago (Not obtainable for players) he deals tons of damage. It is possible to solo with  good aoe attacks or a good build. It is recommended you do it with friends but it isn’t too hard to solo. The more people you do it with the more stronger and more health the boss has. NewPP limit report

title: Amazon
content: "I am Amazon!" Description Amazon is the second legendary Fullbringer that you can roll in Peroxide. It appears on your character as a belt, and transforms into an outfit covering your character which inflicts small damage and flame damage, the colour of your character changes based on your reiatsu colour and sub-colour . In the Twin Soul form you gain 5 passives and 1 debuff. Do note that this secondary has incredibly low damage numbers, and uses fist m1s. New Amazonz Driver: Play Entrance Animation (Will also do a small amount of damage and inflict flame debuff.) Echolocation Difaction: Immunity to Shadow and most forms of screen-obscuring effects Insanity: Violent Slash will now cleanly decapitate an opponent’s head off on knock Armour Zone: Custom Grip. Grip now heals additional 10% EAT, KILL ALL: Less health = more damage plus bleed. DIE SET DOWN: All damage done to Party Members is doubled. Self damage is doubled Amazon Skills Media Skill name Description Scaling Violent Strike Extender Sudo Guardbreak Leap into the air and spin at rapid speeds before dropping down with an axe kick. Wind properties differ depending on if you have hit someone. Strength Violent Punish Sudo Guardbreak Three blows and send them flying into the air with an uppercut. Damage is 1/2 if used on opponent who has just been hit by violent slash. Strength Violent Slash Bypass Dash forward at an incredible speed and slice the neck of your opponent through block. Strength Twin Soul Skills You must be in your Twin soul to use this skill. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Violent Execute Ultimate Bypass Taunt the opponent. Will make them throw haymaker if they are are in specific stuns. Weave almost any attack thrown at you. Strength New Amazonz Driver Passive Play Entrance Animation. Spirit + Strength Echolocation Olfaction Passive Immunity to Shadow and most forms of screen-obscuring effects. No Scaling Insanity Passive Violent Slash will now cleanly decapitate on opponent's head off on knock. No Scaling Armour Zone Passive Your Grip Animation is replaced. Manual/Auto Grips now restore an additional 10% HP. No Scaling EAT. KILL ALL Passive Up to 1.025x Damage on all Violent Attacks through a linear scale of your Max HP to HP Proprotion. All Violent Attacks now apply Bleed for (0-2.25) seconds depending on a linear scale of your Max HP to HP Proprotion. Bleed ticks every 1 second dealing .5% of the opponents Max HP, capping at 5 Damage each tick. Bleed must last at least one second to have an effect; this means that YOU have to be at least under 55.555% HP for Bleed to proc. No Scaling DIE SET DOWN Passive All damage done to Party Members is doubled. Self-Damage is doubled. No Scaling Trivia It's based on Kamen Rider Amazons Alpha, a character from Japanese pop-culture. Watch out for counters if they block the first half of violent strike then they could counter when they have that gap. The gauntlets and boots of Amazon bear somewhat of a similar resemblance to Vergil's

title: Apartment
content:
Description The Apartment is a location that you can access as a Fullbringer when talking to your best friend Shūkurō Tsukishima in the XCution Headquarters . The room is mainly for Fullbringers to rebind skills and to begin their Twin Soul Fullbring obtainment. Features In the Apartment, you can find your Apartment Computer, which has 2 options: Can you modify my skill? (Skill Bind) Execute command "Beckon" Your Apartment Computer will only have the command "Beckon" when you reach level 90, but you can only use that command when you have a total of 420 progression points. For more information on progression points, check out the Fullbringer Progression/Starter Guide . When you use the command "Beckon" successfully, you will be teleported to your Reality Shift Apartment, where the room appears deserted and the Apartment Computer is the only thing left. If you interect with it, it will reply saying that you are not their master. You will not be able to return to your original apartment after using this command. You will be able to walk out of the doors that once appeared closed and walk down a decorated hotel hallway where at the end you will find the Reality Shift Apartment Room , where a shadowing figure waits for you. Talking to the NPC will allow you to fight your Twin Soul Fullbring Boss. For more information on progression points, check out the Fullbringer Progression/Starter Guide . The Apartment will change its appearance after beating your Fullbring Boss, becoming the Reality Shift Apartment Room from then on. You will not be able to reverse this change. Also you can use the apartment as a sort of bank as, dropping yen in your apartment won't disappear if u die or leave the apartment. But if u leave the server or rejoin the yen will disappear. title: Apocalypse
content:
" Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he rode out as a conqueror bent on conquest. " " Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make men slay each other. To him was given a large sword. " " Its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand. " "I ts rider was named Death, and Hades was following close behind him. They were given power over a fourth of the earth to kill by sword, famine, and plague, and by the wild beasts of the earth. " Description Apocalypse is one of the Rare Schrift that Quincy can roll in Peroxide. Apocalypse Vollständing passive is once you are in Vollständing all moves will auto execute players, Your dash summons dark hands that attack nearby opponents. Your M2 also gives the opponent a bell with a skull this is a death toll after 20 seconds the bell will ring and when the opponent gets hits during this time they get stunned. Schrift Skills You must be in your Schrift to use these skills. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Famine Guardbreak Jump backwards and fire a poisonous arrow leaving behind a thick fog of venom for a duration of time. (The poison cloud is spirit) Spirit + Strength Conquest True Stun Dash forward in an attempt to grasp your enemy, upon success you will drag their face across the ground and then slam them down at the end. Strength War Extender Sudo Guardbreak Aggressively stomp the ground sending a wave of shockwaves through the earth with enough force to stagger your enemies. Strength Vollstandig Skills/Passives You must be in your Vollständing to use this skill. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Death Ultimate Bypass Summon a black scythe made of pure despair and slice forth. If the enemy hit is below 20% HP, the attack will automatically execute them. After 20 seconds, Death's Toll will ring a bell, allow for a brief moment where if the opponent receives any source of damage by you, they will explode Strength Death's Toll 2 Passive Dashing summons multiple hands that launch to a nearby target. title: Arrancar
content: Description The Arrancar types vary in power depending on when they remove their mask, with Menoscar being the weakest and Vastocar being the strongest. When you turn into an Arrancar, you will gain a Ressurección , later on you can unlock your Resurrección Weapon and Segunda Etapa . Check out the Hollow Starter Guide to learn how to progress as a Hollow to become an Arrancar. Menoscar Obtainment Obtained by pulling your mask off as a Menos by pressing G (pc) LSB (Xbox) and doing the arrow mini game. Buffs +13 HP bonus +20% EXP buff A sharp, cone-shaped nose which is said to posses a strong Hierro, according to the game's splash texts Buffs are much worse than Adjuchar or Vastocar. Debuff You will be bullied. Adjucar You can also get the skill highspeed regen if you put stats into spirit Obtainment Obtained by pulling your mask off as an Adjuchas by pressing G (pc) LSB (Xbox) and doing the arrow mini game. Buffs 1.05x stat multiplier +40% EXP buff +25 HP bonus +5 more levels to their Max Potential (196) Tip: It is advised to stop at Adjuchar if you plan to go Quincycar, as the only buffs you will keep are the HP bonuses and extra levels, and is not worth the hassle. However, a Vastocar Quincy is technically the strongest type of Quincy, due to the fact which levels slightly boost stats and Vastocars have 10 extra levels. Vastocar Obtainment Obtained by pulling your mask off as a Vasto Lorde by pressing G (pc) LSB (Xbox) and doing the arrow mini game. Advice : It is recommended to obtain the Vasto Lorde exclusive skills ( Cero Oscuras ) before taking off your mask because you will keep them after becoming a Vastocar (upgrades on skills are also saved when taking off your mask & this will not prevent you from getting those skills after resetting your skills) . Buffs 1.13x stat multiplier +60% EXP boost +50 HP bonus +10 more levels to their Max Potential (201) Access to the Vasto Lorde exclusive skills: Cero Oscuras and High-Speed Regeneration (previous arrancars may still access High-Speed-Regeneration). Can obtain arankuda (Gain access to the Arrancar Hakuda skill set by winning Orochi in a fight) Arrow Minigame Tips If you are on mobile and find the arrow game challenging, Use the joystick to input directions—unlike on PC, mistakes don’t seem to be counted. By rotating the thumbstick in continuous circles, you can progress effortlessly. title: Arrancar Dojo Vendor
content:
The Arrancar Dojo Vendor is an NPC located on the left side of The Alley in Hueco Mundo along with the Arrancer dueler Ken . The Arrancer Dojo Vendor offers a Dojo Membership for her Dojo for the price of ¥250. The Dojo does not allow weapons to be drawn inside the Dojo. If the player tries to draw their weapon inside the Dojo, they will kicked out and told to not draw their weapon out. The Dojo is an advanced Dojo that can give you 5 stat stars for a singular trained stat, and each stat star gives you an extra 33% stat exp when gaining stat experience through quests and dueling. The Arrancer Dojo Vendor's counterparts in each map are as follows: The Gym Bouncer in Karakura Town , The Soul Society Dojo Vendor in Soul Society , and the Quincy Dojo Vendor in Wandenreich . Note: The Gym Bouncer only provides access to the Dojo in Katakura town, which only provides a max of 3 stat stars for a chosen stat. Advanced Gyms are ones that are located in other maps than Katakura, and all provide a maximum of 5 stat stars for a chosen stat. Advanced Dojos are more expensive but more rewarding at the same time, but a cheaper but harder option with a chance of failure is fighting Duelers in the different maps. They provide star bonuses and a stat buff. NewPP limit report

title: Hakuda
content: Description Hakuda is a fighting style ( Soul Reaper and Arrancar Exclusive) with 9 close range moves, and can be learnt by completing "Lesson of Strength" and defeating Yoruichi (Who can be found at Urahara Shop). Yoruichi's stats scale off yours, so stat reset max strength or low stats can help make the fight more possible. There are currently 9 abilities in the game right now, and three lessons. Each training gives three skills , first being the basic "Lesson of Strength", second being the "Lesson of Agility"  and third being  the "Lesson of Vitality". You need a certain amount of stats to do each respective lesson. Shunko is also confirmed to be added soon. While Vasto Lordes and Quincycars could obtain Hakuda, it has since been removed from them. Note: Vasto Lorde are able to obtain Arrankuda Hakuda Skills Media Skill name Description Scaling Fleeting Whirlwind Extender Ground version: Create a tornado by spinning around. If successfully hitting anyone, jump into the air and Reset CD. Air Version: Dash quickly in the air, upon making contact with another, kick them up into the sky and slam them back into the earth. Strength Jolting Kick Guard break Slide in with a drop kick promptly following up with an upward kick on any target who is hit by the initial attack. Strength Double Roundabout Guard break Rise up with two sweeping kicks, then follow up with a falling kick slamming anyone nearby in the air back onto the ground. Strength Outspeed Sudo Extender Charge in with an onslaught of afterimages pinning anyone you ram into and then launching them after abruptly halting your advance. Strength Dispersing Barrage Extender Appear in front of someone kicking them, on contact, disappear and hit the target multiple times and re-appear in the air preceding with a swift stomp. Strength Aerial Assault Uppercut towards the sky bringing up a target with you, then proceed to perform a barrage of kicks bringing them back towards the earth. (UNLISTED) : Can extend if you land close to them Strength Showstopper Bypass Take hold of your opponent into a tight squeeze draining reiatsu based off vitality stat (UNLISTED): Is minus on hit Vitality + Strength Headstrong Bypass Grab your opponent and deliver a devastating cranium blow that obscures your opponent's vision for a period of time. Strength Earth Crouching Dragon Hyperarmor Guardbreak Lower your center of mass to throw a powerful uppercut launching your target up; grants Hard Armour and is usable in M1 stuns as a pseudo evasive. Strength Arrancar Hakuda Arrancar Hakuda is a fighting style exclusive to Vastocar Arrancar 's. This fighting style can be obtained by defeating the Orochi boss and unlike Yoruichi after beating him once you will gain all 9 moves of arrancar hakuda. Note: You do not need to have obtained all of Yoruichi's Hakuda moves before you can fight Orochi. The only requirements to fight orochi is to be out of combat and be a vastocar or vasto lorde. title: Aura Michibane
content:
Description Aura Michibane is a NPC that spawns in the Graveyard in Karakura Town at night time as well as behind the counter in the XCution Headquarters . Fullbringers will be told by Shūkurō Tsukishima after they turn level 15 to seek her out. If the player interacts with Shūkurō Tsukishima again, he will give clues to her location and spawn time. Features Once the player finds Aura Michibane at the Graveyard and talks to her as a level 15 Fullbringer , she gives the player some dialogue and then hands over a Cellphone , which is used to get in and out of the XCution Headquarters . The player will be able to find her as well behind the counter, and when interacted, will give the player 2 options: Allow me to prove myself! (Begin Mission) Can you open a portal? If the player selects the first option, they will be given a random task. The player must do 3 of these tasks to be able to fight Agent Harlock and obtain their Fullbring . For more information, check out the Fullbringer Progression/Starter Guide . If the player selects the second option, they will be given the option to open either a Senkaimon or a Garganta, or sometimes both, for free, if the player has equal Reputation for Soul Society and Hueco Mundo . You may change your skills by going to bestfriend and saying [ENTER APARTMENT] then go to the computer. Notes Aura Michibane can also tell the player if they are over level 90 and accumulated 420 points that they can fight their Twin Souls Boss. NewPP limit report

title: Bankai
content: Bankai is an end-game mode for Soul Reapers and is the second mode available to them. How to get Bankai To unlock your Bankai form, you must once again defeat your Inner Spirit, you must once again defeat your Inner Spirit — a more difficult task than before. Here are the requirements for engaging in this battle and attaining Bankai: 1. Attain Level 85. 2. Accumulate 420 “Points”. - Obtain points through different means: Time Gates: You receive 75 points if your team wins and 25 points if your team loses. Time Bubbles (Bosses): You get 1 point for each percentage of the boss's health you damage. Storm Vastocars: Defeating a Storm Vastocar gives 10 points if you contribute the majority of the damage (at least 60%) Invasions: 5 points for "Steal an Object of Interest" 12 points for "Killing Spree" 22 points for "Slay a Leader" Once you meet all prerequisites, press ‘N’ to meditate and converse with your Inner Spirit. Afterward, you'll battle your Bankai Boss , and must win to obtain your Bankai. NOTE: Your Bankai Boss copies your stats. A glass cannon will fight a glass cannon, a tank will fight a tank, etc. Bankai Outfits Congratulations! You've now unlocked Bankai! You'll also be wearing one of the Bankai outfits. ( P.S. There are more outfits available now than shown here, as this page is a bit outdated. ) Bankai Outfit Bankai Outfit 2 Peroxide Bankai Guide: How To Activate Bankai? After equipping your Shikai , press ‘ G ’ once the gauge on the left side is entirely filled. Bankai mode has a time limit starting at 33 seconds, which can be extended to 190 seconds through training to max your Bankai. This includes: Frequent usage of Bankai Sparring with your Bankai spirit in your Inner World After defeating the Bankai Boss, you’ll immediately unlock Bankai Moves , which can also be upgraded through usage and sparring. Bankai Benefits When in Bankai, your base stats receive major buffs: Strength : +20% (1.2x) Spirit : +30% (1.3x) Vitality : +25% (1.25x) BAN-KAI!! Bankai Boss Phase 1: Your sword is temporarily taken, and a bunch of swords fall from the sky. You must identify the real one by breaking seven decoy swords first. Tip: Use a vitality-heavy build for this phase—it takes time. If you're S- Rank or higher, a checkpoint activates after Phase 1. Phase 2: Now you must fight your Inner Spirit at full power, including its own Bankai . Expect a tough fight. Unless you max Strength and rush it — then it becomes a “who hits first wins” battle. Using Wind is also recommended. Bankai Mastery To maximize your Bankai duration, you need to defeat your Bankai boss 13 times. To fight the boss and increase your mastery, meditate by pressing ‘ N ’ (you should know this by now smh), then talk to your Inner Spirit and select ‘ I wish to spar ’ and ‘ I wish to hone my skill (XP & Mastery) ’. You’ll know you have mastered your Bankai when the outline of your mastery bar turns purple. This might take some time. For an easier fight, you can set your stats to 0 Vit

title: Battle Tower
content:
You get Ranked PVP rewards from the Battle Tower . Description The Battle Tower is similar to a Battle Pass but it's completely free. It has 50 Tiers that you can buy for 20 Battle Tower Points each that have 3 Cards each. The cards work similar to Invasion Loot Chest cards being revealed by clicking them but to claim them you have to spend even more Battle Tower Points. If you don't like what you got you can reroll all unclaimed cards in a Tier with 1 Shuffle Points or 100 Battle Tower Points per card. Every 10 Tiers you are rewarded with an emote and on the last Tier you get an accessory without spending additional Battle Tower Points. Rewards There are two types of rewards, randomized and set rewards. Randomized Every Tier you get 3 cards. They can be Common , Rare , Legendary or Godly . Rarity is based on the current tier you are on. With higher tiers having higher chances for Godlies. title: Book of bringers
content:
The book of bringers is a lore book which is 4 chapters long and is meant to be a research book about fullbringers . Chapter 1 is about humans with powers but with extremely limited potential. Chapter 2 is about finding ancient readings talking about Fullbringers. Chapter 3 is about encountering someone using Clock and talks about their ability to slightly manipulate the environment. Chapter 4 talks about human souls and how they interact with hollow souls. On the counter for ASR's Cafe . I've been doing some research on humans with abnormal abilities, they seem to get this strength through raw determination and will to get stronger, however their potential is extremely limited... Maybe there is a way to surpass this limitation? I found ancient readings in the regards to those who are called 'Fullbringers', humans who were attacked by hollows during birth, they grew to inherit powerful abilities to draw out the souls of objects and transforming them... How interesting. I managed to find a human with the ability of Fullbring, though it was through a dangerous confrontation from a distant side of Karakura, I saw him turn his watch into a lethal object when he felt my presence. it is odd though, when we fought, it seemed he could really only do this to his watch, he can alter the environment ever so slightly however not to the level that he is able to with his watch, I tried to question him but he escaped, how unfortunate, however I now know they may exist in our current generation. Based of my findings from that encounter, I studied more on the connection between human souls and hollow souls, it seems that when a human encounters a one on one confrontation with a hollow, their soul starts to grow, just enough to allow the individual to manipulate objects with his soul, however the occurrence is so rare that it has yet to be seen by Shinigami's, Quincies, or Arrancars, that is why there is no information on them. title: Book of Power
content:
The Book of Power is a lore book which is 3 chapters long. It seems to talk about a Gotei 13 captain's time as a captain and their findings. it also mentions reiatsu crystals, and vizard Chapter 1 is just a disclaimer saying that its not meant for people with the goal of power. Chapter 2 talks about things that happen behind the scenes of the Gotei 13 and possibly mentions Reiatsu Crystals OR Ultimate Crystals as "cursed gems of power" Chapter 3 talks about the writer seeing multiple shinigamis in the soul society's forest, referring to them as "masked ones" (possibly Vizards ) To the left of the soul society entrance. An introduction, I want to give you a quick disclaimer this book is not meant for those with the goal of power, but those lost in the journey for it, I have noted my findings in my short time as a Gotei 13 Captain. Things that happen behind the scenes are disturbing to say the least, though we have been told to let higher ups know whenever we find a rare artifact from the time abnormalities, many shinigami tend to keep it to themselves, especially those cursed gems of power. I caught sighting of multiple shinigami within the forest, it was disturbing to say the least, they were masked ones…. But they had no spec of sanity, I could hear them talking about killing those of raw instinct and power, that was the last I saw of them, as they opened a senkaimon and left. NewPP limit report

title: Book of Sins
content:
The book of sins is a lore book which is 6 chapters long. The book mentions Sousuke Aizen It also talks about the Impure Hogyoku and it's effects towards a Vizard . After speaking to an odd fellow about the abnormalities in time; the so called “Time Bubbles”, I realized something far past what the man was chasing. For while he hunted this Temporal Reishi that seemed to spill out onto our world, I realized that if these were truly fragments of a world before ours, then greater treasures could be contained within. Hueco Mundo is covered in ruins of the old Las Noches, and though its original occupants have long since fled. I have reason to believe the new inhabitants may originate from a Time Bubble themselves, so far they have remained largely dormant… But I don’t believe that will last. Thus I have begun researching this legendary figure they call “Sousuke Aizen” and believe that his greatest creation, the Hogyoku, may too have persisted to this world.. It seems that his creation however has been corrupted through the twisting of time… As the Impure Hogyoku has been sighted within these abnormalities in time. It’s been dozens of nights since my last entry, I’ve delved into hundreds of these Time Bubbles.. And finally, I found what I was looking for. An Impure Hogyoku, it reacted oddly with one of those.. Masked Shinigami, however the ones around him did not feel a thing?  Could it be that the Hogyoku only chooses those fated for it, that it can see the very threads of destiny? Nine nights have passed since I last slept, looking into the Unique masked shinigami and his reaction to the Impure Hogyoku, it seems to me that certain people are just born… More worthy than others, no.. More.. Cursed.. Like the world has a job for them, and they aren’t allowed to escape their duty… I found him, that special shinigami, I defeated him.. And took him, the hogyoku just merged within him, the last thing i saw was a hole emerge in his chest inside of my lab, everything, it was destroyed. I have lost everything… EVERYTHING…. AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHHAHAHAH!!! HEARTBEATS…. HEARTBEATS… ALL BLAND HAHAHAHAHAH ALL BLAND… ONLY THAT ONE… THAT ONE WAS NOT BLAND. IT WAS SO BEAUTIFUL… I WANT TO HEAR IT ONCE MORE…. BUT NOT EVEN THE STRONG HAVE IT? IS IT SOMETHING OF FATE TO AQUIRE? NewPP limit report

title: Buarbiette The Bullet
content:
Buarbiette is a NPC that is located near the Quincy Dojo Vendor . Soul Reapers, Arrancars and Quincy players can fight Buarbiette for the cost of 100 yen and if they are over level 50. If you are below level 50, she will tell you to get stronger. If you win, she will upgrade one of your stats. You can previously choose what stat do you want to upgrade before getting into the actual fight. The Buarbiette NPC has a 30 minute timer everytime you defeat her. She gives 5 stat stars max, each star make +33% experience in the stats you chose beforehand, which is better than Kisuke . However, Buarbiette, unlike other Duelers such as Ken and Laqura , does not use Vollständig. Her counterparts in each map are as follows: Kisuke in Karakura , Laqura in Soul Society , and Ken in The Alley in Heuco Mundo . Note: Kisuke only provides 3 stat stars while other duelers provide 5 stat stars due to how hard they are compared to Kisuke . You can also only fight 1 dueler every 30 minutes, and this is effected for every map worldwide for the player. This means that if you beat Kisuke and try to fight Buarbiette, you will be told you are too tired and that you will need to come back after a set amount of time. NewPP limit report

title: Byakuya Raid
content:
Byakuya Kuchiki is one of the five Raid Bosses in the game. He scales with your level and also scales with the amount of members joining a raid. He has 3 phases. (This raid boss can only be spawned with a Time Splitter while being in Soul Society bought from the Dr. Hydrogen NPC ) Drops time relics - 100% Hado 33 Soukatsui Knowledge - 25% Flower Kenseikan (Rare) Stats: 10 Vitality, 20 Spirit (Hat) - 15% Flower Kenseikan (TYBW) (Rare) Stats: 25 Spirit, 0.1x Reiatsu Regen (Hat) - 10% Sky Cloak(Legendary) Stats: 40 agility, +0.1x heal regen, +0.1x reiatsu regen | +0.15x pve damage (Collar) - 10% Flower Cloak (Legendary) Stats: 20 Vitality, 30 Spirit, 0.2x Reiatsu Regen. (Collar) - 5% These chances can be doubled if the time bubble is distorted or you have a fortune field generator active. Phases Phase 1: he start the fight with his Zanpakuto and fights with Kido skills. Phase 2: he activates his Shikai and uses Flower Shikai and Kido skills. Phase 3: he activates bankai and starts to use spirit pressure, use flower Bankai skills and Kido skills. NewPP limit report

title: Chaos
content:
" I look down on existence from a much higher perspective than you do. I witness this world, this universe, and the truth of all things. That yields deeper understanding. Wisdom. The realization that all mortals should be destroyed. The one and only mistake among all divine creations. That is what mortals are, and this mistake is egregious. To shape existence into the beautiful utopia it was always meant to be, the mistake must be corrected. I will purge all mortals from existence... in place of the gods WHO REFUSE TO ADMIT FAILURE!!! " Description Chaos is one of the Legendary Resurrecciónes that Arrancar can roll. Players receive a passive buff in Segunda Etapa called Fissure that makes their M1s add 12.5% of their Spirit stat as scaling, steal 3%-4.5% of the opponents Reiatsu and steal their Mode Charge 1%-1.5% when hitting them with M1s. This resurrecion can be used with either a Spirit Or Strength build, as Chaos Energy and Sickle of Destruction benefit both strength and spirit builds, and the Segunda passives and Cero Eviscerate can be utilized on either build. This element scales with reiatsu color if you are wearing Yhwach's Divine Outfit . Chaos Skills Resurrección Skills You must be in your Resurrección to use these skills. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Sickle of Destruction Extender Summon a scythe of pure destruction and swing forth. When it makes contact with an enemy, it will create a pillar of chaos and you will devastate those who you hit into the air. Sickle of Destruction now no longer DuoScales and instead does an extra 50% strength scaling damage. Spirit + Strength Chaos Energy Support Focus chaotic energy into your body and then output it, increasing your health and damage. The damage boost is global, if Prodigy is used, gain more uptime. From testing it seems to be a 7% damage increase. Mastery Chaos Blaster Guardbreak Sudo Extender Form a small ball of chaotic energy into your palm and fire it off, once it makes contact with an object it's energy will pull nearby targets in and then explode. Spirit Segunda Skills / Passives You must be in your Segunda to use these skills. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Chaos Flash Ultimate Bypass True Stun Unleash the inner chaos in your own nature. Emit a beam of utter chaos in front of you demolishing everyone and everything. IN PVP, The damage scales based off distance to the beam's centre (also cannot damage people you have not hit yet, npcs are NOT exempt from this). This ability automatically executes enemies under 1% HP, completely erasing them. Spirit Cero Eviscerate True Stun Grab your opponent and blast a cero directly into them. Press E or G to use Spirit + Strength Your Chaos Abilities(The Purple part) can now scale off your Reiatsu color with Yhwach's Divine Outfit's Soul King Essence trait. NewPP limit report

title: Charged Time Splitter
content:
The Charged Time Splitter is an Item purchasable from Dr. Hydrogen from his pocket realm for 5,500 , as well as a reward from the Weekly Quests . This Item is a more powerful counterpart to the Time Splitter and can be used to summon Distorted Raid Bosses , which are significantly stronger than normal raids and have higher drop rates than their regular counterparts. It can summon the following raids: Aizen Raid , Ulquiorra Raid , Starrk Raid , Nnoitra raid , Byakuya Raid and Yamamoto Raid , depending on the current world. For more information on raids, see Time Bubbles . Beating the Distorted Raids guarantees you 19 Time Relics . In inventory When holding NewPP limit report

title: Clock
content:
" It’s Dead O’clock Somewhere " Description Clock is one of the rare Fullbring Elements that you can roll as a Fullbringer in Peroxide. It is shown as a watch on the left hand of your character, and upon manifest it turns into a revolver. In it´s twin soul your revolver becomes a duel revolver you also gain a custom M2 counter, Custom Sheath attack, a custom perfect block, and one passive The Three Chronicles: Activating a chronicle´s passive will decrease the cooldown off their respective skill by five seconds if the skill is equipped and is on cooldown. Clock skills Fullbringer Skills Media Skill Name Description Scaling Foreboding Future Sudo Guardbreak Jump upwards and aim down firing a clone of yourself that ruptures the ground and then spins sending those who were hit flying up. Strength Interloping Present Extender Fire a time splitting bullet at an opponent, on hit a clone of you will come from above and slam them on the ground staggering them. Strength Tragic Past Guardbreak Summon a clone of yourself that dashes forward and slams anyone it touches onto the ground. Strength Twin Soul Skills You must be in your Twin Soul to use this skill . Media Skill Name Description Scaling The Chronology Ultimate Bypass Utilize the power of the Three Chronicles to its fullest potential, creating a rift in the timeline giving you permission to edit said timeline and perform a though-out attack. (M1 during the ultimate to spawn in clones) Domain Expansion Strength + Spirit Chronicle of the Tragic Past On sheath (if not stunned), teleport to the last spot you began a flashstep if within 500 studs of range and leave behind a chronicle who screams and inflicting everyone nearby with fear . Press E to use Strength Chronicle of the Interloping Present Perfect Block Upon perfect blocking an opponent, summon a chronicle that unleashes a series of slashes upon them ending with a finisher. Strength Chronicle of the Foreboding Future M2 Counter Counter your opponent tagging them with a trace of the foreboding future, causing a chronicle to spawn in and slam down 3 seconds later. title: Clone
content:
" From the very start, no one has stood upon the heavens. Not you, not I, nor even gods. However, that intolerable vacuum has come to an end. Henceforth... I shall stand upon the heavens. " Description Clone is one of the Rare Shikai elements that Soul Reapers can obtain in the game. In its Bankai state, Clone bankai bestows a passive ability upon the user, allowing for the creation of 4 false clones instead of the usual 2. Clone Skills Shikai Skills You must be in your Shikai to use these skills. Media Skill Name Description Scaling False Clones Reach into our reflection, and let the world see us. Bringing forth two of our reflections to fight. The lifespan of your Clones scale off of your Spirit stat. 0/10/20/30 Spirit = ~12/~14/~16/~18 seconds 70 Spirit = ~26 seconds (cooldown of max mastery 'False Clones') Spirit Mirror Inverse Evasive Punch a hole through our mirror world and instantaneously swap places with one of our reflections. This move has higher range if you have mastery on it. Note: Can be used on party members. No Scaling Emulate Clones Reach through the mirror world inside and take control of our reflections, causing them to repeat our last attack (Depending on your stats, Your Clones will also follow whatever your move scales off
Ex: Hado 90 Kurohitsugi - Spirit - Clones will also follow Spirit Getsuga Tenshou - Strength/Spirit - Clones will Also Follow Strength/Spirit)) No Scaling Bankai Skills You must be in your Bankai to use this skill. title: Game Mechanics
content: Page Navigation ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Basics Make sure to read everything in the tutorial as it helps you put these mechanics to practice. There is a Game Manual that you can read by clicking the 6th button on the top left, which will to help you understand many of the Game's Mechanics when you're new. ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Player GUI Shows your Money Shows your Health Shows the cooldowns of your: Push Counter (left) Uppercut (middle) Dash (right) Shows your Level Shows your Reiatsu ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Controls E or Right D-Pad - Draw Weapon Left Mouse or X - Light Attack R , Right Mouse(When in shiftlock) or B - Heavy Attack F or LT - Guard Guard + Right Mouse or Guard + B - Parry (When you get hit) Q or Y - Dash (Under 10 Agility or when out of Reiatsu ) Q or RB - Flashstep (Dash turns into Flashstep when you get 10 Agility) Flashstep + Heavy Attack - Uppercut V or Up D-Pad - Carry (you cannot normally dash/flash step while carrying, until you have at least 150+ agility at S rank) B or Down D-Pad - Grip/Execute N or Left D-Pad - Spirit Realm or Skill Bind Menu G or LS - Transform - This is different for every race, but transforming allows you to use transformation skills (e.g. Shikai, Schrift) = - Drop Item: The item will appear on the ground as a black sphere with the name above it. (You have to hold out the item you want to drop) ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Miscellaneous Guard Break Hitting an enemy that is blocking with Guard Break Attacks will break their guard, leaving them stunned and open to combos. Light Attack Chain Consists of 4 to 6 Light Attacks (depends on Weapon Type) , the last Light Attack used to guard break, but as of an update, m1/light attacks will no longer block break. Flashstep Chain Hold the dash button to perform multiple flashsteps in a row (Amount of Flashsteps depends on Agility Stat and Bonus Flashstep Trait ) . Flashstep when Carrying You can only flashstep while carrying an object or body with a maxed out Agility stat. Knocked Health State between being dead and alive when reaching 0 Health, you get ragdolled and you can be carried and gripped (executed) . You get up again                              after ~15 seconds have passed. Health Pack Get a certain amount of health when an enemy gets knocked, if you contributed damage. (increased depending on time of enemy being alive or amount of hits, remains untested for now) ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Advanced (Early WIP) ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Combat Move stacking Most skills can be started while winding up M1s, or light attacks. Utilizing this frequently and effectively can help you string together stronger combos that are harder to escape. Combos / False Stun While there is not many moves that true stun (Aside from most of Glacier 's moves, and the hakuda move aerial assault, along with many others.) due to all races having access to evasive skills, "false" stun is still an important mechanic in developing combos. title: Crystals
content: Sought-after gems that boost the strength of a user's capabilities. Description Crystals are Items that can be use on Skills (excluding unbindable skills) , granting them unique effects but gives a drawback of +50% reiatsu cost. Only one can be used per Skill. Crystals can be replaced by using a new crystal on the same skill, voiding the previous crystal. If you use a crystal on an element skill and reroll your element, your crystals on all element skills will be instantly refunded. Ultimate Crystals are Special Crystals that can be applied to Ultimate skills, but they bear a major drawback. Obtainment You can buy a random Crystal for 50 ¥ and 10 Time Relic from the Shady Shingami located in the café at ASRs Cafe . Crystals Common (80%) Rare (18%) Legendary (2%) These are Common Crystals . Crystal Description Showcase Crystal of Wind Adds a brief wind dash and perfect dodge frames before the move Crystal of Shadow Makes your opponent deal 5% less damage and darkens their screen with every hit by a little Crystal of Spirit Halves the Reiatsu cost, and lets you instantly start regening Reiatsu after the skill is used. Crystal of Inferno Adds burn effect for a short duration Crystal of Artificiality Does 20% more damage towards NPCs - Crystal of Force Adds more knockback These are Rare Crystals . Crystal Description Showcase Crystal of Ichor Grants life-steal (heal ~33% of the damage you deal) Crystal of Exponentiality Expands the timeframe between the hit and taking damage, multiplying all damage when marked by 1.3x Crystal of Aegis Grants hyper-armour after a short start up, protecting you from one hit and self-damaging moves for one hit. There is an ~5 second cooldown after use in which the crystal's effects cannot be activated by any skills. (Except from counters and guard breaks) Crystal of Clutch Pulls nearby opponents towards you Crystal of Prodigy Enhances the mastery of the skill (can change behavior of skill) - Crystal of Degression Marks opponents, removing their crystals effects and lessens their damage dealt Crystal of Chains Damages opponents around the hit player, dealing less damage than to the original target Crystal of Creep Steals opponent's Reiatsu and halves the target's passive Reiatsu regeneration for 1.5sec. Crystal of Reap Prevents opponents from healing (except health-packs from killing and HOS) Crystal of Glass Makes block breaks do as much damage as they would usually do when opponent isn't blocking - These are Legendary Crystals . Crystal Description Showcase Crystal of Terra Builds a wall behind the opponent, allowing them to be pushed into it and receive extra damage. [Your opponent can pushblock off this, which was a nerf added a while back] Crystal of Despair Prevents opponents from using any extender Skills Crystal of Null Increases damage by 33%, (at the downside of everything afterwards doing ~90% less damage.) Crystal of Conduction Adds a lightning strike following a down slam, dealing extra damage Trivia Crystal

title: Body Modifications
content:
Quincy have the ability to modify their body with various cybernetics. Description Body modifications allow Quincy and Quincycar to get 2 new Skills . All modifications have 1 Combat Skill and a Utility Skill that doesn't take up a Skill Binding Slot . In order to modify your body you need a Special Part. There are currently 4 parts and all are legendary items that can be obtained from Invasions and Time Gates . You can only have one modification at once. title: Storm Delve
content: Storm Delve is a special game mode that requires you to be within 25 levels of your maximum level and is mainly used to obtain perk stones and Product Essences . Storm Delve is a timed PVP/PVE mode where players fight through waves of enemies to collect loot. Players can queue solo, in duos, or in trios (duos/trios require a party). Queueing costs 500 . Players can kill eachother for loot Total of 12 players are required to start, and players are teleported to the map after the queue fills. Storm Delve can be accessed by talking to Erelander Lathrix at multiple locations: NPC near the sakura tree in Karakura Colosseum in Hueco Mundo (near clothing store in Wandenreich ) Segunda location in Menos Forest House near the entrance of Soul Society Tree at the side of the Trade Hub Enemy Notes Adjuchas Regular mobs, drop basic loot. (You can usually obtain Common Perk Stones and Time Relics ) Vasto Lordes Strong mobs guarding areas with chests. Ancient Vasto Lordes Unlike normal Vasto Lordes they negate Hollow Friend and do a ton of damage, be careful. Storm Arrancar Mid-tier enemies (Gives Time Relics , Sunglasses and Rare Perk Stones ) Storm Espadas Elite mobs, drop high-tier loot Possible drops, Time Relics , Godly/Legendary/Rare/(Common?) Perk Stones , Pure Hogyoku , (legendary skills?)) Arrancar bases marked on mini map by purple dots Clearing a base spawns a Storm Power (interact with E) Storm Powers grant buffs: Blessed, Cursed, Trackstar, Marauder, Pilgrim, Corrupt, Conduit, Omniscient. You can consume multiple Storm Powers but only gain their corruption points instead of powers. Every 25 levels of corruption you now gain a Divine perk. (Either a completely unique perk or a super buffed version of an existing perk) Every 5 corruption levels you gain 2 perks rather than 1. List of Storm Powers Storm Power Effect Blessed Revives on death but you lose carried loot along with respawning you in a random location Cursed Prevents other players' Blessed from activating Trackstar Increases Flash Step speed and halves its reiatsu cost Marauder Health packs fully heal Pilgrim Doubles damage against Arrancars Corrupt Grants double corruption points Omniscient Grants the ability to see the chats of all players in delves and also allows you to see better/further. Conduit Gripping the hero of the storm (Arrancar boss) with Conduit power steals all kill credit from the lobby and gives you the supercharged effect (Like V - The Vanguard) This power will also give you immunity to the delve collapse (boss grip isn't needed) and all the open chests within the delve will fill back up when the delve collapses. Rare: 2 PE + basic items Legendary: 5 PE + better items Godly: 20 PE + top-tier items Golden chests are very rare and spawn an additional chest at extraction. Every corruption level increases the user spirit and strength stat by 5%, and also gives a random perk that stays until death or delve collapse. Corruption can be obtained in various ways, including: Corru

title: Enemies
content:
This page is currently being worked on. Some things may be incomplete. Enemies in peroxide are any entities that attack the player. this may include hollows , arrancars , quincies , and soul reapers. They spawn with random skills, and the arrancars and soul reapers can be divided into 3 tiers: Single-point: these enemies only use basic race abilities , and do not have modes. single-point enemies generally do not have accessories ,and are usually invasion enemies ,such as storm guards. these enemies grant 1 point towards D rank invasion's enemy killing objective. Double-point: these enemies, alongside using basic race abilities , also use one of the race's respective primary modes , as well as all of the skills said mode might have. these enemies have random accessories picked from a pool of accessories. these include incursion enemies for quincies and soul reapers, rogue shinigami, and certain storm guards , as well as all quincies in wandenreich (none of the incursion / wandenreich quincies seem to have random accessories from what i've observed). so named because in an invasion , they grant 2 points towards D rank invasion's enemy killing objective. Espada / captain : these enemies wield not only a primary mode , but a secondary mode as well. they are only encountered as mission objectives for B and S rank invasions , and seem to always have specific accessories that they wear. Enemies also follow specific behavior patterns depending on where they are found. For example; enemies found in incursions generally follow the "basic ai", where coming into a certain radius of them causes them to attack. Guard enemies, such as storm guards, only attack if provoked from an attack or if they see you holding a stolen object. Both of these prohibit multiple enemies from attacking the player all at once, with enemies not currently in battle with you circling around you. S rank invasion npcs follow "ai 3", which seems to be a combination of guard ai (enemies attack when they see you), and hollow ai, which does not restrict enemies to attacking one at a time. Hollow /nonhumanoid npc behavior differs in that they will attack unprovoked, and will also attack in groups. NewPP limit report

title: Explosion
content:
" The whole point of fighting is that you don't want to die! That you'll be killed if you lose! If you throw your life away in battle, where's the point in winning?! " Description Explosion is one of the common Shikai elements that Soul Reapers can utilize in Peroxide. Explosion's Bankai passive leaves behind 5 falling detonation wisps during the beginning and end of a Flashstep, turns the player's counter into an uptilt, and creates an explosion after a wallbang for extra damage. Explosion Skills Shikai Skills You must be in your Shikai to use these skills. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Detonation Wisps Fragment your explosive reiatsu into super dense wisps which go flying out of your palm, which will detonate upon contact. Spirit Impact Point Guard break Hone your explosive reiatsu into your blade and thrust forward, any whom you strike will have a piece of this reiatsu planted on them ticking away to their demise and pulling them towards you. Spirit Bomb Jump Extender Spread your reiatsu across the ground around you, and then ignite it in a blazing explosion that barrels you and those nearby into the air. Spirit + Strength Bankai Skills You must be in your Bankai to use these skills. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Blast Overdrive Ultimate Ignite your failed body in order to defeat your foes. This move is a mode which slightly buffs the player, heals and revives them if used while downed. No Scaling NewPP limit report

title: Faces
content:
This page is currently being worked on. Some things may be incomplete. wadwa Currently, only Cifer, Zaraki, Aizen and Jaegerjaquez clan make changes to your face. With Cifer clan , you get Ulquiorra's eyes which have small slit-shaped pupils, distinctively thick eyebrows And the exclusive Cifer clan face marking has teal lines which descend from the lower part of your eyes. While you use Segunda Etapa , the sclera of your eye turn green while in that form, like how Ulquiorra's turn green in the anime The pupil changes based on your reiatsu color. The Jaegerjaquez clan has has a pair of narrowed, angry eyes with green lines below them, similar to the eye markings on the Panthera genus of cats. Aizen clan Aizen clan === Aizen clan grants you purple sclera and white irises. This is taken inspiration from Aizen's fused with the hogyoku form. Zaraki clan It gives you a face with high cheekbones, enlarged canine teeth, and pronounced and hairless brow ridges. You cannot use a face reroll for this. This is Kenpachi Zaraki's Face. For females, only your eyes and mouth change. You get a eyes become aggressive along with raised eyebrowns. The female face is most similar to Kūkaku Shiba. NewPP limit report

title: Fire
content:
Fire Type Shikai Scaling Strength + Spirit Rarity Juno might know Race Soul Reaper Requirements Shikai available Level 15+ Bankai available Level 90+ "Because I intend to crush your flesh, blood, soul and sword! Until there is nothing left of it!" Description Fire is one of the Rare Shikai elements that can be acquired by Soul Reapers in Peroxide. In its Bankai form, Fire bestows the user with 3 passives. East: a special M2 attack that shatters the ground beneath the opponent, Fire servants: causes exploding skeletons to passively spawn around the place with every 7-8 seconds, detonating upon contact with an enemy. Inferno: each M1 in Bankai attack triggers burn damage,push countering summons a exploding skeleton. And all sources in air trigger burn damage. Burn damage automatically grips enemy's after a few seconds of burning. Fire Skills Shikai Skills You must be in your Shikai to use these skills . Media Skill Name Description Scaling Fire Slash Extender Drawing your internal flame along your blade, perform a whlwind slash. Winding you and your enemies up into the air, to then slam them down. Spirit + Strength Fire Pillars Sudo Extender Guardbreak Pull from your internal flame, and slam it into the ground. Creating a row of enormous flame eruptions ahead of you. Upon using another Fire Shikai skill you get teleported next to your opponent allowing for a successful hit. Spirit Will Of Fire Guardbreak Enveloping your body with your internal flame you leap forward in a blazing rush, devastating anyone in your path. Spirit + Strength Bankai Skills You must be in your Bankai to use this skill . Media Skill Name Description Scaling Ocean of Fire Ultimate Summon a massive fire tornado that pulls in your enemies, incinerating them, and summons skeletons that explodde and decimate your opponents. Spirit + Strength East M2 Slam your sword onto the ground causing it to shatter and send your opponents flying. Strength Trivia Will of Fire have two media references in one move. The naming came from the Naruto series, while the move itself took inspiration from Demon Slayer's Flame Breathing, as it is a combination of Ninth Form: Rengoku (the fire dragon) and Fifth Form: Flame Tiger (the relentless slashing animation done by the player's avatar). title: Flower
content:
"If you wield your blade without regard for your own life, you will find yourself unable to protect anything. " Description Flower is one of the Rare Shikai elements that Soul Reapers can obtain in the game. In its Bankai state you get a a custom M2 counter, M2, uppercut, and a passive that spawns a sword that deal 50 percent of the damage of every third hit. Flower Skills Shikai Skills You must be in your Shikai to use these skills. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Petal Storm Sudo Extender Guardbreak Send petals into the ground, having them follow your location after 10 seconds, or when using the move again, a pillar of petals will rise up all around you causing your opponent to get launched into the sky. Spirit Flower Tornado Wave your hand forward and send forth a stream of petals that go towards your mouse or near the closest opponent. Once Landing, the petals will burst into a tornado that launches opponents and yourself into the sky even when blocking. Spirit Petal Slash Extender Guardbreak Slash forward and generate a storm of petals that fly forward and rapidly attack your opponent. Spirit Bankai Skills You must be in your Bankai to use this skill. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Slaughter Scape Ultimate Bypass Unite all your scattered petals into one circle of death, floating swords that support you in battle will appear. Re-using the Skill after uniting your scattered petals will combine them all into one final attack. (You can evasive out of the domain because your evasive i-frames remove the collision from the domain swords) Spirit Falling Lotus Uppercut Upon uppercutting someone, wrap them in petals for 5 seconds causing the next down slam to deal 25% of the damage dealt while they had the status effect. Strength Petal Dance M2 Shoot forward a burst of petals. Spirit Lily storm M2 Counter Summon an array of blades made out of petals and fire them. Spirit NewPP limit report

title: Fortune Field Generator
content:
The Fortune Field Generator item is a held item that increases overall luck on obtained drops from Bosses or Raids or other events, It is activated by clicking on it (on and off option) and is AUTOMATICALLY CONSUMED after a Boss or raid is completed - When turned on the text "The Fortune field has been flipped on, and will be expended when you perform an action it can assist on" will appear -When turned off the text "The Fortune Field powers down and will no longer be expended" will appear - Useful for farming Accessories and Time Remnants (Mostly recommended for S rank raids according to other players) but can boost overall luck in places outside of these game modes - Costs 850¥ from Dr, Hydrogen - Can boost luck in time bubbles, S rank invasions, and time gates. however, FFG does not work on unchained or chained storm delving chests. title: Fullbring
content:
Fullbrings are the Element Abilities that you can get as the Fullbringer race in Peroxide. So far there are 6 of them. In order to achieve your Fullbring you must make sure that you have completed the things necessary in order to obtain it. First you must talk to Shūkurō Tsukishima in order to become the Fullbringer race. Then you must get to level 15 and head to the graveyard at night to talk to Michibane Aura . She will give you a Cellphone which can be used to get in and out of the Fullbringer HQ. Then inside you must talk to her to get and need to complete 3 different quests that she gives you. Once these are done she will put you in a match with endlessly spawning agents who you must kill. this is time based about 1:30 to 4 minutes time based. Once you have completed it, your screen with go grey and have an effect on it, with your Fullbring Ability manifesting a few seconds later you will not instantly teleport out. In order to use your Fullbring you must fill up the bar on the left side of your screen to at least 19% and then press G to manifest it. Getting to B rank will allow you to manifest your Fullbringer without needing to fill up the bar at all and infinitely sustain it. There are currently 6 Fullbrings in Peroxide. title: XCution Headquarters
content:
Description The XCution Headquarters is the homebase where Fullbringers get teleported to upon use of the Cellphone that Aura Michibane gives them. It holds many NPCs, many which are useless and important, and is essential for Fullbringers to obtain their Fullbring and Twin Soul , as well as travel between Soul Society and Hueco Mundo to be able to do Invasions. To exit the XCution Headquarters, use your Cellphone once again, and you will be teleported back. Characters In the XCution Headquarters, there are a total of 4 NPCs you can find in the room: Aura Michibane , who transports the players to Soul Society or Hueco Mundo if their reputation allows them to, and allows the player to obtain their Fullbring after 3 quests she gives out. For more information, check out the Fullbringer Progression/Starter Guide . Shūkurō Tsukishima , who teleports the player to their Apartment . Grey Star, who likes to chill on the couch. Joe, who sleeps at the counter. Notes The XCution Headquarters is directly based of the Headquarters seen in the anime the game references, "Bleach" NewPP limit report

title: Fullbringer Progression/Starter Guide
content: This page is currently being worked on. Some things may be incomplete. Part 1: Becoming a Fullbringer As a human or soul, talk to your best friend, Shukuro Tsukishima, to become a Fullbringer. He is in a room behind Asr's Cafe, the building directly to the right of the Gym. Talking to him and choosing the first dialogue option will immediately make you a Fullbringer. Part 2: Early Fullbringer Progression After becoming a Fullbringer, all you have to focus on now is reach level 15 and increasing your stats. There's several ways you can go about doing this. Head to the gym and pay the gym owner a fee of 50 yen for entry. (Recommend doing some jobs for money first.) From there you can use the training machines found in the dojo to start increasing your stats. You can take on jobs from the Job Billboard . They'll grant you experience so that you can level up. You can also get stat increases upon completing jobs if you talk to Herupa and pay her to boost your chosen stat whenever you complete a job. For the sake of grinding levels, you could take the bandit beater route and just kill things for experience, ignoring the Job Billboard. (not really efficient/or just not ask Herupa to not attune a stat so you get extra xp) When increasing your stats you will have to limit break at several points of your progression. Limit-breaking requires you to max out 3 areas of your stats for each rank ranging from Rank F to S+. Combat Stats Reiatsu Agility Once you max out these 3 areas of your stats, you'll need to gain limit break experience in order to ascend to your next Rank. This can be done by talking to NPCs you haven't spoken to before, taking on jobs, or just slaying enemies.(P.S: Invasions also helps limit break. It helped me a whole bunch when there were no good jobs and/or normal Adjuchas.) Part 3: Obtaining Fullbring Once you reach Level 15, at night time, travel to the graveyard on the hill to the left of Urahara's shop, and speak with Aura Michibane . Upon closing the dialogue box, you will be given a Cellphone that you may use outside of combat to travel to the Fullbringer/XCution HQ. Speaking with Aura Michibane in the XCution HQ will allow you to take on the three missions that you must complete before you are given your Fullbring ability. If you are experienced, you will already know what the ability is by looking at the accessory you were given when you spoke with Shukuro Tsukishima and became a Fullbringer (see Fullbrings). The three missions can vary from four randomly selected tasks, all intended to be moderate in difficulty. Escort - You must escort an XCution agent to the designated area, while keeping them alive and safe from Hollows, which will spawn directly next to the Agent in an interval and begin attacking immediately. It is intended to be medium in difficulty, but because of the way the game is designed, it is the most difficult task Aura Michibane can give you, other than reaching Level 90 and defeating your Twin Soul. title: Game Mechanics
content: Page Navigation ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Basics Make sure to read everything in the tutorial as it helps you put these mechanics to practice. There is a Game Manual that you can read by clicking the 6th button on the top left, which will to help you understand many of the Game's Mechanics when you're new. ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Player GUI Shows your Money Shows your Health Shows the cooldowns of your: Push Counter (left) Uppercut (middle) Dash (right) Shows your Level Shows your Reiatsu ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Controls E or Right D-Pad - Draw Weapon Left Mouse or X - Light Attack R , Right Mouse(When in shiftlock) or B - Heavy Attack F or LT - Guard Guard + Right Mouse or Guard + B - Parry (When you get hit) Q or Y - Dash (Under 10 Agility or when out of Reiatsu ) Q or RB - Flashstep (Dash turns into Flashstep when you get 10 Agility) Flashstep + Heavy Attack - Uppercut V or Up D-Pad - Carry (you cannot normally dash/flash step while carrying, until you have at least 150+ agility at S rank) B or Down D-Pad - Grip/Execute N or Left D-Pad - Spirit Realm or Skill Bind Menu G or LS - Transform - This is different for every race, but transforming allows you to use transformation skills (e.g. Shikai, Schrift) = - Drop Item: The item will appear on the ground as a black sphere with the name above it. (You have to hold out the item you want to drop) ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Miscellaneous Guard Break Hitting an enemy that is blocking with Guard Break Attacks will break their guard, leaving them stunned and open to combos. Light Attack Chain Consists of 4 to 6 Light Attacks (depends on Weapon Type) , the last Light Attack used to guard break, but as of an update, m1/light attacks will no longer block break. Flashstep Chain Hold the dash button to perform multiple flashsteps in a row (Amount of Flashsteps depends on Agility Stat and Bonus Flashstep Trait ) . Flashstep when Carrying You can only flashstep while carrying an object or body with a maxed out Agility stat. Knocked Health State between being dead and alive when reaching 0 Health, you get ragdolled and you can be carried and gripped (executed) . You get up again                              after ~15 seconds have passed. Health Pack Get a certain amount of health when an enemy gets knocked, if you contributed damage. (increased depending on time of enemy being alive or amount of hits, remains untested for now) ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Advanced (Early WIP) ‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎Combat Move stacking Most skills can be started while winding up M1s, or light attacks. Utilizing this frequently and effectively can help you string together stronger combos that are harder to escape. Combos / False Stun While there is not many moves that true stun (Aside from most of Glacier 's moves, and the hakuda move aerial assault, along with many others.) due to all races having access to evasive skills, "false" stun is still an important mechanic in developing combos. title: Crystals
content: Sought-after gems that boost the strength of a user's capabilities. Description Crystals are Items that can be use on Skills (excluding unbindable skills) , granting them unique effects but gives a drawback of +50% reiatsu cost. Only one can be used per Skill. Crystals can be replaced by using a new crystal on the same skill, voiding the previous crystal. If you use a crystal on an element skill and reroll your element, your crystals on all element skills will be instantly refunded. Ultimate Crystals are Special Crystals that can be applied to Ultimate skills, but they bear a major drawback. Obtainment You can buy a random Crystal for 50 ¥ and 10 Time Relic from the Shady Shingami located in the café at ASRs Cafe . Crystals Common (80%) Rare (18%) Legendary (2%) These are Common Crystals . Crystal Description Showcase Crystal of Wind Adds a brief wind dash and perfect dodge frames before the move Crystal of Shadow Makes your opponent deal 5% less damage and darkens their screen with every hit by a little Crystal of Spirit Halves the Reiatsu cost, and lets you instantly start regening Reiatsu after the skill is used. Crystal of Inferno Adds burn effect for a short duration Crystal of Artificiality Does 20% more damage towards NPCs - Crystal of Force Adds more knockback These are Rare Crystals . Crystal Description Showcase Crystal of Ichor Grants life-steal (heal ~33% of the damage you deal) Crystal of Exponentiality Expands the timeframe between the hit and taking damage, multiplying all damage when marked by 1.3x Crystal of Aegis Grants hyper-armour after a short start up, protecting you from one hit and self-damaging moves for one hit. There is an ~5 second cooldown after use in which the crystal's effects cannot be activated by any skills. (Except from counters and guard breaks) Crystal of Clutch Pulls nearby opponents towards you Crystal of Prodigy Enhances the mastery of the skill (can change behavior of skill) - Crystal of Degression Marks opponents, removing their crystals effects and lessens their damage dealt Crystal of Chains Damages opponents around the hit player, dealing less damage than to the original target Crystal of Creep Steals opponent's Reiatsu and halves the target's passive Reiatsu regeneration for 1.5sec. Crystal of Reap Prevents opponents from healing (except health-packs from killing and HOS) Crystal of Glass Makes block breaks do as much damage as they would usually do when opponent isn't blocking - These are Legendary Crystals . Crystal Description Showcase Crystal of Terra Builds a wall behind the opponent, allowing them to be pushed into it and receive extra damage. [Your opponent can pushblock off this, which was a nerf added a while back] Crystal of Despair Prevents opponents from using any extender Skills Crystal of Null Increases damage by 33%, (at the downside of everything afterwards doing ~90% less damage.) Crystal of Conduction Adds a lightning strike following a down slam, dealing extra damage Trivia Crystal

title: Gotei 13 (Faction)
content:
The Gotei 13 faction is based off of a group of skilled Shinigami in Bleach This faction is very popular, having over 19K members in their Roblox group and over 12K members in their discord group. Similar to other Factions attaining a certain rank allows the usage of special titles in your ingame name, this only applies for captains roles and  the kenpachi role. The way to get a higher seat is to defeat someone who is one rank above your seat. Like many other factions in peroxide Gotei 13 has many leaders/captains for their divisions, They get their own ingame title as Captain. An example of a title granted as a Captain is: A list of possible Captain/leader roles are: List of Captain Names The Kenpachi Captain Of Division 7 Captain Of Division 1 Captain Of Division 8 Captain Of Division 2 Captain Of Division 9 Captain Of Division 3 Captain Of Division 10 Captain Of Division 4 Captain Of Division 11 Captain Of Division 5 Captain Of Division 12 Captain Of Division 6 Captain Of Division 13 There are 13 divisions in the entirety of Gotei 13, each of these divisions has a set of roles, each role fufills a specific set of requirements for the division to operate effectively. The Captain of a division is the leader and the head of the division they show the upmost integrity and lead their division into battle with great leadership and forges their divisions path to reach their goals. The the expectations of a Sub-Captain align the same as a captain due to the fact that they are expected to be able to operate their division on their own if for any reason a captain isnt availible. Similar to Sub-Captain the head Lieutenant is expected to be able to fulfill the role of Sub-Captain if required The Lieutenant assists in the division to keep it running and alive they could also be promoted incase of sudden departure of any higher commands. Sub Lieutenant This role assists the Lieutenant with their duties Seated Officer These are the best players in PvP in any division, there are about 3-5 of these members per Division There are also separate roles from these roles for a list of these roles: Head of Gotei 13 Secondary Command of Gotei 13 Additional information on Gotei 13 can be found on their Discord Server: https://discord.gg/NTNKKfxs NewPP limit report

title: Gym Bouncer
content:
The Gym Bouncer is a NPC located in Karakura Town next to Urahara's Shop thats allows the player to go into the Karakura Gym to increase your stats with the price of 50 each time. The Gym Bouncer runs the Karakura Gym, which doesn't allow weapons drawn inside. If the player tries to draw their weapon inside the Gym, they will kicked out and told to not draw their weapon out. The Gym Bouncer sells Gym Memberships that allows you to stay inside the gym for 200 seconds or 3 minutes and 20 seconds. The player can increase their stats to a max cap of 30 points, and they can train stat stars, which provide an extra 33% stat exp gain for each one. The maximum amount of stat stars a player can gain from this Gym is 3, while Advanced Dojos in other worlds provide 5 stars maximum. A membership in advanced dojos costs 250 instead of the regular 50 . The Gym Bouncer's counterparts are as follows: The Soul Society Dojo Vendor in Soul Society , the Quincy Dojo Vendor in Wandenreich , and the Arrancar Dojo Vendor in The Alley in Hueco Mundo . title: Hakuda
content: Description Hakuda is a fighting style ( Soul Reaper and Arrancar Exclusive) with 9 close range moves, and can be learnt by completing "Lesson of Strength" and defeating Yoruichi (Who can be found at Urahara Shop). Yoruichi's stats scale off yours, so stat reset max strength or low stats can help make the fight more possible. There are currently 9 abilities in the game right now, and three lessons. Each training gives three skills , first being the basic "Lesson of Strength", second being the "Lesson of Agility"  and third being  the "Lesson of Vitality". You need a certain amount of stats to do each respective lesson. Shunko is also confirmed to be added soon. While Vasto Lordes and Quincycars could obtain Hakuda, it has since been removed from them. Note: Vasto Lorde are able to obtain Arrankuda Hakuda Skills Media Skill name Description Scaling Fleeting Whirlwind Extender Ground version: Create a tornado by spinning around. If successfully hitting anyone, jump into the air and Reset CD. Air Version: Dash quickly in the air, upon making contact with another, kick them up into the sky and slam them back into the earth. Strength Jolting Kick Guard break Slide in with a drop kick promptly following up with an upward kick on any target who is hit by the initial attack. Strength Double Roundabout Guard break Rise up with two sweeping kicks, then follow up with a falling kick slamming anyone nearby in the air back onto the ground. Strength Outspeed Sudo Extender Charge in with an onslaught of afterimages pinning anyone you ram into and then launching them after abruptly halting your advance. Strength Dispersing Barrage Extender Appear in front of someone kicking them, on contact, disappear and hit the target multiple times and re-appear in the air preceding with a swift stomp. Strength Aerial Assault Uppercut towards the sky bringing up a target with you, then proceed to perform a barrage of kicks bringing them back towards the earth. (UNLISTED) : Can extend if you land close to them Strength Showstopper Bypass Take hold of your opponent into a tight squeeze draining reiatsu based off vitality stat (UNLISTED): Is minus on hit Vitality + Strength Headstrong Bypass Grab your opponent and deliver a devastating cranium blow that obscures your opponent's vision for a period of time. Strength Earth Crouching Dragon Hyperarmor Guardbreak Lower your center of mass to throw a powerful uppercut launching your target up; grants Hard Armour and is usable in M1 stuns as a pseudo evasive. Strength Arrancar Hakuda Arrancar Hakuda is a fighting style exclusive to Vastocar Arrancar 's. This fighting style can be obtained by defeating the Orochi boss and unlike Yoruichi after beating him once you will gain all 9 moves of arrancar hakuda. Note: You do not need to have obtained all of Yoruichi's Hakuda moves before you can fight Orochi. The only requirements to fight orochi is to be out of combat and be a vastocar or vasto lorde. title: Storm boss
content:
The Storm Boss spawns 19-6 minutes shortly before the end of a Storm Delve . It uses a random Resurrección and Hollow Clan , and also uses the Ultimate Crystal of Aegis , which grants 9.5 seconds of damage negation after its ultimate move. You can easily find the boss by using the afterlife gps as it has a skull icon while using it. A random title can drop for the player who dealt the most damage (45%+ damage dealt) to the Storm Boss . Titles are purely cosmetic, although higher tier titles are generally considered more valuable. title: Herupa
content:
Herupa in Peroxide is an NPC whose purpose is to enhance your board jobs . Herupa can enhance your board jobs, making them so that instead of gaining exp you boost one of your stats. Herupa can do this enhancing process for 50 yen, although the player can cancel this or change it to increase another stat at any time. Changing stat increase will still cost 50 yen. Note: if you leave the server, you won't have this enhance back when rejoining. Herupa can be always be found next to a job billboard , which means he is in several locations at Karakura city and at one place in Hueco Mundo. Judging from his appearance and mastery in reishi condensation, Herupa is a Quincy. NewPP limit report

title: Impure Hogyoku
content:
" An orb containing a unique substance thought to be capable of dissolving the boundaries between Soul Reaper and Hollow ." Description The Impure Hogyoku (aka: Hog or Imp Hog ) is a rare droppable item obtained from the normal Time Remnant . It allows Soul Reapers and Hollows (mainly Adjuchas and Soul Reapers ) to become stronger by speeding up their progress or unlock new forms. (You can use this as a menos BUT it does NOT speed your progression up. It changes your mask into that of an Ancient Menos ' mask, which is purely cosmetic .) Note: The Pure Hogyoku can also be used to speed up Adjuchas progression into Vasto Lorde. (Gives +1000 progression points on use aswell) Obtainment You can get an Impure Hogyoku by using a Time Remnant , a Godly item obtainable in Invasions , Incursions and Time Gates . The chances of getting a Time Remnant are: Invasions (F/D ranks) – 0.1% (B rank) – 0.2% (Not Recommended) Incursions – 0.1% (Not Recommended) Time Gate – 0.6% (Recommended) Note: After 45 Wins in Time Gates , you are guaranteed to get a Time Remnant . Weekly quests (Recommended) Dr. Hydrogen 's Scrapper Machine (you can get a Time Remnant or an Impure Hogyoku ) P.S: Not Recommended Trading Usage Obtaining Vizard Obtaining Vastorage Speeds up Adjuchas progression into Vasto Lorde (Gives +1000 progression points on use). Turning into an Ancient Menos ( Cosmetic change) Tips The most efficient way to get an Impure Hogyoku is to grind Time Gates or Weekly Quests . Trivia It is one of the hardest items to get. Despite belief it is not one of the items with the most value in trading but it is the item used to measure value in trading. NewPP limit report
