title: Hollow Bait
content:
Hollow Bait Hollow Bait is dropped from all hollows (except menos) and can be used in Karakura , Wandenreich , Soul Society, Menos Forest , and Hueco Mundo If there are too many hollows already in the world, the hollow bait won't spawn any hollows,and instead say "There is already too much Reishi in the air." Types and Effects Hollow Bait Piece -Summons a horde of Fishbones . Drops from Hollows Average-sized Hollow Bait -Summons up to 2 Adjuchas or about 4 Menos with the chance for them to be Ancient, and drops from the aforementioned hollows and fishbones . Condensed Hollow Bait - Summons up to 5 Vasto Lordes that can be Ancient, these do count for Vasto Rage and can even be used for the final step. Can be obtained from killing Vasto Lordes and Adjuchas Uses If you use it in PVP, make sure to use an Accesory with the Hollow Friend trait. title: Hollow

title: Hollow Prince
content: To find the Hollow Prince, you must talk to Hueco Oscura in the Ancient Tome in the Wrecked building, found in the Menos Forest The requirements for fighting the Boss are, Level 90+ 420 points Time Gates reward 75 points if your team win and 25 points if your team loses. Time Bubbles (Bosses) grant 1 point for each percentage of the boss' health you damage. Defeating a Storm Vastocar rewards 10 points if you contribute the majority of the damage (at least 60%). “ You are strong, but, your soul lacks.. something… vital. You must fight those beyond the hourglass, or within the gates of war. I refuse to prey upon anyone else… “ Less than 200 points. “ Your soul is finally gaining that spark, continue your training. Return to me once you’re finally a worthy prey. “ More than 200 points. After beating the Hollow Prince, you are rewarded with the second release of your Resurrección , Segunda Etapa . The Hollow Prince jumps at the Player and starts attacking them. After the Player deals around 20% of his health, the Hollow Prince backs down and sends his minions to fight him. The Hollow Prince sends out two ancient Adjuchas . These Adjuchas are slightly stronger than the ones in Hueco Mundo. The player will not get any sort of Health pack until both Adjuchas are dead. Note: Passing Phase 2 once will set up a checkpoint and you will not have to repeat it even if you fail and die during the next phases. However this checkpoint only appears if you're rank S- or above. The Hollow Prince makes a return, this time he will have more skills to his kit. The player has to deal around 5%-7% of his Health and when they do so, the Hollow Prince will once again disappear and hide while his minions fight for him. The Hollow Prince sends in an Arrancar to fight the player. This Arrancar will be using the Resurrección “ Manifest ” when fighting against the player. When the Arrancar reaches half their health they will activate their Segunda and heal back to near max health. After a long and hard battle, another foe appears. The Hollow Prince sends in another Arrancar to fight the player. This arrancar will be using the Resurrección “ Acceleration ” this time. The player has to repeat the same thing they did in the previous phase, because this arrancar also has Segunda . After the Player has defeated the Arrancar , the Hollow Prince decides to come back to finish him off. The Hollow Prince makes his final return, and this time it is the Player’s goal to kill him, he will have even more moves that the Player must look out for. When the player has successfully killed the Hollow Prince they will be sent out of the Abyss... with the Power .. The Hollow Prince is one of the hardest bosses in the game. It is the only thing stopping you from getting Segunda Etapa . This Guide will explain how to easily beat each phase and what the AI does. This is useless just go to YouTube and find a cheese method on phase 4-5 most people are stuck there but it probably just involves using outs

title: Hollow Starter Guide
content: Part 1: Becoming A Hollow : Unsurprisingly, you’ll need to first become a Hollow . To achieve this, you must die first, then when you're a spirit, pull out your chain of fate five times by repeatedly pressing your 'G’ key, or the button displaying an avatar with an aura if you're on a mobile device. Once you’ve pulled your chain, you’ll become a regular, yellow-eyed Hollow, You'll be able to teleport to Hueco Mundo , where hollow NPCs will be more common, making it easier to gain levels and progress. Once you have become a hollow , the you'll first want to hunt other Hollows . This will both increase your strength and set you on your path to advance in progression. Most of the ones you see in Hueco Mundo are AI-controlled, though a few might be player characters. You can defeat Hollows and then eat the smoking remains that drop on their death to gain experience and access to new Hollow abilities. Part 2: Progressing To Red Eyes : Keep attacking and eating Hollows until you reach Level 20. Once you are Level 20, look for Hollows with red eyes. Defeat one with red eyes to get red eyes yourself.  Finally, find another red-eyed hollow and defeat it. Once you do, you will evolve into the second stage in hollow progression, the Menos . Dying will cause you to lose the red eyes, so stay alive until you find the red-eyed hollow. If you have a friend, try using hollow bait or make them take the "Kill a red eyed hollow" chore so they can see if there is one near them. Part 3: Gillian/Menos Progress: Warning: As a Menos , you have the choice to become an Arrancar by pressing G. However, that choice is a double edged sword - your strength will increase quickly, but your potential will be extremely low. It is recommended to only become an arrancar as a Vasto Lorde . Avoid pressing G, and if you ever accidentally do, wait out the timer for the minigame and do nothing, or press the wrong arrow. The towering Menos , or Gillian , is the state you achieve once you have killed a red-eyed hollow as one yourself. You become much slower in this form, although your immense power allows you to take out most hollow NPCs in the game. Be cautious, however, as when you die, you revert into a normal hollow , and are forced to repeat the red-eye hunting process. To progress into the next stage as a Menos , you need to take out 30 Hollows , and stay alive for 30 minutes. This can be a little tricky, as not only has your speed been reduced, but you’re a very obvious target, and prone to being attacked by both NPCs and players. If you are unable to deal with the NPCs you encounter, or players are bent on killing you, you have a one-time teleport ability which can be used whenever it is needed. Use it only when necessary to prevent your own death, though if you do die, once you become a Menos again, you will keep your kill and time progress. title: Horn of salvation
content: "For all your work, you've gained SALVATION " Description Horn of Salvation (short: horn, HoS) is a Soul Reaper exclusive transformation obtained by using a Pure Hogyoku with Max Vizard and completing a pvp-focused questline. Horn of Salvation replaces your Vizard mask when in Bankai. On use, the user regains around 60-75% of their hp, gains a better vizard buff, and 2 exclusive moves. Horn of Salvation lasts for the entirety of Bankai, regardless of when it was used. Obtainment Guide for Horn of Salvation Quest-line To obtain Horn of Salvation you need to complete 2 stages that are extremely hard. Stage 1: Have Vizard Mask Mastery Maxed Out Consume a Pure Hogyoku Obtainable from Starrk Raid and Storm Delve . When consuming the Pure Hogyoku and the text: "Your mastery of hollow powers is insufficient" that means that your Vizard Mastery isn't maxed. But there is currently a bug that even if you max out your vizard, Pure Hogyoku will still refuse and say: "Your mastery of hollow powers is insufficient". To solve this, keep clicking the Pure Hogyoku until it’s consumed, the server may take a time to load in. Kill 50 S+ players in Hueco Mundo without dying (death resets progress) You must grip 50 different players They need to be S+ rank They have to be combat tagged (do not say mb before grip or it wont count) Kill 5 players in Time Gate (dying before achieving the 5 grips will reset your progress); you can grip players from your own team, and the same player counts. (If someone combat logs after they die to you, you get another kill) Once you have completed 5 Time Gate Grips, the game will say “advanced to the next stage”, meaning you can be combat logged/dying anywhere without getting the grip reset, failing the obby in Stage 2 also won't reset your progress. Stage 2: Find ゴン npc (ゴン translate to Gon ) that is located at the end of "The Pit" that can be found in the right wall of the Gourge in Hueco Mundo , speak to ゴン, he will fling you saying “ピトー“, speak to him again and he will send you to the obby. If you have not gotten the 55 kills (50 unique Hueco Mundo grips and 5 Time Gate grips) he will send you to the menos forest and reset your progress. Complete the super hard obby, if you fail the obby, you can re-try after the cooldown of 15 minute ends, you will not lose your progress. (you have infinite tries) . Stage 3: Have a Time Gate win streak of 5 (winning 5 Time Gates without losing a single one) (Leaving a Time Gate will reset your win streak progress back to 0.) Stage 4: Go to the bell in Hueco Mundo and kill Terumi (Dying to Terumi won't reset your time gate streak so you can die as many times until you beat him) Congratulations, you have unlocked Horn of salvation ! Horn of Salvation Skills/Passives Skills Media Skill Name Description Scaling Activation Gain full control of the hollow inside of you ripping it out in to a horn. Horn of Salvation's heal now scales off your Bankai bar. (Using it at 100% bar now heals you the full amount,

title: How to Get Weapon Ressurection
content: Este é um tutorial em vídeo de como conseguir a arma da ressurreição (Segunda Weapon) jogando de Arrancar . A arma liberada depende da sua Resurrección. Veja também a página Segunda Weapon com o passo a passo em texto. Abrir o vídeo no YouTube Seja um Arrancar (evoluindo de Hollow) com rank e nível necessários. Complete os requisitos (pontos de Time Gate, Time Bubbles, Invasões etc.). Vá para a Menos Forest e encontre o Hollow Prince no prédio em ruínas. Derrote-o para desbloquear a arma da sua Resurrección.

title: Hueco Mundo
content: Hueco Mundo is the homeland of Hollows and Arrancar alike. This area is a location where players that're of the Race , Hollow can freely enter and leave. Ruins of Las Noches "A land of legends, claimed by the storm." Las Noches is the former castle of the Espada. Uses This is where all Hueco Mundo raids happen. (excluding S ranks) The top of Las Noches is littered with Arrancar that will attack you upon entering their presence. This makes genocide for EXP a viable option in this area. This is also where the Monolith is located, which is needed for an Arrancar trying to get a Resurrección Weapon. Trivia While heading upstairs in Las Noches , an NPC called Tohjin will be there when you get to the top. Interacting with him while not in an invasion will make him respond with saying "Trust me. You have no need for my services...". He gives disguises to non-Arrancars if a Storm Guard is given to him. The Alley "A sheltered hand against this hollowed world." The Alley is a sections of small shops with each one having a different purpose in Hueco Mundo . This place also allows you to go on invasions which give you rewards. The alley is guarded by Arrancars , which means you must have negative reputation with the Soul Society to not be attacked by them. Jim's Little Shop Jim's Little Shop is small shop that can be found in The Alley . Uses Jim sells the Spiritvial and Stainpaper. Trivia Jim is an NPC that sells items that function the same but for opposite intentions. One for killing enemies of Soul Society , and one for killing enemies of the Arrancars . Hueco Mundo Dojo Like Jim's Little Shop , the Dojo can be found in The Alley . Besides that, the Hueco Mundo Dojo is no different then any other Dojo. Uses This Dojo can train all of a player's stats separately up to level 30 each, but the membership costs 250 yen. Tim's Clothes Shop The Clothes Shop is located in The Alley . Uses Tim's Clothes Shop allows you to buy Arrancar themed clothes. Each item costs 500 YEN to switch into. Trivia Tim (the NPC standing behind the counter) allows for no dialogue options if one attempts to speak with him. [End Dialogue] The only thing he says to you is " If you see something you like, you outta buy it, no?" Colosseum "Once a grand hold against the storm, now, only a refuge..." This is a hub area with a Job Billboard . Gargan , Erelander Lathrix and Herupa can be found here. Uses Herupa and a Job Billboard . Gargan spawns portals to other worlds in exchange for Yen. A Time Gate spawns here once every hour and twenty minutes. Erelander lathrix, denoted by a purple cloud, will allow players to Storm Delve for 500 yen. Trivia Gargan in the colosseum has blue hair, contrary to his usual orange hair. The Gourge "Where many fall into, and many die." The Gourge is a big ravine in the floor of Hueco Mundo that spawns Vasto Lordes ; also, at the end of The Gourge , there is black pit that leads to the Menos Forest (can also be accessed through the pit (a cavern near the middl

title: Human
content:
The human race is the race everyone starts at, if you do not die when below level 5 then you stay as a human. At any point in human progression you can switch to any other race but your skills will not transfer over. If you get to level 15 then you unlock your m1/2's, block, 2 skills ( Flash Mirage and Counter Strike ). To unlock it, you must either join a new server, or rejoin your current one. To see other players (excluding other humans and Fullbringers ) and hollows, you must have at least 15 Reiatsu . (it is advised if you are maxing a human slot to use a strength build because you have very limited selection of spirit skills.) When You Get Enough Strength You Can Get Default Skills Humans can also use Soukotsu , Reiatsu Eclipse , Ryodan , Flag of Resolve , Vertical Slash and Reiatsu Ball if you consume the knowledge. Humans can also become S+ rank and receive the extra skill slot you would usually get from getting your secondary mode. As a human you can use your regular roblox avatar without having to talk to Mysterious Helper and pay 5000¥ for it. NewPP limit report

title: Hurak
content:
Hurak is a NPC located in Hueco Mundo next to the Vastocar Cave near The Alley. Hurak allows Hollows and Adjuchas players to rebind their skills. Non-Hollow races such as Arrancars and Soul Reapers cannot use this function. If the player who is a Non-Hollow race tries to talk to him, he will only have one option, which is as follows: "What do you need?" "What's going on here?" title: Impure Hogyoku
content:
" An orb containing a unique substance thought to be capable of dissolving the boundaries between Soul Reaper and Hollow ." Description The Impure Hogyoku (aka: Hog or Imp Hog ) is a rare droppable item obtained from the normal Time Remnant . It allows Soul Reapers and Hollows (mainly Adjuchas and Soul Reapers ) to become stronger by speeding up their progress or unlock new forms. (You can use this as a menos BUT it does NOT speed your progression up. It changes your mask into that of an Ancient Menos ' mask, which is purely cosmetic .) title: Incursion
content:
Arrancar , Soul Reaper and Quincy war parties randomly spawn within Karakura , Soul Society and Hueco Mundo to attack anybody who approaches them (unless you are the same race or have high reputation with the race invading) . Defeating all Npcs from the Incursion opens a portal to their respective dimension, e.g. Soul Reapers will spawn a Senkaimon . This is also one of the only ways to get to Wandenreich without being a Quincy , the  other is having positive quincy reputation and buying a portal from gunther, though this is the only way to get it with negative Wandenreich reputation, Races won’t attack their own land, meaning no Soul Reapers in Soul Society , and no Arrancar in Hueco Mundo . You can also find out which race it is using the color of the beam, blue being quinces , gray being arrancars and black and grey being soul reapers. Defeating an Incursion enables you to bolster one stat of choice. You can get a random Accessory . 0.1% of a Time Remnant . NewPP limit report

title: Invasions
content: This page is currently being worked on. Some things may be incomplete. Invasions is a gamemode within Peroxide . In this gamemode, players storm an important area belonging to an organization and then extract. Players can invade Soul Society with the Captain Tojo NPC as a Soul Reaper , Hueco Mundo with Xavier as a Hollow / Arrancar , or the Wandenreich with the General Alberich NPC as a Quincy / Quincycar . After completing an invasion, the player is rewarded with a stat increase of their choice and 4 randomized items from a chest. Bringing additional players reduces the number of items per player (down to 3) for F–B Rank invasions, but this penalty does not apply to S- Rank invasions. All chests despawn after a short time. Each invasion tier is unlocked when the player reaches the corresponding rank. To locate the invasion NPC in a given location, use Reiatsu Sense to find a purple triangle symbol with smaller triangles on each of its three faces. In F Rank invasions, the player must steal an artifact of importance from the organization and bring it back to the NPC who sent them. When the player returns to their portal with the artifact, a white circle will appear; the player must stay within this circle for 15 seconds. Two NPCs will spawn in the area and ambush the player during this time, but being attacked does not cancel the extraction, as the game removes the combat tag and teleports the player out after the timer ends. Taking a path with as few NPCs as possible makes this mission more efficient. Getting knocked back will cause the player to drop the item. Obtaining a disguise makes this mission extremely easy, as enemies will not aggro unless attacked. In D Rank invasions, the player must assassinate 5 guards in the area. The total number of kills required scales with how many players are in the invasion, so larger groups will need to eliminate more guards. It is recommended to avoid anger large groups of enemies, as they will chase the player; a disguise helps a lot here. Shikai users in D Rank invasions count as 2 points instead of 1 towards the assassination requirement, making them valuable targets if the player can safely defeat them. One strategy is to camp a spawn where a single guard appears and repeatedly defeat them, but this becomes less viable when multiple players are present and competing for the same spot. In B Rank invasions, the player must first kill 5 guards and then eliminate a high-profile target: either a Captain (Soul Society) or a Storm Espada (Hueco Mundo). As with D Rank, the total kills scale with party size, increasing the number of eliminations needed when more players participate. Shikai users in B Rank invasions also count as 2 points instead of 1 towards the initial guard-kill requirement, allowing players to finish the quota faster by prioritizing them. The Captain/Espada will always have Bankai or Segunda Etapa and will use it when reaching roughly 1/3 HP (33%). It is recommended to pull the boss to an are

title: Job Billboard
content:
Job Billboards in Peroxide are used to get quick quests. Job Billboards in Peroxide are a feature that lets players pick jobs (quests) that upon completing, the player will receive Yen and EXP (or stat upgrades, if enhanced by Herupa ). Billboard jobs have a timer that's different for every quest, since not all of them are equally fast to complete. Jobs are classified by difficulty/completion time by stars. The more stars, the more time consuming or harder (yet rewarding) the quest is. These stars are ranged from 1 to 4. -Kill 3 Hollows (30 EXP 15 Yen) -Clean up plastic near Kisuke's house (8 EXP 15 Yen) -Deliver the package (15 EXP 20 Yen) -Kill a Menos (375 EXP 60 Yen) -Kill 15 Hollows (265 EXP 90 Yen) -Deliver the far-off package (60 EXP 40 Yen) -Slay an Adjuchas (285 EXP 105 Yen) -Exterminate 3 Adjuchas (420 EXP 145 Yen) -Slaughter 3 Menos (500 EXP 90 Yen) -Slay a VastoLorde (620 EXP 160 Yen) -Defend against a Time Bubble (1125 EXP 150 Yen) -Eradicate 10 Menos (825 EXP 900 Yen) To pick up quests from the Job Billboard, you need to have a humanoid form, thus fishbone , red eyes, menos and adjuchas players cannot pick up any of the previously mentioned quests. Another important thing to know is that these quests show up different for every player, which means noob players can only get 1 star and 2 star jobs. There are several locations at Karakura , but also two in Hueco Mundo . Note: Hueco Mundo's Job Billboards have different quests than the ones at Karakura . When delivering packages, use your knowledge of bus stops. Killing a menos is probably the best quest if you are grinding in Karakura. NewPP limit report

title: Johan
content:
This page is currently being worked on. Some things may be incomplete. Johan is a npc in Wandenreich who can attach your cybernetics and give you a special Schrift Weapon. He is located in the laboratory behind General Alberich’s shop . If the player presents Johan with a Body Modification part and asks for him to install a cybernetic onto their body, he will give them the part’s respective cybernetic and it’s Utility Skill (the Combat Skill must be unlocked via leveling up). The player can also ask him to remove their cybernetic, so that they may get another one. In order to install cybernetics, you must be level 60+. For more information, visit the Body Modifications page. The player can ask Johan to fix them up a special schrift by giving him a Strange Ore. Doing so will change the player’s schrift bow into a more traditional weapon. If you’re unhappy with the schrift weapon you get, you can use another Strange Ore to reroll it. Once you have a schrift weapon, you can freely change between the weapons and the bow by asking Johan . To get a shrift weapon, you obviously need to have your schrift unlocked. The weapons themselves can be seen on the Quincy page. NewPP limit report

title: Vastorage
content: Vastorage is an end-game mode that can be obtained by Shinigami . Although it will not impact your progression up until level 165, it will most likely impact your experience in PvP. Activation You activate your Vastorage by getting knocked while in Bankai mode and having your Vizard mask on. When you get knocked, a cutscene will play where you begin to violently smash your head against the floor, before transforming into your Vastorage form, and letting out a powerful roar which knocks back anyone within its radius, slowing them and nullifying their flashstep. The transformation will heal you fully, and lasts until you run out of Vizard bar. When it runs out, you will go back to your Shikai form. Your stats are multiplied by 1.13x but your max hp is reduced by 0.3x. Vastorage no longer passively drains but your Bankai bar becomes your hp bar. If you land skills you heal and gain more bar, if you get damaged your Bankai bar goes down. When you have no more bar you'll get knocked and be vulnerable to gripping. Obtainment Prerequisite : Level 165 and 3 Impure Hogyokus in total. Become a Vizard by using your first Impure Hogyoku as a level 165 (and above) Soul Reaper . Obtain 2 more Impure Hogyokus and use one. (You should see a text saying "The threads of destiny align." after you use it) Keep the third Impure Hogyoku in your inventory and grip 30-50 Vasto Lordes with your Vizard Mask on. (You will receive the confirmation message in red text: " You feel the urge to kill more... " when killing the first Vasto Lorde , and another that says: " The Impure Hogyoku disappeared... " when you have killed the last Vasto Lorde.) Talk to Ranburā (He's next to Bus Station 1/Fountain behind the stairs/ Fusionfriends NPC) If you get the dialogue option "Him?" click it and read what he says instead , if you don't get it, then end dialogue and talk to him again until it appears. If you skip through the "Him?" dialogue by accident, reattempt interacting with him until you get it again. Now you have to find a Vasto Lorde with the name he has given you (it's a random spawn but there's a higher chance a Vasto Lorde with that name spawns in your server ) A really easy way to find the Vasto Lorde with the name given is to join a small server (5 or less players) and keep checking the Gourge and Vasto cave and kill every Vasto Lorde so they keep respawning. Grip the Vasto Lorde WHILE YOUR VIZARD MASK IS ON with the name Ranburā gave you. Ensure you are in combat with the Vasto Lorde before executing it to receive credit. If done correctly, " Something doesn't feel right... " will appear in red text at the bottom of your screen above your move binds. Congratulations, you have unlocked Vastorage. Celebrate by having your friends and/or enemies brutally maul you to death while in Bankai with your Vizard mask on. Your Vastorage will then activate. Appearance/Note You DO NOT need full Bankai / Vizard Mastery for you to get Vastorage.(But It Is Recommended) During obtainment, y

title: Ken The Shredded
content:
Ken is a NPC that is located near the Heuco Mundo Dojo Vendor . Players can fight Ken for the cost of 100 yen and if they are over level 50. If you are below level 50, he will tell you to get stronger. If you win, he will upgrade one of your stats. You can previously choose what stat do you want to upgrade before getting into the actual fight. The Ken NPC has a 30 minute timer everytime you defeat him. He gives 5 stat stars max, each star make +33% experience in the stats you chose beforehand, which is better than Kisuke . However, Ken is much stronger than Kisuke , being able to use Beast Segunda Etapa moves against you. His counterparts in each map are as follows: Kisuke in Karakura , Laqura in Soul Society , and Buarbiette in Wandenreich . Note: Kisuke only provides 3 stat stars while other duelers provide 5 stat stars due to how hard they are compared to Kisuke . You can also only fight 1 dueler every 30 minutes, and this is effected for every map worldwide for the player. This means that if you beat Kisuke and try to fight Ken, you will be told you are too tired and that you will need to come back after a set amount of time. NewPP limit report

title: Kenpachi
content:
Boss that can spawn by chance (30%) in S- rank invasion within soul society. He doesn't scale of players stats and is recommended to take on with 4 or more players. title: Kisuke Urahara
content:
Kisuke Urahara Features In Peroxide, Kisuke has a variety of functions that can benefit all players, even if they are not Soul Reapers. You can become a Soul Reaper by interacting with Kisuke as a regular human or as a lost soul. All players, Aside from hollows , etc: Soul Reaper , Arrancar , Fullbringer and Quincy players can fight Kisuke for the cost of 40 . If you win, he will upgrade one of your stats. You can choose what stat do you want to upgrade before getting into the actual fight. The Kisuke NPC has a 30 minute timer everytime you defeat him. He gives 3 stars max. Each star makes the stat it applies to get a +33% experience boost. He can also drop Kisuke's Hat , Kisuke's Cloak and Kisuke's Outfit if you defeat him. Upon having a full Soul Gourd, you can exchange the souls it has inside for Yen, upgrading a stat or getting reputation for Soul Society. Kisuke also has a series of chores for players under level 50, that will increase their level, potential and upgrade one of their stats once completed. Quests vary in difficulties and rewards, from killing all types of hollows to delivering packages and cleaning plastic. Another feature the Kisuke NPC has is to exchange product essences for stuff like rerolling pretty much everything (mode element, name, clan, outfit, weapon skin, etc.) or restarting his fight timer. But he might scam you if you roll your element. Location Kisuke's location is in the Karakura map, specifically at Outer Karakura. If you go to the left after getting there, you should eventually find an odd-looking house. Kisuke is located inside of that house. If you have trouble finding him, use your Soul Wayfinder. The place you are looking for should look like this: Trivia Kisuke spamming Kido moves on the player is true to source material as in the anime/manga, Kisuke is a master in Kido, capable of unleashing Hado 91: Senju Koten Taiho and Hado 99: Goryu Tenmetsu, as well as perform a modified version of Byakurai. Kisuke's supposed Shikai element is Benihime, capable of producing and manipulating a crimson-colored energy to perform a variety of techniques. Urahara can use these techniques by declaring the proper verbal command that corresponds to Benihime's different abilities. Kisuke's Bankai is called Kannonbiraki Benihime Aratame, which possess the ability to "restructure anything it touches" both offensively and supportively. Offensively, it can split open whatever is within its area of effect as if cutting with a knife. This "splitting" is similar to the act of dissecting something by cutting it open. Supportively, it can restructure something by stitching it back together. NewPP limit report

title: Laqura The Lightning
content:
Laqura is a NPC that is located in Soul Society next to the Soul Reaper Clothes Store. Soul Reapers, Arrancars and Quincy players can fight Laqura for the cost of 100 yen and if they are over level 50. If you are below level 50, he will tell you to get stronger. If you win, he will upgrade one of your stats. You can previously choose what stat do you want to upgrade before getting into the actual fight. The Laqura NPC has a 30 minute timer everytime you defeat him. He gives 5 stat stars max, each star make +33% experience in the stats you chose beforehand, which is better than Kisuke . However, Laqura is much stronger than Kisuke , being able to use Lightning Bankai moves against you. His counterparts in each map are as follows: Kisuke in Karakura , Ken in The Alley in Heuco Mundo , and Buarbiette in Wandenreich . Note: Kisuke only provides 3 stat stars while other duelers provide 5 stat stars due to how hard they are compared to Kisuke . You can also only fight 1 dueler every 30 minutes, and this is effected for every map worldwide for the player. This means that if you beat Kisuke and try to fight Laqura, you will be told you are too tired and that you will need to come back after a set amount of time. Has a time limit of 5 minutes. title: Limit breakers
content: The Ultimate Guide to Limitbreaking in Peroxide At first your stats are capped in Peroxide, and to increase your stats further, you have to Limitbreak. There are eight ranks in Peroxide, and each rank has a stat cap. A Limitbreak is essentially an ascension to the next rank. But before you do, you need to max out your stats for the rank you’re on. In your Stats menu, on the right side will say Limitbreak, and underneath this should be some text. It should look something like this: Combat Stats Unmaxed Reiatsu Stat Unmaxed Agility Stat Unmaxed You need to max all of these stats for your current rank. Once you do, the text will disappear, and in its place will be a yellow/golden bar. This bar is your Limitbreak gauge. You now need to max the bar until it’s at maximum. You’ll know when the Limitbreak bar is maxed out because it will start to animate like a liquid, so when it’s full, you can then press G without your weapon out to rank up. To complete/access some of the harder content in Peroxide, you must Limitbreak to get better stats and a higher level cap. How to Charge Limitbreak in Peroxide To charge the Limitbreak, you have the choice of a wide variety of mostly combat-focused content, however there are a few exceptions to this. Your options include the following: Invasions Incursions Time Gates Defeating NPC hollows Defeating NPC guards Performing a Konso on a lost soul (Soul Reaper exclusive) Talking to NPC's in all worlds (this only works once per npc) It should be noted that generally, the tougher challenges grant more limitbreak progress. For example, completing a S- Rank Invasion will grant more limitbreak progress compared to a B rank invasion. Additionally, limitbreak bars become tougher to fill up as you rise through the ranks, but at the same time you unlock better sources of limitbreak progress. Total stat points every rank Combat stat points: F : 70 combat stat points D : 140 combat stat points C : 210 combat stat points B : 280 combat stat points A : 350 combat stat points S- : 420 combat stat points S : 490 combat stat points S+ : 570 combat stat points Reiatsu and Agility stat points (each): F : 22 stat points D : 44 stat points C : 66 stat points B : 88 stat points A : 110 stat points S- : 132 stat points S : 154 stat points S+ : 180 stat points (If you can, help us gather information so we can have a better Peroxide wiki by joining the main Peroxide Discord or by joining the Peroxide wiki Discord server. Other information As well as combat/support stat requirements, a few extra requirements must be filled to go past certain ranks. -To go beyond C rank, you must unlock your Shikai/Schrift/Fullbring. Arrancars are the exception to this, as they don't need to do a quest in order to unlock their Resurreccion. -To be able to rank up to S+, you must have your Bankai/Vollstandig/Segunda Etapa/Twin Soul completely mastered. title: Lore
content: THE (unofficial) LORE OF PEROXIDE maybeic4y Long ago, the world was connected by the flow of Peroxide , a mysterious and powerful energy that shaped realms, spirits, and the very laws of existence. Over time, this energy fractured the world into distinct territories, each governed by its own rules and inhabited by warriors, monsters, and spirits who could channel its power. Among these fractured lands, humans, Soul Reapers, Quincies, and Hollows all carved out their own domains, but the balance of power remained fragile. In the central city of the Shattered Realms, everyday life is punctuated by the rhythm of portals, bus stations, and marketplaces where energy and information flow constantly. The bus stations serve as hubs for travelers, though their reach is limited: portals exist only for areas permitted to a player’s race. Humans, Hollows, and Soul Reapers can travel freely to most common locations, but Hueco Mundo, Soul Society, and the Wandenreich remain restricted. Only Quincies can enter the Wandenreich freely, unless others perform a rare and dangerous ritual to breach its boundaries. The bus stops include a Hospital for the wounded, a Bridge Entrance connecting districts, Sickles Chicken , which is always mysteriously closed, a Gym for training, a Urahara Shop stocked with essential tools, and the primary Bus Terminal , where paths to other realms converge. The Shattered Realms are alive with strange phenomena. Every thirty minutes, Terumi from BlazBlue manifests somewhere in the world, bringing chaos and danger to any who cross his path. During the holiday season, the city transforms under the influence of Peroxide itself, raining presents from the skies and bringing brief joy to all races before the constant struggle resumes. The flow of energy also manifests in abilities and transformations: Schrifts , Resurrections , Bankai , Voltstanding , Segunda , and Shikai are the pillars of power, defining every encounter and rivalry. Despite constant player demand, the developers have never added new Shikais, making mastery of the existing arsenal a lifelong pursuit. The world is divided among multiple factions and guilds. Guilds serve as social and combat hubs, where alliances are forged and rivalries erupt. Hueco Mundo, home to the most dangerous Hollows, remains a forbidden territory for most, while the Soul Society maintains its structured order, training new Reapers and defending the balance of the realms. The Wandenreich , exclusive to Quincies, is a realm of secretive power, with portals locked to outsiders and filled with deadly trials for anyone attempting entry. The city itself is a maze of activity. The Gym echoes with training strikes, bursts of energy, and the clash of weapons. The Urahara Shop is always crowded with adventurers seeking rare items or tools to enhance their Peroxide abilities. title: Marking
content:
In the game, players can customize their characters with markings, which are purely cosmetic. These markings do not affect gameplay or stats but serve as a way for players to personalize their appearance. To obtain different markings, players can use face marking rerolls in the reroll shop by using 50 Robux, or by using 0.5 Product Essence . title: Menos
content: Description Gillians are the first Evolution Stage of the Race , Hollow . Gillian NPCs can spawn in Karakura rarely, with Hueco Mundo being more common, & Menos Forest being almost exclusively Menos. Non-Player and Player Gillians almost completely share the same skills, save for the latter having Acid Spit and the exclusive one-time ability to escape from any situation. It is recommended to use said ability only if one is endangered of dying. Obtainment Following the Hollow Starter Guide , you obtain "Gillian" by first leveling up to Level 20 as a normal Hollow . Then, you kill a Red-Eyed Hollow . After that, you kill another Red-Eyed Hollow . Note : Once you kill your first red-eyed hollow, your character will turn into a red-eyed hollow. Alternatively, if you struggle finding the first one, waiting twenty minutes will turn your eyes red automatically. Progression There are two different ways to continue from here: Following the Hollow Starter Guide , after being alive as a Gillian for 30 minutes AND getting 30 kills (must have the killing blow to receive kill credit), the Gillian will automatically turn into an Adjuchas . A Gillian can bypass the first method by pressing G, which afterwards wouldbe given a Mini-Game. Should a Gillian complete this Mini-Game, they will have their mask taken off. This turns them into the weakest type of Arrancar , the Menoscar. This method is highly unrecommended as the Menoscar has the weakest buffs among the Arrancars , and doing this will sacrifice the ability to progress any further. ( You'll also get a pinocchio looking ahh nose..) Alternative Strategy: Staying as a Menos Alternatively, you can attack and let someone else finish off the enemy. This way, your Kill Count bar won’t increase, allowing you to remain a Menos all the way to level 191, which is one of the most enjoyable builds in the game.  Once you reach level 30, you won’t regress anymore as a Menos.  Additionally, you can use an Impure Hogyoku to change your mask to be an Ancient Menos. THIS IS PURELY COSMETIC . RECOMENDED ROUTE FOR LEVELING: Once you reach Menos get a skill reset and use it to max out either cero or stomp, after that farm storm vastocars until lv30(if you can't get a skill reset you should still be able to do this) Regression If a Player Gillian dies, they will revert back to a normal Hollow and will have to go through the Obtainment process of becoming a Menos all over again, if they are not level 30 or higher. Facts The difference between a Menos and Ancient Menos can be shown by their mask, if their mask has a long nose, it is a normal Menos. Otherwise, it's an ancient Menos. It is possible to bypass automatically transforming to an Adjuchas by never receiving kill credit as a Menos. If you combat log as a menos you will revert to base hollow form. title: Menos Forest
content:
"The trees no longer slumber, the evils lurking in their shadow." The Menos Forest is a location under the surface of Hueco Mundo that many Menos and some Adjuchas dwell in.  The overall enviroment is very dark, with the only structures in this place are sparsely placed quartz trees and stone ruins. There are a total of three ways to access the Menos Forest at this current moment: Being A Hollow - If one is a Hollow , they are given the ability, "Garganta", to travel between Hueco Mundo and the Menos Forest. The Gourge - "The Gourge" is a location in Hueco Mundo that allows anybody within it to travel below Hueco Mundo into the Menos Forest. Gargan - Gargan , an NPC found in various locations, can open a portal to the Menos Forest for 150 Yen. This method is rarely used due to the fact that an Arrancar already has the ability to enter the Menos Forest through The Gourge, and any other race has no need of entering the Menos Forest for anything. There are a total of two ways to get out of the Menos Forest at this current moment: Being a Hollow or an Arrancar - Despite the differences between the two forms of Garganta they have, Hollows and Arrancars can still use their Garganta to get out of the Menos Forest into Hueco Mundo . If a human enters the Menos Forest, then they can get out by getting killed and ripping out the chain in their chest to become a Hollow . If a human is in the Menos Forest and is above level 10, their only option is to call a friend to get them out. Being a Soul Reaper - A Soul Reaper can use their Senkaimon to get out of the Menos Forest into Soul Society . Being a Quincy - A Quincy can use their Schatten to escape to Wandenreich Being a Fullbringer - A Fullbringer can use their Cellphone to enter the XCution Headquarters Reaching this location is required for an Arrancar to receive its Resurrección weapon. Hueco Oscuro , one of the many bosses in Peroxide, can be found by entering a ruined building and jumping into the hole at the ceneter of said building. He is essential to letting an Arrancar unlock its Segunda Etapa . The Menos Forest is known for how toxic the players dwelling in it are. If one wants to enter, they either should be really skilled at the game or make their trip in the Menos Forest quick. If one meets neither of those two requirements, they should be prepared to get absolutely owned. There is a cave in the Menos Forest where there are a lot of normal and ancient adjuchas there a green guy named Chad who killed 2 menos NewPP limit report

title: Aura Michibane
content:
Description Aura Michibane is a NPC that spawns in the Graveyard in Karakura Town at night time as well as behind the counter in the XCution Headquarters . Fullbringers will be told by Shūkurō Tsukishima after they turn level 15 to seek her out. If the player interacts with Shūkurō Tsukishima again, he will give clues to her location and spawn time. Features Once the player finds Aura Michibane at the Graveyard and talks to her as a level 15 Fullbringer , she gives the player some dialogue and then hands over a Cellphone , which is used to get in and out of the XCution Headquarters . The player will be able to find her as well behind the counter, and when interacted, will give the player 2 options: Allow me to prove myself! (Begin Mission) Can you open a portal? If the player selects the first option, they will be given a random task. The player must do 3 of these tasks to be able to fight Agent Harlock and obtain their Fullbring . For more information, check out the Fullbringer Progression/Starter Guide . If the player selects the second option, they will be given the option to open either a Senkaimon or a Garganta, or sometimes both, for free, if the player has equal Reputation for Soul Society and Hueco Mundo . You may change your skills by going to bestfriend and saying [ENTER APARTMENT] then go to the computer. Notes Aura Michibane can also tell the player if they are over level 90 and accumulated 420 points that they can fight their Twin Souls Boss. NewPP limit report

content:

title: Monolith Quest
content:
The Monolith Quest is a quest that the Arrancar player must do in order to obtain their Resurrección weapon. First, the player must go to the Las Noches Ruins Directions : Walking straight from the raids/invasions area in hueco mundo take the first right turn and go straight until you see a structure. Next, speak to the monolith located at the top. An easy way to go up the monolith is to walk up the flight of stairs in the main entrance. An alternate way is to take a left near the main staircase and climb up the slanted rock. While it is faster, this route has more enemies that could ambush you. From there, the player must interact with the monolith to absorb its energy. When the player does so, there will be purple text appearing on the bottom of the screen, hinting to the player that they must go to Menos Forest . The player will then be put on a time limit. If time runs out and the player has not reached Menos Forest by then, a message will appear, informing the player that the ancient energy of the monolith has dispersed. If you made it in time, congratulations. You have obtained your very own Resurrección Weapon. There is an NPC known as Vidente who sets you on the path for this quest; however, he is rarely visited due to the fact that speaking to him is optional. Avoid combat with anything in your path. Fighting NPCs/Players will cause you to be combat tagged, which greatly reduces your flashsteps. If you have the Acceleration Resurrección , it is recommended to activate the speed passive move, which allows you to move faster than usual NewPP limit report

title: Nnoitra raid
content:
Nnoitra is one of the possible Raid Bosses in the game. It can be spawned using Time Splitter / Charged Time Splitter in Hueco Mundo . He sometimes spawns in -S Ranks within Las Noches with a 20% chance, or has a 50% chance to be any Hueco Mundo Time Splitter raid boss. Nnoitra has unique sword-style moves and a built-in passive of **infinite Hierro**.  
His outfit adds a new passive to the game that makes Blut Vene and Hierro have a cooldown on taking Reiatsu , making them more effective against multi-hit abilities. Nnoitra also has a passive where he guard breaks on the final M1 (same guard break the old combat system had). content:

content:
This page is currently being worked on. Some things may be incomplete. Organizations are a mechanic found in Peroxide. Organizations may be created/joined by any group you're in. It is possible to join an Organization by talking to the Shady Arrancar NPC. Members of an organization can be identified via an icon of the organization above their head, as well as next to their username on the leaderboard. Hoving your mouse over said icon on the leaderboard should replace the player's name with a yellow text, showing you the name of said Organization. title: Orochi The Shura
content: Orochi is an NPC located in a cave in Hueco Mundo near the Hurak NPC (the cave is also a Vasto Lorde spawn). He teaches hollow players ( Vastocar and Vasto Lordes only) the Arrancar Hakuda skill set right after being beaten. He has 20,000 HP and scales off your strength(?) and spirit stats. Using spirit stats against this boss the damage will depend on your vitality, and his health will be doubled (possibly depending on your spirit). MUST be a Vastocar or Vasto Lorde , otherwise you won't be able to fight him. As a Vastocar , you are NOT required to unlock the base Hakuda from Yoruichi to fight Orochi and unlock the Arrancar Hakuda. When the player talks to Orochi he will say "I've seen fishbones with more grit than you." if you are not a Vastocar/Vasto Lorde player. If you are a Vastocar/Vasto Lorde player and talk to Orochi he will give you the chance to challenge him. If you accept you will be teleported to a dojo similar to the one you are given the tutorial by Laqura when you first play the game. After spawning in Orochi "The Shura" will have a short cutscene before starting the boss fight, and a timer of 240 seconds (4 minutes) will be set (with voice lines from BlazBlue). The fight against Orochi is very hard, but once you beat him you will be given access to all 9 Arrancar Hakuda moves (you must use a skill reset to select, upgrade and use them). His moveset is unique in a few ways. It consists of a combo starting critical, a combo starting M2-Counter, the Arrancar Hakuda moveset (frequently using Banishing Hunt, Ferocity, Tatsumaki, Lightlike, and Flying Fist), Ruthless Fatality, and Dark Beast transformation (healing 33% of all damage dealt, he is stunned during the animation allowing you to waste one evasive from him), his boss exclusive move. In addition, he also has multiple evasives, keep this in mind for high damage combos. Waste evasives with M1s. On rare occasions, he won't use Dark Beast transformation (probably a bug). On these tries, he will NOT heal off his moves nor M1s. Maximize your damage as much as possible, save your evasive and mode, and make a good use of Segunda passives. On high ping, Tatsumaki will true combo into Lightlike . You can perfect block or counter Banishing Hunt . You can block Flying Fist and Tatsumaki , however, to avoid the guardbreak at the end of Tatsumaki , M2-Counter immediately before it happens. Same can be said for Ferocity , block and M2-Counter before the uppercut guardbreak happens and you can get a free combo off of both. Unrivaled and Unforeseen are rarely used, but should still be noted. Unrivaled, while having no counter, gives you iframes at the end, allowing you to block his M1s or chained moves. Unforseen can be blocked. Expression (Earth Crouching Dragon but fancier) should just be dashed away, as it also has endlag. He will dash around you frequently, wait them out and use M1s when he gets close. Heavy weapons (greatsword, axe, guns) are recommended, but not necessarily needed. Pay

title: Perk Stones
content:
Perk Stones are items that can be applied to your Accessories to give special buffs to them Perk stones are items that can be dropped from Arrancars, Vastolordes, and Hollows in storm delving. These stones can be applied to your accessories that give significant buffs. Perk stones are obtained in four different rarities. Those rarities are common, rare, legendary, and godly. Legendary stones and godly stones are only dropped by espadas. These Accessories are obtainable from Storm Delving . Perk stone Attributes Obtainment Common perk stone A common variant of the Perk Stones, gives a random Common perk to an accessory of choice. (You have to be wearing it) Strengthened: +4 Strength Hardened: +4 Vitality Spiritual: +4 Spirit Agile: +4 Agility Resevoir: +4 Reiatsu Artificial: 5% more damage against NPCs Parkour: 20% faster climbing speed and slightly higher if stacked Storm Delve Rare perk stone A Rare variant of the Perk Stones, gives a random Rare perk to an accessory of choice. (You have to be wearing it) Aerial: Take 5% less damage during air combos Proficient: Skills take 10% less reiatsu Shielded: The first attack to hit you outside of combat is voided and does not damage you (this does NOT stack) All-Round: +2 to all stats Swift: 10% extra flashstep speed out of combat Speedster: +1 out of combat flashstep Slayer: 8% more damage against NPCs Storm Delve Legendary perk stone A Legendary variant of the Perk Stones, gives a random Legendary perk to an accessory of choice. (You have to be wearing it) Boxer: M1s deal 3% more damage Strength Resistant: Strength related damage deals 3% less damage Spirit Resistance: Spirit related damage deals 3% less damage Doubled Edge: Deal 4% more damage but also receive 8% more damage Dexterious: Second form lasts 10% longer Underdog: Enemies that have higher health deal 3.5% less damage to you Sniper: Deal 5% more damage when hitting enemies that are atleast 50 studs away from yourself Conqueror:  Deal 10% more damage against NPCs Storm Delve Godly perk stone A Godly variant of the Perk Stones, gives a random Godly perk to an accessory of choice. (You have to be wearing it) Respiration: Perfect dodging an attack will heal you for 1.5% of your max hp Reaper: Deal 15% more damage to NPCs Engager: Lower all cooldowns by 2 seconds upon block breaking an opponent, does not work on evasives and ultimates Sponge: Increases all incoming healing by 5% Storm Delve NewPP limit report

title: Vasto Lorde
content: Not to be confused with Vastorage . Vasto Lorde is the first evolution of a Hollow before turning into an Arrancar . While this race is usable in PvP and PvE, it is not recommended due to the lack of a Second Mode and the abysmally bad stats on Strength and Spirit. It's still semi-viable due to the Lord's Roar and the summon. Description Vasto Lorde have 3 exclusive Skills , Lord's Roar , Secuases and Cero Oscuras . Non-player Vasto Lorde leave behind Remains when they die. They spawn in Hueco Mundo and Menos Forest . They are able to use clan skills such as Cero Metralleta. Vasto Lorde get stats every 10 Levels (starting at Level 5) , they get a 1.15x stat multiplier and their stat scaling gets buffed once they reach level 100. Vasto Lorde can become Vastocar by pulling their mask off. When you become an Arrancar you lose all your levels and you don't keep any Vasto Lorde exclusive Skills (except Cero Oscuras , Hierro, and High-Speed Regeneration). It's recommended to use a skill reset before becoming an Arrancar and getting all the Skills you want at full mastery, as you cannot receive them for some time after becoming an Arrancar . Do not use a skill reset, as you will lose them. Obtainment For players, Vasto Lorde is obtained by getting 1700 "Evolution Exp" as Adjuchas . Exp is gained through killing or eating different types of Hollows , some give more exp than the others. You lose exp upon death. If you are curious on how to keep track of your points, talk to Shady Arrancar in the Alley . Type Reward Eating Remains +1 Exp (for all Hollow types) Normal Hollow +1 Exp Red Eyes Hollow +3 Exp Menos +5 Exp Ancient Menos +12 Exp Adjuchas +10 Exp Ancient Adjuchas +25 Exp Vasto Lorde +50 Exp Ancient Vasto Lorde +75 Exp Storm Arrancar +100 Exp Dying -60 Exp Combat Logging -120 Exp Using Pure/impure Hogyoku +1000 Exp Once you get to 1250 Exp, you can't go below 1250 Exp ever again, even if you die multiple times. Appearance Body Variants Variant 1 Variant 2 Variant 3 Variant 4 Vasto Lorde Skills Hollow Skills Clan Skills Miscellaneous Skills These are skills used by Vasto Lorde. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Lord's Roar Let loose a mighty roar to invoke fear into your opponents. Slows enemies at Mastery 3. No Scaling Secuases Dish your reiatsu as bait, drawing in hollows before taking command of them using your superior will. Masteries 1 - 3 Spawns Normal Hollows which turn into Red Eyed Hollows Mastery. Your hollows become adjuchas at mastery 4, you need 165 lvls to get mastery 4. If you put a Prodigy gem on this skill, it will raise the mastery to 5, changing your adjuchas into ancient adjucha. No Scaling Cero Guardbreak Fire a concentrated beam of reiatsu from your mouth that deals devastating damage to anything that steps in its way. Spirit Bala A weaker version of a Cero fired in the form of a ball, though it's not as strong, it's a lot faster. This ability loses 6 seconds of cooldown per person hit. title: Presents 2024
content:
Presents There are three types of presents in the 2024 peroxide new years event, these been green, blue and red presents. The green presents are the most common and red presents being the rarest and most valuable. Presents can be obtains through two means these being: In Karakura town there are 2 drop events every hour on several spots on the map. The drop events happen every XX:25 and XX:55, Currently there are 6 drop spots in karakura town. The Fountain The Three-way crossroad between the fountain and the Gunther NPC In front of the the gym next to Kisuke . In front of the Kisuke House. in the SicklesChicken's parking lot. The are three drop spots on the lake, two are separated by the two bridges and the third being on the present trad-in island. The second method to obtain presents is through "Protecting peroximas". In the karakura lake seperating inner- from outer karakura there is an island with presents and an NPC called Saint Peroxilas. talk with him and you will get the following dialog "Ho ho ho merry Peroximas how may I help you?" you get two options, one being "I'd like to help save Peroximas" Choose this option and you will be summoned to protect a "wise mythical tree" from waves of Hollows , these hollows range from normal hollows to vasto lordes. The waves will become progressively harder and every 5 waves you will be get a large present drop all around the arena similar to present drops in karakura town. This event is a raid event so it's not made to be a solo venture. Recommendation If you want to farm as many presents as possible fast gather about 2 other players and keep playing the raid event to wave 5 then leave and start a new, it should take about 5 min to get to wave 5 and if you are a small party it will be a lot of presents for all of you. The presents are collected to be opened for limited accessories and skins. There are different rarity presents as well as rewards with each rarity present being worth 10 presents of the lower tier and giving better chances for higher rarity rewards. Rarities are not based of concrete information from the developers, but off my own statistics from opening presents. Without larger sample data, you should take this information with a grain of salt. Green Presents (lowest tier): Common: 81% Rare: 18% Legendary: 1%  Godly: 0% (Current Sample Size: 106 presents) Blue Presents (Medium tier): Common: 48%  Rare: 46%  Legendary: 6%  Godly: 0 (Current Sample size: 100 presents) Red Presents (highest tier): Common:   Rare:  Legendary:  Godly: When interacting with Saint Peroxilas you have another option besides saving Peroximas, this being present trade-in.  You can trade in 10 gifts of one rarity and get one of a higher rarity. For example trading in 10 Green presents would result in you receiving 1 blue present 5 limited weapon skins 4 limited skill skins 3 limited godly Accessories! 6 common limited Accessories NewPP limit report

title: Pure Hogyoku
content:
"A mere imprint of a legend, is terrible echoes still tremoring even unto this hourglass." The Pure Hogyoku also known as a True Hogyoku ( short: True Hog or Pure Hog ). The Pure Hogyoku looks like a normal Impure Hogyoku with the difference that it is purple and has a purple glow. Starrk raids (5% normal/10% distorted) S- Rank Invasions (drop rate indeterminate) Storm Delving Used to start the Horn of salvation questline. Using it will give max Vizard mastery. Using it on Adjuchas will give you 1k points. The developers have stated: "this will be used for new paths in the future". If the Pure Hogyoku is used with Vastorage the Pure Hogyoku will destroy itself , since it was already stated before by the developers themselves that you can have Vrage or Hos not both. title: Quincy Dojo Vendor
content:
The Quincy Dojo Vendor is an NPC located after the first set of stairs to Yhwach , then to the right, where the Quincy Dojo is located along with the Quincy Dueler Buarbiette . The Quincy Dojo Vendor offers a Dojo Membership for his Dojo for the price of ¥250. The Dojo does not allow weapons to be drawn inside the Dojo. If the player tries to draw their weapon inside the Dojo, they will kicked out and told to not draw their weapon out. The Dojo is an advanced Dojo that can give you 5 stat stars for a singular trained stat, and each stat star gives you an extra 33% stat exp when gaining stat experience through quests and dueling. The Quincy Dojo Vendor's counterparts in each map are as follows: The Gym Bouncer in Karakura Town , The Soul Society Dojo Vendor in Soul Society , and the Arrancar Dojo Vendor in The Alley in Hueco Mundo . Note: The Gym Bouncer only provides access to the Dojo in Katakura town, which only provides a max of 3 stat stars for a chosen stat. Advanced Gyms are ones that are located in other maps than Katakura, and all provide a maximum of 5 stat stars for a chosen stat. Advanced Dojos are more expensive but more rewarding at the same time, but a cheaper but harder option with a chance of failure is fighting Duelers in the different maps. They also cannot raise your stats over 30, but still provide star bonuses. NewPP limit report

title: Quincy Starter Guide
content: Quincy Progression Guide: Part I [Becoming a Quincy] The first step is to become a Quincy is by talking to Gunther NPC. By using your reiatsu compass, find the following symbol/icon (on the right); follow it to find a tunnel like area with maxwell and an NPC.[Gunther Location]. Quincy Progression Guide: Part II [Quincy Device] Players can activate the device that Quincy uses by pressing the N key when they are not engaged in the battle to change their skill binds. Quincy Progression Guide: Part III [ Schrift ] The next step of the Quincy Progression obtaining your own Schrift. To obtain the Schrift as a Quincy, first reach level 15+ and talk to Yhwach (who can be found sitting on his throne in the Castle of the Wandenreich). After that, you need to finish the hunt by using the Bounty Medallion item and then talk to him again. An alternative and easier way to get your schrift is by doing Invasions (any rank will do), and after each invasion, talk to Yhwach. After completing your Bounty or Invasion, talk to Yhwach again, and you may obtain Schrift (there is a 1/4 chance of getting Schrift, which increases with each fail). You change your schrift weapon into a greatsword, sword, claw, cutlass or a gun by talking to Johan and giving her a strange ore in Wandenreich. Quincy Progression Guide: How To Get Bounty Medallion In Peroxide? Players can buy Bounty Medallion from the general’s shop.  A shop that can be found in the Wandenreich. To find it, go left after entering the kingdom. You will need 150¥ to buy Bounty Medallion. 100¥ for Quincy Hat. The Bounty Medallion is a peculiar contraption utilized by Quincies to initiate the Hunt, enabling them to track and pursue adversaries of the Wandenreich, be they Soul Reaper or Hollow PLAYERS. Engaging in this Hunt yields valuable experience points to the hunter. However, should the hunter’s endeavor prove unsuccessful, the intended target is instead granted the reward of experience points. Furthermore, this item has a less-used purpose, as it can be used to obtain a Schrift, but this is NOT recommended as most targets will have noob protection. Quincy Progression Guide: Part IV Your next encounter with Yhwach is reserved for when you achieve the noteworthy milestone of reaching Level 90 or beyond as a Quincy. During this interaction, he imparts specific instructions designed to test and affirm your worthiness. Upon receiving these instructions, your task entails ascending a sizable hill within the Wandenreich and entering the dwelling/house situated at its peak. There, an unforeseen and formidable challenge awaits[Vollstandig boss]. Should you emerge triumphant against these odds, your success will earn you the coveted ultimate power known as Vollstandig. For Arrancars who have also reached Level 100 or above, engaging in a dialogue with Yhwach opens an alternate path. title: Quincycar
content:
A Quincycar is a Hybrid Race obtained by Arrancars . Description Quincycar are Arrancars that became Quincy . As Quincycar you lose EVERYTHING Hollow related, even your respective Arrancar Buffs but not Arrancar Mask and Hollow Clan (You can not use Hollow Clan Skills , to get a Quincy Clan you need to Clan reroll), As this race is cosmetic, it is recommended to use either a Menoscar or an Adjuchar instead of a Vastocar to save time. You will keep 5-10+ Max Level 20-80% Exp Boost Your Mask (You can reroll this) Your Clan and it's respective boosts until you reroll your clan . (NOT MOVES) Your Segunda "points" YOU WILL NOT KEEP Any Arrancar/Vasto Exclusive moves (INCLUDING ANY EXCLUSIVE LEGENDARY SKILLS AND CLAN MOVES) Any Arrancar benefits (e.g The stat and health boost) Any Mode progress (If you were max Segunda you need to re-max Vollstandig) Hakuda You will be just like a normal Quincy , able to obtain: Schrift Vollständig Cybernetics Schatten (Teleport to Wandenreich ) Quincy Skills Spirit Weapons and Schrift Weapon Quincy Names and Clans Etc. Cosmetic You keep your Arrancar Mask (and Menos Nose if you are a Menoscar - Quincy ) on top of usual Quincy Cosmetics . Obtainment Prerequisite: Level 100 and +100 Reputation with Wandenreich . Become a level 100 (or higher) Arrancar Get +100 (or more) Reputation with Wandenreich (You can get Positive Reputation by giving Full Soul Gourds to Gunther ) Finish a Quincy Incursion to open the schatten portal to teleport to Wandenreich because of this, it is vital to turn in extra soul gourds so your Reputation doesn't go under 100 (500 is more preferable due to you being able to get your Segunda straight away). You could also pay Gunther to open a portal to Wandenreich. Go to Yhwach by following the path and going up the stairs Talk to him, if you meet the requirements, he will turn you into a Quincycar Additional Notes Going this route for Quincy is faster than grinding Human-Quincy (due to the 20-80% exp boost). You can get your Segunda and then turn to a Quincycar, skipping the parrying part of the Automaton fight. Tip: If your going for the Quincycar route, progress as a Arrancar first. Get to max level then get 100+ rep with Wandereich. I suggest getting Segunda Etapa first (not full mastery) so you keep your points. NewPP limit report

title: Races
content:
There are four races in Peroxide: Hollow , Soul Reaper , Quincy and Fullbringer . All races possess different skills and abilities that differentiate them from each other. There are also three hybrid races: Arrancar , Vizard and Quincycar The Races You can become part of any race upon spawning into the game on a brand new slot depending on what you do first. Soul Reaper Hollow Quincy Fullbringer Soul Reaper To become a soul reaper , you could find Kisuke and choose the soul reaper or "die" option while talking to him or get killed by a hollow to become a lost soul and find Kisuke and select the option to become a soul reaper.  You'll then be reborn as a Soul Reaper. Kisuke is located at the Urahara shop, you can find him with your Soul Wayfinder. Hollow To become a Hollow , you must die to turn into a Lost Soul and then press "G" key 5 times. You will pull your chain and become a normal Hollow. As a Hollow you progress by killing and eating the remains of other Hollows. Quincy To become a Quincy , you need to talk to Gunther , this can be done as a human, or a lost soul. You can find him with your Soul Wayfinder. Fullbringer You must go to the back of the Cafe next to the Gym to meet Shukuro who will ask if you want to join him. Say yes and you'll be converted into a fullbringer and gain the ability to use fullbringer exclusive moves. At level 15, talk to Aura Michibane in the graveyard at nighttime for a phone to acess the fullbringer's HQ. NewPP limit report

title: Raian Hirako
content:
Raian Hirako is a npc in Karakura who specializes in vizard training. He is located near the park. He will offer you to spar as a regular shinigami, but once you are a vizard will offer vizard training for 200 yen per session, which works like second mode training. After beating him with vizard your mastery with vizard will increase causing your vizard mask to last longer His fight consists of Three Phases: Phase One; He will be in his base transformation with the Vizard mask equipped Phase Two; He will enter his Shikai , which is Glacier Phase Three; He will enter Bankai Fighting him will be free if your vizard mask is at maximum mastery. He is located near the park entrance near the Hobo Monk and Shady Shingami . It usually takes 6 to 8 wins to fully master your Vizard. Raian Hirako has Iframes when he pops Shikai . If you cannot find him use the bus to the Hospital then turn left and after reaching a crossing turn left again. Then you should be able to see a npc with blonde hair. NewPP limit report

title: Ranked PVP
content:
Overview Ranked is a gamemode accessible through the menu, requiring a minimum level of 166 to enter (S+ rank for non arrancars, and S rank for arrancars). It is a gamemode where players are pitted to fight against players instead of NPCs, and as such, it has a very different "meta" than standard gameplay. Common "PVE Builds" such as Chaos builds that utilize many Ceros can be much weaker than Resureccions such as Beast . In ranked, you earn " Battle Tower Points " and "ELO" to gain rewards or be ranked respectively. With the battle tower containing rewards such as Legendary Skills or exclusive Emotes. It costs 20 "BTP" to unlock every tier (until after tower level 50 which it costs 50 BTP), and a further amount to unlock or gain items such as Impure Hogyokus , Legendary Skills , Product Essence , Clan Rerolls , Shikai Elements, Resureccion's, Fullbrings, or Schrifts and Accessory Crates . The modes are: 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s, 4v4s, and 5v5s, along with a region selector to gain a better chance of getting a certain region. The top 50 players get titles in game chat of [#rank] name showing off their rank. NewPP limit report

title: Reality Shift Apartment
content:
The Reality Shift Apartment is the apartmant that you gain access to when you achieve your Twin Soul Fullbring . The appearance is a high class suite room with a desk and a shadowy figure that sits at that desk, After talking to the shadowy figure it takes on your appearance. The NPC that sits at the desk is your Reflection, or your Second Soul. By fighting and defeating this NPC in a 1v1 fight 13 times after achieving your Twin Souls , you will able to fully master your Twin Soul Fullbring , which is shown when your Twin Soul Bar turns purple. The Reflection also allows Fullbringers to rebind their moves after they defeat the Twin Souls Boss. For more information, check out the Fullbringer Progression/Starter Guide . NewPP limit report

title: Reiatsu
content:
You need Reiatsu to use Skills and to Flashstep. The maximal stat points in Reiatsu are 180. Some Accessories give you additional Reiatsu. There are Crystals that interact with Reiatsu in different ways, the Crystal of Spirit reduces the Reiatsu cost of the move or the Crystal of Creep that makes you steal the Reiatsu of the person you hit. These Colors of Reiatsu can affect many aspects of the game such as skills and accessories . Red Blood Orange Orange Yellow Lime Green Cyan Light Blue Dark Blue Dark Purple Light Purple Bluish White Pastel Pink Custom Reiatsu ( Crei ) can be any color. It can be earned through various methods such as: devs, faction tournaments, moderators, or giveaways in offical factions / offical server. However, depending on the method used to earn custom reiatsu , the hex range will be capped at certain values, meaning that you will not always be able to choose pure white / black. title: Crystals
content: Sought-after gems that boost the strength of a user's capabilities. Description Crystals are Items that can be use on Skills (excluding unbindable skills) , granting them unique effects but gives a drawback of +50% reiatsu cost. Only one can be used per Skill. Crystals can be replaced by using a new crystal on the same skill, voiding the previous crystal. If you use a crystal on an element skill and reroll your element, your crystals on all element skills will be instantly refunded. Ultimate Crystals are Special Crystals that can be applied to Ultimate skills, but they bear a major drawback. Obtainment You can buy a random Crystal for 50 ¥ and 10 Time Relic from the Shady Shingami located in the café at ASRs Cafe . Crystals Common (80%) Rare (18%) Legendary (2%) These are Common Crystals . Crystal Description Showcase Crystal of Wind Adds a brief wind dash and perfect dodge frames before the move Crystal of Shadow Makes your opponent deal 5% less damage and darkens their screen with every hit by a little Crystal of Spirit Halves the Reiatsu cost, and lets you instantly start regening Reiatsu after the skill is used. Crystal of Inferno Adds burn effect for a short duration Crystal of Artificiality Does 20% more damage towards NPCs - Crystal of Force Adds more knockback These are Rare Crystals . Crystal Description Showcase Crystal of Ichor Grants life-steal (heal ~33% of the damage you deal) Crystal of Exponentiality Expands the timeframe between the hit and taking damage, multiplying all damage when marked by 1.3x Crystal of Aegis Grants hyper-armour after a short start up, protecting you from one hit and self-damaging moves for one hit. There is an ~5 second cooldown after use in which the crystal's effects cannot be activated by any skills. (Except from counters and guard breaks) Crystal of Clutch Pulls nearby opponents towards you Crystal of Prodigy Enhances the mastery of the skill (can change behavior of skill) - Crystal of Degression Marks opponents, removing their crystals effects and lessens their damage dealt Crystal of Chains Damages opponents around the hit player, dealing less damage than to the original target Crystal of Creep Steals opponent's Reiatsu and halves the target's passive Reiatsu regeneration for 1.5sec. Crystal of Reap Prevents opponents from healing (except health-packs from killing and HOS) Crystal of Glass Makes block breaks do as much damage as they would usually do when opponent isn't blocking - These are Legendary Crystals . Crystal Description Showcase Crystal of Terra Builds a wall behind the opponent, allowing them to be pushed into it and receive extra damage. [Your opponent can pushblock off this, which was a nerf added a while back] Crystal of Despair Prevents opponents from using any extender Skills Crystal of Null Increases damage by 33%, (at the downside of everything afterwards doing ~90% less damage.) Crystal of Conduction Adds a lightning strike following a down slam, dealing extra damage Trivia Crystal

title: Reputation
content:
Las Noches - Hueco Mundo . Soul Society - Soul Society . Wandenreich - Wandenreich . If you have a red bar, it means you have Negative Reputation. If you see The primary color of that Faction , it's Positive Reputation. Reputation controls Enemies NPC s and Ally NPCs, also is what determines if they are ally or foe. If you have High Positive Reputation with a Faction they will no longer target you if you are the opposing Faction , that Faction will also allow you to do their invasions. If you have Low or Negative Reputation with your own Faction , they will not longer treat you as a ally, and will attack you, will not allow you to do invasions . If you have total neutral will all Reputation, your Faction will treat you as ally but not others. You need High or Medium Positive Reputation With Wandenreich to be a Quincycar . You can reset your reputation at the Shady Arrancar . The shinigami and hollows are in a relationship where killing shinigami will bring you to the positive for hollows. Therefore a negative bar means you are technically an ally with Las Noches/Hueco Mundo. Ways to get + or - reputation include killing a faction's npc, doing invasions and giving soul gourds to the respective npcs. Killing a Faction's Base Guard earns you -5 Reputation for the Killed Faction. NewPP limit report

title: Rerolls
content:
Rerolls are a mechanic that allows you to change your Shikai / Resurreccion / Fullbring / Schrift Element and some other things. To perform a reroll, you need Product Essences. Visit Kisuke to use your PE or press the Robux icon at the top of your screen and then pressing the "toggle PE usage". (can be done with robux) PE spending options at kisuke: All of Your Product Essences : This option uses all your PE. (Not Recommended) Half of Your Product Essences : This option uses half your PE. One Product Essence : This option is the most conservative, using a single PE. Res / Shikai / Schrift / Fullbring Element reroll 1 PE/200 robux Clan reroll 1 PE Weapon colour/ style reroll 0.2 PE Shikai / Res weapon / Schrift bow 0.3 PE Main/secondary rei colour reroll 0.3 PE Hair/eye colour reroll 0.2 PE Face /name reroll 0.2 PE Face marking reroll 0.5 PE Spirit name reroll 0.3 PE Spirit realm reroll 0.2 PE Vrage body reroll 0.1 PE Vizard / Arrancar mask reroll 0.3 PE Bankai / Segunda / Res outfit reroll 0.3 PE Bankai/Spirit phrase reroll 0.15 PE Res animation reroll 0.15 PE Volt wings / wings colour reroll 0.3 PE Other than element rerolls, all rerolls follow a system of 1 PE = 100 robux. Elements such as Amazon or Glacier have their own reroll page to change their cosmetics. Rerolls can also be obtained through the ranked Battle tower. Element/Clan rerolls obtained through ranked are race locked. (meaning you NEED to buy them on the race you want) Res animation/weapon rerolls cannot change the starrk res animation/weapon. title: Resurrección
content:
Description A Resurrección is a special ability that is given to you once you become an Arrancar during the Hollow progression process. You also need to be level 15 to find out what your Resurreccción is. If you obtain a Resurrección that you don’t want, you can reroll the Resurrección by spending 100 OR by spending Product Essences . Additionally, there are some redeemable codes that reward you with PE that you can use to reroll your Resurrección. Press G to activate your Resurrección when your bar has reached a minimum of 20%, which is filled by dealing damage. Each ranks slows down the drain rate of the bar. Reaching B rank allows you to use your Resurrección when the bar is at 0% infinitely. From this point on, the bar itself will have no use until you obtain your Segunda Etapa . Each Resurrección has 3 skills associated to it and when it becomes a Segunda Etapa , you get an Ultimate ability depending on what Resurrección (commonly referred to as res) you have. Also, when you use your Resurrección, you take on a new form that will be randomly picked for you, this is purely cosmetic however, and you may reroll them for 1 PE per 4 rerolls. Keep in mind that Resurrección has different activating style. (Someone find out what the best one is and put it here) Click here to learn how to obtain your Resurrección Weapon . All Resurrecciónes Common (78.75%) Music ( Spirit ) Astra ( Spirit ) Beast ( Strength ) Rare (20%) Acceleration ( Strength ) Vessel ( Spirit + Strength ) Legendary (1%) Chaos ( Spirit ) Manifest ( Spirit )   ( Strength for segunda moves) Godly (0.25%) Starrk ( Spirit + Strength ) Trivia Only 1st mode that does not require some type of quest ↑ photo credit to BoltSwiitch ↑ photo credit to BoltSwiitch NewPP limit report
