title: Schrift
content:
How do I get my Peroxide Schrift? To get your Peroxide Schrift you must be level 15 or higher after that you must talk to Yhwach in Wandenreich and go on the hunt for the soul reaper you are sent to kill in Karakura town. (you will need a bounty medallion for this you can buy it from the generals shop for 150 yen) If you don't speak with Ywach before your hunt you will be killed and sent back to Wandenreich After you kill the soul reaper you are sent back to Wandenreich , where you will talk to Yhwach again. You have a 30% chance to get Schrift first try, so if he says ¨pathetic¨, you will die and need to hunt another soul reaper. The chances of you getting schrift increase by 10% every time you die to Yhwach. If he says "..." that means you have obtained your schrift. You can also do invasions and talk Yhwach with the same chance of getting Schrift How do I use my Peroxide Schrift? Once you gain your Schrift from Yhwach You activate your Schrift by pressing G after filling up the bar on the right to atleast 20%.  But once you gain B rank you can use this transformation for as long as you please with 0% bar. All Schrifts Common (79%) Duality ( Spirit ) Odyssey ( Strength ) Rare (20%) Vermin ( Strength ) Apocalypse ( Strength ) Eidolon ( Spirit ) Legendary (1%) Forest ( Spirit ) Oasis ( Spirit ) NewPP limit report

title: Segunda/Bankai/Voltstanding Boss Methods
content:
Segunda / Bankai / Vollständig Bosses Are Hard. This page is built to help you guys. 420 Spirit , 69 Vitality Wait for the boss to spawn the m1 4 times, after that follow up with Rising Star then 4 more m1s to then use Agarre Cero . The boss should be at Segunda phase already, that's when you hit him with a normal Cero then founding rain of stars to finish him off hit him with a Cero Oscuras Accessories : Demonic Hood, Flower Cloak, King's Wristband, Scientist Glasses and Starrk's Outfit Stats : 490 Strength , 0 Vitality .
Block the boss’s combo starter, use 4 M1s and use bite. This should get your inner spirit to below half, making him pop segunda. Move near the boss, and activate its ultimate, and run towards one of the walls during the charge up. This should finish the boss by itself without you having to fight its Segunda . Accessories : Candy Horns, The Kenpachi’s Eyepatch, Starrk’s Outfit, and Storm Torn Cape the first phase is really the hardest for vessel, at the last phase, have PATIENCE. do the move "AHAHAHAHA" as a combo starter, then do your combo, run, repeat. Hope this helps :) Pyro cheese: MAX Strength , 0 Vitality and 0 Spirit Equip Tsuzuri Raiden , a combo extender ( cyclone , Fire Slash etc...) and a strong combo finisher ( Will of Fire , slash barrage etc...), DONT equip any evasive moves. You should try to only  use Tsuzuri Raiden and your shikais moves, since if you equip anything else, you bankai boss will have these moves as well. Talk to the Bankai NPC and go into a corner, wait for him to use flash step once and begin to spam m1s, he will flash step into your m1s, so you just need to use a simple combo extender, 4 more m1s and then the combo finisher, as soon as both of you fall into the ground hell flash step again, and then you just repeat this process. Try to only use Strength acessories and simple shikais. The fight should be quite easy this way, so unless your doing the glacier bankai (If u need help with the ice bankai click HERE ), u should be able to defeat the boss 13 times in a row no problem! ( Stage 1 ) No strat, pure instinct. ( Stage 2 ) Voltstanding Obtainment: 490 Strength , pop Voltstanding when ur low. ( Mastery ) Use 490 Strength and Apocalypse . Use crystal of artificiality on Conquest. Skills : Cyclone and Conquest ( Do NOT Equip Evasive ). Use Medium weapon (Gun, Claw or Sword). Do 4 m1s into cyclone , another 3-4 m1s into Conquest. The conquest bypasses his Voltstanding pop allowing for a fast Cheese . (If this doesn't kill him you might need PVE accessories) NewPP limit report

title: Segunda Etapa
content: Segunda Etapa (commonly referred to as just Segunda) is an end-game mode for Arrancars , and is the 2nd Mode for them. How to get Segunda Etapa Segunda Etapa in Peroxide, you must beat the hollow prince. Here are the prerequisites for engaging in this battle and attaining Segunda Etapa : Attain Level 90. Accumulate 420 “Points" Obtain points through different means: Completing a Time Gate awards 75 points if your team wins, and 25 points if your team loses. Time Bubbles grant 1 point for each % of boss health you deal. Defeating a Storm Vastocar awards 10 points if you contribute the majority of the damage (at least 60%) Invasions : 5 points for stealing an object, 12 points for killing a guard, 22 points for killing a leader 6 points for each guard grip during an incursion. Once you meet all these prerequisites, farm level 90, and then initiate the process by jumping into the Prince's Den in the Menos Forest . The prince gives two dialogues : You are strong, but, your soul lacks.. something… vital. You must fight those beyond the hourglass, or within the gates of war. I refuse to prey upon anyone else… – You have collected less than 200 Points. Your soul is finally gaining that spark, continue your training. Return to me once you’re finally worthy prey – You have collected more than 200 Points. How To Activate Segunda Etapa You can activate your Segunda Etapa by pressing the ‘G’ key once the gauge on the right side is entirely filled. Segunda Etapa mode comes with a time limit, starting at 33 seconds with no mastery, and extending up to 190 seconds at full mastery. You can enhance this mode’s duration by diligently training it, which involves utilizing it frequently or engaging in sparring sessions with their Segunda spirit within their Inner World (accessible my pressing the ‘N’ key). immediately gain access to Segunda Etapa . Furthermore, an Arrancar can upgrade these moves by employing their Segunda extensively or practicing with their Inner Spirit through sparring sessions. When in Segunda Etapa mode, your character’s base stats receive significant enhancements: Strength is boosted by 20% (1.2x). Spirit is amplified by 30% (1.3x). Vitality receives a 25% increase (1.25x). Segunda Boss Note : the term "Hollow Prince" will be used here in exchange for Hueco Oscuro . They mean the exact same thing. Phase 1: The Hollow Prince jumps at the player and starts attacking him. He will use Flash Stamp, Aggare Cero, an unknown beam move, Scatter Image, Flash Mirage, and Bala. After the Player deals a percentage of his health (around 80% health), the Hollow Prince backs down and sends his minions to fight him. Phase 2: The Hollow Prince sends out two ancient Adjuchas . These Adjuchas are slightly stronger than the ones in Hueco Mundo . The player will not get any sort of Health restoration until both Adjuchas are dead. Note: Passing Phase 2 once will set up a checkpoint, and this phase will be skipped repeat attempts. However this checkpoint only appears

title: Segunda Weapon
content:
Since others didn't add a Segunda Weapon Guide. To unlock your Segunda Weapon in Peroxide , follow the steps below: You must be a Hollow that has progressed to Arrancar Reach at least Level 90 Earn a total of 420 Points by: Winning Time Gates (75 points each) Losing Time Gates (25 points each) Participating in Time Bubbles , Invasions , or Incursions Defeating Storm Vastocars Go to Menos Forest and find the Hollow Prince in the ruined building If you meet the requirements, you can challenge him Defeat him through six phases , facing Ancient Adjuchas and powerful Arrancar Upon victory, your Segunda will activate and u will be granted whenever u get 100% of your bar u can press g. The weapon you get depends on your Resurrection. Examples include: Image Weapon Name Type File:ChaosScythe.png Chaos Scythe Spirit File:ManifestRifle.png Manifest Rifle Spirit File:LightspeedBlade.png Lightspeed Blade Strength File:VesselClaws.png Vessel Claws Strength File:BeastClaws.png Beast Claws Strength File:GuitarBlade.png Guitar Blade Spirit File:Starblade.png Starblade Spirit Note: Weapons have unique abilities and visuals. Some may be rarer based on your Resurrection path. This is a page in progress NewPP limit report

title: Shady Arrancar
content:
"The Sasuke Of Hueco" The Shady Arrancar is a npc that you can find in the hollow base (invasion place in hueco mundo ) and in the alley next to the principal road for the bridge.
You can rejoin an organisation by the group where you are or create one in the end. Clicking "Can You Clear My Past?" and paying ¥500 resets your reputation. You can check your Vasto Lorde progress by speaking to the Shady Arrancar. By speaking to him he’ll tell you specific phrases based on your progress: ”Not a single bit of progress. ” 0-100 kills “ Not close, not close at all… ” 100-250 kills “ You have a really long road ahead of you… kid. ” 250-500 kills “ You have a long road ahead of you… kid. ” 500-1000 kills “ You’re getting close, that’s for sure ” 1000-1250 kills “ You’re making some progress, keep going. ” 1250-1600 kills “ Almost there, just a little closer. ” 1600 – 1700 kills (Once you reach over 1250 kills, you will stop losing all kill points up to that point. (Do note you can still lose kill points, just that the number cannot go under 1250.) Normal hollow counts as 1 kill Red Eye counts as 3 kills Menos/GIllian counts as 5 kills (12 if it is Ancient) Adjuchas counts as 10 kills (25 if Ancient) Vasto lorde counts as 50 kills (75 if Ancient) Storm Arrancars count as 100 Eating dead hollows counts as 1 kill Using an Impure Hogyoku or pure hogyoku gives you 1000 kills. Incursion counts as 100 kills (any race) Dying makes you lose 60 kills Combat logging makes you lose 120 kills Addon/Extra: Storm Arrancars only count after 55% Damage | Vasto Lordes only count after 30% Damage (This may not be true, as there have been experiences where the counter increased without the percentages listed. Further testing required.) NewPP limit report

title: Shikai
content:
Obtainment Your Zanpakutō has 2 evolutions. The first one is the Shikai. To get your Shikai, you first need to make sure you have a few things in place. For a start, you can only take on your inner spirit if you’re at least a level 15 soul reaper, which might require a bit of training. We recommend hitting the dojo if you need to train before taking on the next step. Once you’re at level 15, you need to press the ‘N’ key to begin meditating. Once you begin meditating, the game tasks you with a quest to collect 60 orbs. Grab all the orbs, then you take on another small quest – which more often than not requires battling a few characters or a single more challenging opponent. the enemies include rogue shinigami, guard soul reapers, and Menos class or higher hollow. With this out of the way, it’s finally time to take on your Peroxide Shikai. The battle against your inner spirit is a difficult one, but thanks to leveling up to at least level 15, you should be well prepared to take on this task. Our advice here is to keep moving, dodge as often as you can, and watch out for special attacks that do more damage. If you die, you won't have to redo the quest. If you are struggling train your stats and level up for new skills. How to activate Shikai Once you deal with your inner spirit, you can enable your Shikai by simply clicking the G key once the meter on the right side of the screen is above 19%. The meter powers up through battling opponents, so just keep on reaping souls to make sure you can engage your Shikai powers whenever the situation calls for it. Once you achieve rank B, you can use this transformation without restrictions. title: Shūkurō Tsukishima
content:
Description Shūkurō Tsukishima is a npc that is described as the best friend of the player. He spawns behind the Kindergarden Play Area and is located in the XCution Headquarters . Features When the player interacts with Shūkurō Tsukishima for the first time as a human or a Lost Soul, he will ask the player to join the Fullbringers . If you talk with him again at level 15 he tells you that you need to meet up with a friend of his, Michibane Aura , who will give you the Cellphone , which will take you to the XCution Headquarters . When the player interacts with Shūkurō Tsukishima before unlocking their Twin Soul Fullbring in the XCution Headquarters , he will teleport the player to his/her Apartment . When the player interacts with him after unlocking their Twin Soul Fullbring , he will comment on how strong they are, and he will teleport the player to the Reality Shift Apartment . title: Skills
content: Description Abilities are called "Skills" in Peroxide. All races share skills and a list of Obtainable Skills while having their own exclusive set of skills. There are also obtainable skills exclusive to Arrancar and Soul Reaper races. Hakuda can be obtained from Yoruichi and there is an exclusive Vastocar Hakuda obtainable in Hueco Mundo from Orochi The Shura Obtainment Every three levels, skill cards are able to be obtained. This shows up as an orange icon above the health bar. Once pressed, it will display up to three skill cards. If not enough skills are available, it can display two, or even only one skill card. Re-rolling Skills Re-rolling skills requires an item called SkillShop Reset Essence. These are obtained from Invasions , Time Gates , and NPCs (non playable characters). Some skills such as High Speed Regeneration and Cero (for Adjuchas), may seem impossible to re-roll. But their chances are lower than 1%. Some skills, like High Speed Regeneration, require at least one point in spirit to obtain. The more you add, the higher the chances are to get that move and other spirit moves. It's not guaranteed, but the chances increase the more you add.  The stats you need for that skill are tied to the stats that strengthen it. ( Resurrección and Shikai move probabilities are not affected by stats.) Mastery Upgrading a skill's mastery decreases it's cooldowns, as well as lowering the reiatsu cost and sometimes bringing more unique changes. Classification Skills are divided into: Combat Mobility (Evasives) Support (Modes/Heals) You only have a limited amount of skills that you can bind to your hotbar. You start with 3 Wildcard Slots (any class/type) , 1 Mobility Slot and 1 Support Slot. 2nd Mode Skill don't take up slots. You can only bind one Mode Type Skill at one time. To get more Wildcard Slots you have to unlock your Shikai / Resurrection / Schrift / Fullbring (+1) and your Bankai / Segunda Etapa / Vollständig / Twin Soul (+1) . Players can change their active abilities depending on their races : Soul Reaper & Arrancar : press N (pc) Left D-Pad (Xbox) and talk to your inner spirit, (for soul reaper you will have to defeat your shikai boss first). Fullbringers : use the Cellphone, and then enter your appartment and use the computer to change your abilities. Quincy : Press N (pc) Left D-Pad (Xbox). Hollows : talk to Hurak at Hueco Mundo, who is located near the orochi cave; this does not apply to Vasto Lordes, who can also access their moves by simply pressing N (pc) Left D-Pad (Xbox). Vitality (Increases health Points, and in very rare instances, increases damage or mastery of certain moves, ec: showstopper and flag of resolve) Spirit (Strengthens non-physical attacks, this is essentially the magic stat of peroxide) Agility (Slightly Increases speed and the amount of times you can Flashstep .) title: Soul Gourd
content:
A Soul Gourd is an item that can be bought for 25 ¥ from either Kisuke’s Shop or the Hueco Mundo Alleyway . It is utilized to gain reputation /rewards with in-game organizations . NOTE: This is a multiple use item, meaning it won't disappear from your inventory after you turn it in to Kisuke/Xavier/Gunther, it is also impossible to drop Soul Gourds. This item also cannot be bought multiple times, so you can't have more than one soul gourd per slot. Collect a certain amount of hollow kills and the Gourd will become bright green, then you can go to either Urahara's Shop, The Alley, or the garage by the bus stop and give the Gourd to Kisuke , Xavier , or Gunther respectively. You can get ONE of these rewards for doing so: +140 ¥ . +40 Soul Society /+45 Wandenreich Reputation , lower negative Reputation with Las Noches by an unknown amount. Exp towards a certain stat of your choice. NOTE: Higher evolutions of hollows take less kills to fill the gourd. Ex: Killing 1 Storm Vastocar will completely fill the gourd whilst Adjuchas will fill it by around 1/3. NewPP limit report

title: Soul Reaper Progression/Starter Guide
content: Part 1: Becoming a Soul Reaper The first thing to do when spawning into the game as a human is to find Urahara shop. You can locate Urahara by using your Soul Wayfinder or by using a Bus Station. After you find him and talk to him it will say ”I want to become a soul Reaper”. Part 2: Soul Reaper Progression Begins After becoming a soul reaper, all you have to focus on now is leveling up and increasing your stats. There's several ways you can go about doing this. 1. Head to the gym and pay the gym owner a fee of 50 yen for entry. (Recommend doing some jobs for money first.) From there you can use the training machines found in the dojo to start increasing your stats. 2. You can take on jobs from the Job Billboard . They'll grant you experience so that you can level up. You can also get stat increases upon completing jobs if you talk to Herupa and pay her to boost your chosen stat whenever you complete a job. 3. For the sake of grinding levels, you could take the bandit beater route and just kill things for experience, ignoring the Job Billboard. (not really efficient) When increasing your stats you will have to limit break at several points of your progression. Limit-breaking requires you to max out 3 areas of your stats for each rank ranging from Rank F to S+. Combat Stats Reiatsu Agility Once you max out these 3 areas of your stats, you'll need to gain limit break experience in order to ascend to your next Rank. This can be done by talking to NPCs you haven't spoken to before, taking on jobs, or just slaying enemies. Part 3: Obtaining Shikai Upon reaching level 15 you are able to unlock your Shikai. To begin the process of unlocking your shikai, go ahead and press the N key to begin meditating. Upon meditating, you will become a soul that is bound to its body by a chain. While in this state, you must collect 160 orbs. Every once in a while, while collect orbs you will receive a quest from your Inner Spirit to prove yourself. This includes: "Defeat one who opposes you." - Defeat a Rogue Soul Reaper. These Enemies are found in the outskirts of Soul Society. "Break the barrier and Slay a powerful Hollow." - Defeat any Menos class hollow (These can be found in Karakura town and Hueco Mundo. It's recommended to hunt them in Hueco Mundo because of a better spawn rate for them. Talk to Gargan for transport to Hueco Mundo or ask a Hollow/Arrancar player to open a garganta to Hueco Mundo.) "Bring me the head of a civilized enemy." - Defeat a Soul Society Guard. (They spawn at the gates and can be found within the Soul Society.) You can also defeat a rogue shinigami that spawn in the small villages out on the outskirts of Soul Society . This is recommended if you don't want to lose reputation . When your meditation and questing is complete, a message will pop up on your screen telling you that you're ready. Press the N key again and you will be teleported to your Shikai's dimension. title: Soul Reaper Progression/Starter Guide
content: Part 1: Becoming a Soul Reaper The first thing to do when spawning into the game as a human is to find Urahara shop. You can locate Urahara by using your Soul Wayfinder or by using a Bus Station. After you find him and talk to him it will say ”I want to become a soul Reaper”. Part 2: Soul Reaper Progression Begins After becoming a soul reaper, all you have to focus on now is leveling up and increasing your stats. There's several ways you can go about doing this. 1. Head to the gym and pay the gym owner a fee of 50 yen for entry. (Recommend doing some jobs for money first.) From there you can use the training machines found in the dojo to start increasing your stats. 2. You can take on jobs from the Job Billboard . They'll grant you experience so that you can level up. You can also get stat increases upon completing jobs if you talk to Herupa and pay her to boost your chosen stat whenever you complete a job. 3. For the sake of grinding levels, you could take the bandit beater route and just kill things for experience, ignoring the Job Billboard. (not really efficient) When increasing your stats you will have to limit break at several points of your progression. Limit-breaking requires you to max out 3 areas of your stats for each rank ranging from Rank F to S+. Combat Stats Reiatsu Agility Once you max out these 3 areas of your stats, you'll need to gain limit break experience in order to ascend to your next Rank. This can be done by talking to NPCs you haven't spoken to before, taking on jobs, or just slaying enemies. Part 3: Obtaining Shikai Upon reaching level 15 you are able to unlock your Shikai. To begin the process of unlocking your shikai, go ahead and press the N key to begin meditating. Upon meditating, you will become a soul that is bound to its body by a chain. While in this state, you must collect 160 orbs. Every once in a while, while collect orbs you will receive a quest from your Inner Spirit to prove yourself. This includes: "Defeat one who opposes you." - Defeat a Rogue Soul Reaper. These Enemies are found in the outskirts of Soul Society. "Break the barrier and Slay a powerful Hollow." - Defeat any Menos class hollow (These can be found in Karakura town and Hueco Mundo. It's recommended to hunt them in Hueco Mundo because of a better spawn rate for them. Talk to Gargan for transport to Hueco Mundo or ask a Hollow/Arrancar player to open a garganta to Hueco Mundo.) "Bring me the head of a civilized enemy." - Defeat a Soul Society Guard. (They spawn at the gates and can be found within the Soul Society.) You can also defeat a rogue shinigami that spawn in the small villages out on the outskirts of Soul Society . This is recommended if you don't want to lose reputation . When your meditation and questing is complete, a message will pop up on your screen telling you that you're ready. Press the N key again and you will be teleported to your Shikai's dimension. Your next task is to fight your Shikai. It's recommended that you prepare

title: Soul Society Dojo Vendor
content:
The Soul Society Dojo Vendor is an NPC located from the left side of the entrance to Soul Society within it's walls. The Soul Society Dojo Vendor offers a Dojo Membership for his Dojo for the price of ¥250. The Dojo does not allow weapons to be drawn inside the Dojo. If the player tries to draw their weapon inside the Dojo, they will kicked out and told to not draw their weapon out. The Dojo is an advanced Dojo that can give you 5 stat stars for a singular trained stat, and each stat star gives you an extra 33% stat exp when gaining stat experience through quests and dueling. The Soul Society Dojo Vendor's counterparts in each map are as follows: The Gym Bouncer in Karakura Town , The Quincy Dojo Vendor in Wandenreich , and the Arrancar Dojo Vendor in The Alley in Hueco Mundo . Note: The Gym Bouncer only provides access to the Dojo in Katakura town, which only provides a max of 3 stat stars for a chosen stat. Advanced Gyms are ones that are located in other maps than Katakura, and all provide a maximum of 5 stat stars for a chosen stat. Advanced Dojos are more expensive but more rewarding at the same time, but a cheaper but harder option with a chance of failure is fighting Duelers in the different maps. They also cannot raise your stats over 30, but still provide star bonuses NewPP limit report

title: Starrk
content: " I so envied the weak. The weak can always find others to be around. I want to be weak. And if that's impossible, I at least want to find companions who are as strong as I. " Description Starrk is the very first and only Godly Resurrección that Arrancar can roll for a 0.25 percent chance. It can also be obtained by using Starrk essence which is a 1% chance drop rate on a Starrk Boss Raid or 2% on a Distorted Starrk Raid. Most Starrk's skills scale on both Strength and Spirit . When Players pop their Segunda Etapa , their first passive will be automatically activated. This Segunda has four passives, an uppercut, sheathe, and counter-block move which each of them are listed below. Appearance Starrk has some unique appearance trait: All the moves color changes based on what your Reiatsu Color is. When you use Starrk, your Resurrección Weapon will automatically be switched to gun, your Resurrección Outfit will be set on outfit #4 (Starrk's) and your Segunda Outfit will be set to a custom one. Note: you cannot change these through rerolls, however note that your old weapon and outfits will still appear if you switch to another Resurrección . Starrk uses a different Resurrección transformation animation than the regular one. Starrk Skills Resurrección skills You must be in your Resurrección to use these skills Media Skill name Description Scaling 🐺 Extender Guardbreak Summons two wolves which target the opponent closest to you, exploding upon impact and briefly ragdolling them. When used during Segunda, summons an additional two wolves. Gives 5% Metralleta meter upon successful usage. Means "The Wolves" in Spanish. (Inflicts Burn Damage and will do the same damage independent of stats, only way to increase is via Perks . Does not trigger Renunciar.) Strength + Spirit Renunciar Counter A counter: upon hit, teleport in front of the attacker, and strike with a flying knee, winding them. Then, reappear behind them to obliterate their head with a condensed cero. Successful counters fill the Metralleta meter by 30%, but failed counters decrease it by 10%. Means "Give up", or "Renounce" in Spanish. (Universally counters almost every move regardless of distance or attributes, bypassed only by specific moves.) Strength + Spirit Colmillo Rush forwards in an omnidirectional flurry of slashes. While in the air, throw a rapid barrage of slashes at whoever is in front of you. If extender on cooldown, it will knock them back. Landing this move grants 5% Metralleta meter. Means "Fangs" in Spanish. (Bypasses block during Segunda.) Strength + Spirit Segunda Skills You must be in your Segunda to use these skills. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Starrk’s Metralleta Bypass After briefly taking aim, annihilate your opponents with hundreds upon hundreds of ceroes. title: Starrk Raid
content:
Coyote Starrk is one of the 6 Raid Bosses in the game. He scales with your level and also scales with the amount of members joining a raid. He has 3 phases. (This raid boss can only be spawned with a Time Splitter while being in Hueco Mundo bought from the Dr. Hydrogen NPC ) Drops Starrk's Outfit - 10% Pure Hogyoku - 5% Essence of Starrk - 1% Beyond Patch - 1% Unstable Time Remnant - ???% Impure Hogyoku - ???% These chances can be doubled if the time bubble is distorted or you have a fortune field generator active. Phases Phase 1: Starrk starts the fight using some basic moves along with some Vastocar and Arrancar Hakuda Skills such as: Cero Oscuras, Expression and Unforeseen . He stays this way until you manage to deal enough damage to tick him. Phase 2 : Starrk, after getting to half health takes it slightly more seriously, and goes into his Resurrección (Once activated heals up to 75% of his max health) while calling out “ Kick About, Los Lobos ” and getting full access to Starrk Resurrección moves along with his Ultimate move Starrk's Metralleta, unlike us players, he can use it whenever without needing to land the skill Renunciar to fill up the meter. Phase 3: After getting tired enough he's forced into his Segunda Etapa , in which, he begins with his first passive Revolver de Los Lobos summoning two big revolvers to fire a giant cero afterwards, and of course being able to use all of his passives as well. When in this state he will begin firing his Ultimate more constantly so you all better be ready(he uses his ultimate more when the targeted player runs). NewPP limit report

content:

title: Storm Delve
content: Storm Delve is a special game mode that requires you to be within 25 levels of your maximum level and is mainly used to obtain perk stones and Product Essences . Storm Delve is a timed PVP/PVE mode where players fight through waves of enemies to collect loot. Players can queue solo, in duos, or in trios (duos/trios require a party). Queueing costs 500 . Players can kill eachother for loot Total of 12 players are required to start, and players are teleported to the map after the queue fills. Storm Delve can be accessed by talking to Erelander Lathrix at multiple locations: NPC near the sakura tree in Karakura Colosseum in Hueco Mundo (near clothing store in Wandenreich ) Segunda location in Menos Forest House near the entrance of Soul Society Tree at the side of the Trade Hub Enemy Notes Adjuchas Regular mobs, drop basic loot. (You can usually obtain Common Perk Stones and Time Relics ) Vasto Lordes Strong mobs guarding areas with chests. Ancient Vasto Lordes Unlike normal Vasto Lordes they negate Hollow Friend and do a ton of damage, be careful. Storm Arrancar Mid-tier enemies (Gives Time Relics , Sunglasses and Rare Perk Stones ) Storm Espadas Elite mobs, drop high-tier loot Possible drops, Time Relics , Godly/Legendary/Rare/(Common?) Perk Stones , Pure Hogyoku , (legendary skills?)) Arrancar bases marked on mini map by purple dots Clearing a base spawns a Storm Power (interact with E) Storm Powers grant buffs: Blessed, Cursed, Trackstar, Marauder, Pilgrim, Corrupt, Conduit, Omniscient. You can consume multiple Storm Powers but only gain their corruption points instead of powers. Every 25 levels of corruption you now gain a Divine perk. (Either a completely unique perk or a super buffed version of an existing perk) Every 5 corruption levels you gain 2 perks rather than 1. List of Storm Powers Storm Power Effect Blessed Revives on death but you lose carried loot along with respawning you in a random location Cursed Prevents other players' Blessed from activating Trackstar Increases Flash Step speed and halves its reiatsu cost Marauder Health packs fully heal Pilgrim Doubles damage against Arrancars Corrupt Grants double corruption points Omniscient Grants the ability to see the chats of all players in delves and also allows you to see better/further. Conduit Gripping the hero of the storm (Arrancar boss) with Conduit power steals all kill credit from the lobby and gives you the supercharged effect (Like V - The Vanguard) This power will also give you immunity to the delve collapse (boss grip isn't needed) and all the open chests within the delve will fill back up when the delve collapses. Rare: 2 PE + basic items Legendary: 5 PE + better items Godly: 20 PE + top-tier items Golden chests are very rare and spawn an additional chest at extraction. Every corruption level increases the user spirit and strength stat by 5%, and also gives a random perk that stays until death or delve collapse. Corruption can be obtained in various ways, including: Corru

title: String
content:
" With great power, there must also come great responsibility. " Description String is the second common and the second Spirit-scaling Fullbring Element that you can roll as a Fullbringer . It is shown as a white headband on your character, and in its Fullbring, a gray kunai. In its Twin Soul form it has three passives, and a custom M2 counter. Passive 1: Laced Composure: After being guard broken, give yourself a string shield reducing damage by 50% until you're able to move. [Cooldown: 60s] Passive 2: Razor Strings: All string skills will now proc bleed. Passive 3: Threads of Fate: Threads randomly spawn only you can see, when touched they will make your ultimate deal more damage. (Max stack of 30) String Skills Fullbring Skills Media Skill Name Description Scaling onto an object onto a player Snare Attach a string onto where your mouse is located and grapple in that direction. If your mouse is on top of a player you will pull him towards you in the air. Reusing this move after doing a successful grapple will make you spin in the air and deal extra damage. Spirit Lace Compress Extender Launch rocks into the sky and dash forward, upon contact, tie strings to the target allowing rocks to smash into them. Spirit Opening Thread Guardbreak If on the ground, stomp the ground sending nearby enemies flying, then grapple onto them proceeding into a cross slash. Spirit Twin Soul Skills Media Skill Name Description Scaling Lacerate Ultimate Dash forward and grapple at least one person you sent flying proceeding into an onrush barrage of slices in a cage of strings. Apply Fragility after landed. (If target is hit under 5% Health, they will instantly get executed and your cooldowns will get reset.) Spirit Snag M2 Counter Passive Counter your opponent attaching a string to them, use any skill to automatically snare into them. No Scaling Laced Composure Passive After being guard broken, give yourself a string shield reducing damage by 50% until you're able to move. No Scaling Razor Strings Passive All string skills now proc bleed. No Scaling Threads of Fate Passive Threads randomly spawn only you can see, when touched they will make your ultimate deal more damage. (Max Stack: 30) No Scaling NewPP limit report

content:

title: The Storm
content:
The Storm is an event that happens inside Hueco Mundo . The sole enemy(s) that spawn during the Storm are special Storm Vastocars (or Vastolorde Arrancars ) , which spawn randomly around the map. There are 5 waves, with each wave increasing the amount of Vastocars that spawn. They are important for harvesting "points" towards various progression points, especially for Hollows , since they contribute a massive 100 Kill Points per kill if the player manages to deal at least 60% of the damage towards them. Otherwise, if the player doesn't have their second mode, they provide 10 "Points" if the player's level is 85+: For Soul Reapers, these points go to Bankai progression. For Arrancars who unlocked their Resurrección, these points go to the fight with Hueco Oscuras . For Quincies, these points go to Voltstanding progression. There is a chance to get 1-6 Time Relics per each Storm Vastocar killed, as well as a 1 in 420 chance (increasing with each wave) to get the Hollow Hunter Cloak . While The Storm is active, Vastocars will have their spawn position (not their current position) indicated by orange 'dots' when using your Soul Wayfinder, which act as beacons. They can spawn anywhere from a few meters from The Alley to the other end of Hueco Mundo . It is speculated that the spawn rate of Red-eyes Hollow and Adjuchas is increased when The Storm is in a server. NewPP limit report

title: Time Bubbles
content:
Raids are bosses from the past coming back to challenge the players. Beware they are extremely strong opponents. Raids appear as a huge beams of energy coming from the sky. The huge beams of light spawn in one of few location around the map every 30 - 45 min and despawn around 5 minutes later so beware, you can also summon one using Time Splitter , or a distorted raid using a Charged Time Splitter . Naturally spawned ones will cause a server message saying: An immense spiritual pressure etc. If a 'glass breaking' sound effect occurs during the message, it means an Aizen Raid has spawned, if mexican like music its Ulquiorra. It is important to note that Time Bubbles only naturally appear in Karakura Town . Time Bubbles in Hueco Mondo and Soul Society will only appear via the usage of a ( Charged ) Time Splitter . To join a Raid you need to be at least level 15 or above and level 80+ for Distorted Raids.(NOTE: YOU NEED TO HAVE NOOB PROTECTION OFF) They give extra rewards if the player and his friends are able to beat the Raid in under 7 minutes. Raids are also guaranteed to drop Time Relics , which can be traded for the magical Gems called Reiatsu Crystals at the Shady Shingami . NOTE: Don't try to join in 2 separate raids at a time, doing at your own risks Distorted Raids Distorted Raids are raids that can only be triggered using a Charged Time Splitter , and are more difficult versions of regular raids. Distorted Raids appear as a black and white wormhole floating in the sky. Drop rates for these raids are also increased as well as Time Relics . The current raids we have are: KARAKURA TOWN/MENOS FOREST Aizen Raid Ulquiorra Raid SOUL SOCIETY Yamamoto Raid Byakuya Raid HUECO MUNDO Nnoitra raid Starrk Raid NewPP limit report

title: Time Gate
content: The Time Gates are an event in Peroxide. The Time Gates can spawn in every  World at xx:00 and closes at xx:30 EST. They will teleport players to a lobby where they are put up in a team with other players and sent to a special map where PvP-based game modes play out. There are only three teams, those being Shinigami,  Arrancars, and Quincies. The teams don't mean/do anything to individual players. For example, the Quincy team won't only have Quincies, it's all randomized. Winning these game modes will give the player two random rewards, a decent amount of EXP, and the chance to boost a stat of their choice. For Point progression, winning a time gate rewards the winners with 75 points while losing only rewards 25 . Friendly fire exists within these game modes, so teams will need to plan out how they'll attack without harming their allies. There is a Level average that's calculated when the teams are full. the game will attempt to pair teams against other teams with a similar average to keep the battles fair. Gladiator The Gladiator game mode consists of the three teams being sent to a gladiator arena. 2 players of each team will be sent in to battle each other. If one person on a team dies, another random player from their team is chosen. The goal of this game mode is to be the last team standing, the zone is first visible after 15 minutes, and is fully closed (same size as any other zone) at 17 minutes also a cool thing that after 17 minutes which team have the most people alive that team win. Elimination The Elimination game mode is a normal battle against the three teams. each kill rewards the team with 1 point. The first team to get 15 points OR the team that has the most points in the allocated time (10 minutes) will be regarded as the victors. Strong Foe In the “Strong Foe” mode, a player is randomly chosen to act as the “Team Leader.” This player stands out due to their enhanced health and increased damage. The main goal of this mode is to defeat the players of the opposing team, with a special emphasis on their leader. This mode features a designated zone that players must remain within to avoid sustaining damage. Team Leaders are easily recognizable to other players thanks to a Crown icon. An additional feature of this mode is that regular players can respawn continuously if their Team Leader is still alive. Capture The Flag (CTF) (REMOVED) Capture the flag consists of each team getting a flag in their spawn area. You must steal other flags and return them to your own. This will give you one point. the goal of this game mode is to have the most points under the allocated time. While holding the flag, you cannot use evasive skills, making avoiding attacks more difficult. Hitting an enemy enough will have them drop their flag. if it is not retrieved within ten seconds, it is instantly sent back to its respective team. title: Time Splitter
content:
The Time Splitter is a consumable item purchasable from Dr. Hydrogen in his pocket realm for 2,200 . A more powerful variant, the Charged Time Splitter , is also available for 5,500 . It is used to summon Time Bubbles , which allow the player to fight Raid Bosses .
Completing a Raid guarantees a minimum of 9 Time Relics , or 19 when using the Charged Time Splitter . It can summon the following raids: Aizen Raid , Ulquiorra Raid , Starrk Raid , Nnoitra raid , Byakuya Raid and Yamamoto Raid , depending on the current world. For more information on raids, see Time Bubbles . Using the Charged Time Splitter summons a Distorted Raid instead of a regular one. NewPP limit report

title: Tohjin
content:
Tohjin is an NPC that is located in Las Noches , Hueco Mundo . He resides on top of the stairs near The Monolith , and he is essential for players who are doing E to B rank Invasions . If an Arrancar interacts with him, he will tell the player that they do not need his services. If you are a Non-Arrancer race and give him a Storm Arrancar Guard, he will proceed to give you a disguise, telling you that you do not need to know where they placed the body. The disguise consists of a fake Menos Nose that is placed on your character's face, which makes all Storm Arrancar Guards passive to you, until you attack them. You cannot remove this disguise unless you rejoin or leave the server, and this disguise will not work on any Hollows or the Arrancars that spawn from The Storm . The disguise will not work for the Espada NPC that spawns from B-rank Invasions either. NewPP limit report

title: Twin soul
content: Twin Soul is the end-game second mode for Fullbringers To unlock your Twin Soul in Peroxide, you must beat your inner reflection. Here are the prerequisites for engaging in this battle and attaining Twin Soul : Attain Level 90. Accumulate 420 “Points" Obtain points through different means: Completing a Time Gate awards 75 points if your team wins, and 25 points if your team lose. Time Bubbles grant 1 point for each % of boss health you deal. Defeating a Storm Vastocar awards 10 points if you contribute the majority of the damage (at least 60%). Invasions give points only if you are above level 80. 5 Points for "Steal an Object", 12 for "Slaughter Guards" and 22 for "Kill a Leader". Each Npc grip you get during an Incursion rewards you with 6 Points. Once you meet all these prerequisite initiate the process by using the ¨beckon¨ command on the apartment computer. Upon equipping your Fullbring , activate your Twin Soul by pressing the ‘G’ key once the gauge on the left side is entirely filled. Twin Soul mode has a time limit, starting at 33 seconds with no mastery and extending up to 190 seconds at full mastery. They can enhance this mode’s duration by diligently training it, which involves utilizing it frequently or engaging in sparring sessions with their reflection within their altered reality world. Upon defeating your reflection, you’ll immediately gain access to Twin Soul . Furthermore, a Fullbringer can upgrade these moves by employing their Twin Soul extensively or practicing with their  Reflection through sparring sessions. When in Twin Soul mode, your character’s base stats receive significant enhancements. Note: this changes somewhat for each one Twin Soul Mode Benefits: – Strength is boosted by 20% (1.2x). – Spirit is amplified by 30% (1.3x). – Vitality receives a 25% increase (1.25x). The Player gets teleported in a room where they have to defeat their past failures. Every time they have died to thus far will come back to haunt them. It is now their job to best the failures and move on. These reflections will be using whatever Fullbring and accessory the player has at that time. Phase two is when the Player’s reflection appears. With it’s goal being to prepare them for the King’s return, it will definitely not go easy on them. After getting it to around 40% HP, the reflection will activate Twin Soul Fullbring and heal to max HP. You will also be healed along with your reflection. it will grant the Player Twin Soul Fullbring after the fight. Note: Passing Phase 1 once will set up a checkpoint and you will not have to repeat it even if you fail or die during Phase 2. However this checkpoint only appears if you're rank S- or above. To be in Twin Soul longer, a Fullbringer will need to beat their Reflections multiple times (13 times to full mastery). To fight the boss so one can increase their mastery, one needs to go to their apartment, and click on "Let's duel again. (Train Mastery)". One will know when one has mastered their Twin Soul w

title: Ulquiorra Raid
content:
Ulquiorra is one of the five Raid Bosses in the game. This boss scales with the player´s level and the amount of player´s fighting him. He has 3 phases he is guaranteed to drop Time Relics , he also has a 2% chance to drop his outfit that gives boost to your stats, And finally he can drop the Volcan Cero Skill Knowledge. Phases Phase 1: Ulquiorra starts the fight in his base form and doesn't even bother until he sees how annoying you can be. Phase 2 :
Ulquiorra, after getting damaged enough will awaken into his Ressurreción mode. In this stage Ulquiorra still isn't going all out and only attacks you with Vessel abilities as well as Lanzas del Relampago . He has ichor crystal on all of his moves; meaning he will heal some hp after hitting you with them. Phase 3: Wanting to show you what true despair feels like, Ulquiorra enables his Segunda Etapa mode which buffs him immensely. This is where things get serious as he lets many Lanzas del Relampago fall from the sky and uses his special move, the Volcan Cero . Beware as in this stage he's almost impossible to beat without the help of your friends. However he is easier to beat if you have a good spirit build or have a high damage AOE skills. title: Ultimate Crystals
content:
Ultimate Crystals are godly items, and are exclusively applicable to ultimate moves (flower domain, starrk metralleta, etc). They give unique effects similar to reiatsu crystals, but unlike reiatsu crystals, they have downsides (other than inferno). Combining 10 godly perk stones in a Storm Delve Using an Unstable Time Remnant Name Effect Drawback Aegis Grants 10 seconds of damage negation after ultimate move is casted (you still take hitstun) 35% of your Mode bar is lost Prodigy Makes your ultimate dual-scale and adds 1 point of mastery Adds 35 seconds to your ultimate cooldown Conduction Teleports you to your opponent before use (the teleport has a cooldown of 45 seconds) Longer wind-up Exponentiality If target has Exponentiality mark, ult detonates early (true damage) Greatly reduced damage otherwise Artificiality Ult does 20% more PvE damage, insta-executes targets 20% less PvP damage Shadow Gain 10s of partial invisibility after ult usage (works if missed) Ult costs 25% more reiatsu and +10s cooldown Reap Applies anti-healing on your opponent (prevents HOS healing) Applies to yourself ONLY if you hit someone Spirit Increasing the mastery of your ultimate by 2 (Lower cd, bigger hitboxes and possibly more dmg) No Reiatsu Regen for 10 seconds Degression Stops all crystals including ultimate ones on your opponent Happens to you too Despair Puts all the opponents moves on 180s cd including their ultimate and for 1 minute last m1 guardbreaks Happens to you too even if you miss Inferno Applies a fire effect which auto-grips knocked opponents (lasts I believe 15 seconds. the colour is the same as your rei) No drawbacks Creep Prevents opponent's mode regen and halves their reiatsu regen for 30 seconds Reverses your controls for 8 seconds Force Increases the knockback for your ultimate Disables your flashstep for a small amount of time Ichor Changes your ultimate abilty to a short ranged grab that true stuns for a few moments. Heals whoever you hit for 30% of their Max HP Your ultimate ability is now just a healing ability and nothing more. Starrks are able to use Metralleta in base though. Shady Shinigami can remove your ultimate crystals They are among the most valuable items to get from an unstable time remnant, with an ultimate crystal of prodigy often going for around 7 hogyokus. Aegis ult gem's downside can be somewhat of an upside, allowing you to mode-cycle to get your mode back faster for the healthpack (although this is quite unreliable, as you would have to pop twice to get the healthpack, as every other mode pop in combat doesnt give a healthpack). Ultimate Crystals can effect people in your party. You can use Ultimate of Prodigy to make explosion ultimate have scaling. You can bypass Ultimate of Spirit's drawback by using Music segunda's blue tempo passive NewPP limit report

title: Update Log
content: This update log keeps tracks of new content, bug fixes, and balance changes that are released. The timeline for the tracking of updates starts at the Jester Update which was released on September 1, 2026. For a detailed overview events such as the Halloween event 2025 , or Easter Event , please refer to their respective pages. The exact times of the updates are not the time the game was updated per say, but rather it is the time the update log was released on the peroxide discord server. The format for the dates are dd/mm/yy. Balance Log #2.5 | 9/9/2026 + Acceleration's Segunda M2 counter passive Lightspeed Reflexes  now goes through block. Reduced self-stun/end-lag a bit + Removed Music's 20% Agility Segunda buff. Tempo and Muse Beat remain the same + Amazon's Twin Souls' Violent Execute will now auto execute opponents below the final hit's damage + Explosion Bankai's dash passive can now hit the same target multiple times but they will only explode on contact once, meaning the explosions themself have to hit the person. + Explosion Bankai's Blast Overdrive can now hit the same target multiple times but they will only explode on contact once, meaning the explosions themself have to hit the person. Balance Log #2 | 8/9/2026 + Reiatsu Ball now has 10% increased spirit scaling + Ryodan will now stop when perfect blocked + Flawless Pierce endlag when missed decreased to 1s, dash distance increased, speed increased, hitbox increased, sends enemies flying with first tick of damage, and is now true of your last m1. Endlag when landed reduced to 0.45s, and time to next flashstep reduced to 2s. + Heilig Schlag will now detonate when it hits a player + Self damage no longer procs Apocalypse's Vollstandig passive Deaths Toll. + Tenran now has 0.8s of endlag if completely missed + Danku 's cooldown increased to 50s. Attacks that Danku blocks now count as your perfect block if you are near the Danku AND said attack. + Horin's hit damage increased to 8, and pull damage increased to 5 + Explosion Bankai's dashes and Blast Overdrive can now only hit once + Amazon's Violent Slash damage decreased to 6 + Amazon's Violent Punish damage increased by 33% + Dimension's Lightning Shower Rain can no longer be cancelled once they're flying in the air (Only before). Balance Log #1 | 5/9/2026 + The following skills no longer hit through walls and need line of sight: Soukotsu , Lacerate , Dispersing Barrage , Flash Draw , Counter Strike , Orbital Pull (V variant) , Ultimate Crystal of Conduction , Renunciar , Storm Blitz and Cosmic Illusion . + Bow M1s now have an extra 12.5% spirit scaling + Increased Bow M2 spirit scaling to 150% + 25% extra spirit scaling + Daggers and Savage Claws now have 15% chip damage + One Handed Claws now have 20% chip damage + Spears now has a much longer and further M2 + Fists now has a 10% faster M2. This does not stack with the Acceeleration Segunda passive + Increased Gun's M2 hitbox s a bit + Greatswords now block break on last M1, however,

title: Urahara's Shop
content:
Urahara's Shop is located in Karakura Town , specifically at Outer Karakura and is an important location for all progressions alike. Kisuke Urahara resides here, with 2 Job Boards and Herupa standing outside. Gargan is also situated outside the shop by the wall, and Yoruichi also resides in the side room on the right of the shop, where you are able to buy a Soul Gourd for 25 . You also able to buy Soul Drinks , which give a boost in exp, for 10 . The shop is where the player is able to fight the Dueler Kisuke as well as get jobs and small tasks from him till level 50, which is essential for progression starting, easy stat increases and limitbreaking. You can also spend Product Essence in the Shop, and trading in your Soul Gourd for stat increases, reputation, and money. NewPP limit report

title: V - The Vanguard
content:
V - The Vanguard is a Delve NPC boss that uses the Apocalypse Schrift, he will spawn at the start of the delve ramdomly in one side of it you can hear a dark music when he is close to you. He can also be found in Wandenreich as a NPC that you can talk Stages V - The Vanguard has two main stages: Base form Schrift (Stage 1) Volt (Stage 2) Vital Surge (Stage 3) Even while in his Schrift , he can still use the Apocalypse ultimate, so be careful. Abilities True Volt V - The Vanguard has a unique Vollständig form called True Volt , which only he can use. True Volt heals him 100% of his HP, and he will keep popping it if you do not kill him fast enough. It is possible to duo or even solo this boss. He has 16,000 HP , but V - The Vanguard also gains a hidden buff if he executes the Storm Server Boss, which increases the chance of his drops. It also make him immune to PvE multiplier damage. This is his Charged State. Charged State If V - The Vanguard consumes the Storm Boss, he will gain immunity to PvE damage but still have the same health. Boss Drops The following items can drop from V - The Vanguard in Storm Delve and related content. True Volt heals him 100% of his HP, and he will keep popping it if you do not kill him fast enough. It is possible to duo or even solo this boss. He has 16,000 HP , but V - The Vanguard also gains a hidden buff if he executes the Storm Server Boss, which increases the chance of his drops. It also make him immune to PvE multiplier damage. This is his Charged State. Charged State If V - The Vanguard consumes the Storm Boss, he will gain immunity to PvE damage but still have the same health. title: Vasto Lorde
content: Not to be confused with Vastorage . Vasto Lorde is the first evolution of a Hollow before turning into an Arrancar . While this race is usable in PvP and PvE, it is not recommended due to the lack of a Second Mode and the abysmally bad stats on Strength and Spirit. It's still semi-viable due to the Lord's Roar and the summon. Description Vasto Lorde have 3 exclusive Skills , Lord's Roar , Secuases and Cero Oscuras . Non-player Vasto Lorde leave behind Remains when they die. They spawn in Hueco Mundo and Menos Forest . They are able to use clan skills such as Cero Metralleta. Vasto Lorde get stats every 10 Levels (starting at Level 5) , they get a 1.15x stat multiplier and their stat scaling gets buffed once they reach level 100. Vasto Lorde can become Vastocar by pulling their mask off. When you become an Arrancar you lose all your levels and you don't keep any Vasto Lorde exclusive Skills (except Cero Oscuras , Hierro, and High-Speed Regeneration). It's recommended to use a skill reset before becoming an Arrancar and getting all the Skills you want at full mastery, as you cannot receive them for some time after becoming an Arrancar . Do not use a skill reset, as you will lose them. Obtainment For players, Vasto Lorde is obtained by getting 1700 "Evolution Exp" as Adjuchas . Exp is gained through killing or eating different types of Hollows , some give more exp than the others. You lose exp upon death. If you are curious on how to keep track of your points, talk to Shady Arrancar in the Alley . Type Reward Eating Remains +1 Exp (for all Hollow types) Normal Hollow +1 Exp Red Eyes Hollow +3 Exp Menos +5 Exp Ancient Menos +12 Exp Adjuchas +10 Exp Ancient Adjuchas +25 Exp Vasto Lorde +50 Exp Ancient Vasto Lorde +75 Exp Storm Arrancar +100 Exp Dying -60 Exp Combat Logging -120 Exp Using Pure/impure Hogyoku +1000 Exp Once you get to 1250 Exp, you can't go below 1250 Exp ever again, even if you die multiple times. Appearance Body Variants Variant 1 Variant 2 Variant 3 Variant 4 Vasto Lorde Skills Hollow Skills Clan Skills Miscellaneous Skills These are skills used by Vasto Lorde. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Lord's Roar Let loose a mighty roar to invoke fear into your opponents. Slows enemies at Mastery 3. No Scaling Secuases Dish your reiatsu as bait, drawing in hollows before taking command of them using your superior will. Masteries 1 - 3 Spawns Normal Hollows which turn into Red Eyed Hollows Mastery. Your hollows become adjuchas at mastery 4, you need 165 lvls to get mastery 4. If you put a Prodigy gem on this skill, it will raise the mastery to 5, changing your adjuchas into ancient adjucha. No Scaling Cero Guardbreak Fire a concentrated beam of reiatsu from your mouth that deals devastating damage to anything that steps in its way. Spirit Bala A weaker version of a Cero fired in the form of a ball, though it's not as strong, it's a lot faster. This ability loses 6 seconds of cooldown per person hit. title: Vastorage
content: Vastorage is an end-game mode that can be obtained by Shinigami . Although it will not impact your progression up until level 165, it will most likely impact your experience in PvP. Activation You activate your Vastorage by getting knocked while in Bankai mode and having your Vizard mask on. When you get knocked, a cutscene will play where you begin to violently smash your head against the floor, before transforming into your Vastorage form, and letting out a powerful roar which knocks back anyone within its radius, slowing them and nullifying their flashstep. The transformation will heal you fully, and lasts until you run out of Vizard bar. When it runs out, you will go back to your Shikai form. Your stats are multiplied by 1.13x but your max hp is reduced by 0.3x. Vastorage no longer passively drains but your Bankai bar becomes your hp bar. If you land skills you heal and gain more bar, if you get damaged your Bankai bar goes down. When you have no more bar you'll get knocked and be vulnerable to gripping. Obtainment Prerequisite : Level 165 and 3 Impure Hogyokus in total. Become a Vizard by using your first Impure Hogyoku as a level 165 (and above) Soul Reaper . Obtain 2 more Impure Hogyokus and use one. (You should see a text saying "The threads of destiny align." after you use it) Keep the third Impure Hogyoku in your inventory and grip 30-50 Vasto Lordes with your Vizard Mask on. (You will receive the confirmation message in red text: " You feel the urge to kill more... " when killing the first Vasto Lorde , and another that says: " The Impure Hogyoku disappeared... " when you have killed the last Vasto Lorde.) Talk to Ranburā (He's next to Bus Station 1/Fountain behind the stairs/ Fusionfriends NPC) If you get the dialogue option "Him?" click it and read what he says instead , if you don't get it, then end dialogue and talk to him again until it appears. If you skip through the "Him?" dialogue by accident, reattempt interacting with him until you get it again. Now you have to find a Vasto Lorde with the name he has given you (it's a random spawn but there's a higher chance a Vasto Lorde with that name spawns in your server ) A really easy way to find the Vasto Lorde with the name given is to join a small server (5 or less players) and keep checking the Gourge and Vasto cave and kill every Vasto Lorde so they keep respawning. Grip the Vasto Lorde WHILE YOUR VIZARD MASK IS ON with the name Ranburā gave you. Ensure you are in combat with the Vasto Lorde before executing it to receive credit. If done correctly, " Something doesn't feel right... " will appear in red text at the bottom of your screen above your move binds. Congratulations, you have unlocked Vastorage. Celebrate by having your friends and/or enemies brutally maul you to death while in Bankai with your Vizard mask on. Your Vastorage will then activate. Appearance/Note You DO NOT need full Bankai / Vizard Mastery for you to get Vastorage.(But It Is Recommended) During obtainment, y

title: Vermin
content:
"I f, lets say, you were to write a story with me as the main character, it would certainly be a tragedy. No. Everyone’s the same, in fact. He’s the main character of his novel, and she’s the main character of her movie. All those that walk this earth are the main characters of their own tragedies. All steal, and from all, something is stolen. We can’t help it. That’s who we are. Steal, and be stolen. Imprison, and be imprisoned. Follow, and be followed. Do, and be done. Affirm and negate over and over. We fight ceaselessly to save ourselves from loss. And yet the people and places we love will one day surely be lost. We will all surely be forgotten. Life is sad. Empty. But, despite knowing we will one day be bereft, despite knowing we will one day disappear, we still strive in wretched ways. We still wish to be beautiful. And I consider. “Which one?” I choose. “This one.” Forever choosing, forever being chosen. Nothing more. Nothing less. title: Vessel
content:
" TASTE SOME DESPAIR! " Description Vessel is one of the Rare Resurreccions that Arrancar can roll in Peroxide. Vessel has 4 moves and mostly scales with strength. Players receive a passive buff that gives the player a custom dash that deals damage, A full custom M1 combo, A custom M2, A custom uppercut, And a custom counter. While this resurreccion has many passives, most are mainly reskins of the base kit and has little impact. Vessel  Skills Resurreccion Skills You must be in your Resurreccion to use these skills. Media Skill Name Description Scaling Uoaring Phalant Guardbreak Extender Unleash a powerful kick in an upward motion sending anything in your path flying. Full mastery of this technique allows it to be used twice in succession in which case the second kick sends the opponent plummeting to the ground. Strength AHAHAHAHAHA Extender Open the gates as multiple snakes creep out and gnaw anyone but the user in its path. Strength + Spirit Bite True Stun The user sends a chain forwards, if this move connects, the user performs a series of strikes as the target is sent upwards, then slamming them back into the ground. This move will auto-lock onto an opponent if they have been recently hit by Uoaring Phalant. This move also scales the damage with the height of the fall. Strength Segunda Etapa Skills You must be in your Segunda to use these skills. Media Skill Name Description Scaling SELF HATRED Utimate Hold out a blade made of hatred and slash forth with utter rage. This move does self damage, hence the name, self hatred. Strength + Spirit Meija Gekkouga M2 Pressing m2 in your segunda sends the enemy up into the air before pulling them back down with a chain and knocking them away *UNLISTED: Keeps them there if it Guardbreaks. Strength Uppercut Soutenjin Uppercut Performing a uppercut in segunda will  launch both the user and the target in the air, followed by a snake-like trail. Strength Zanrouga M2 Counter Doing a pushblock in segunda causes the enemy to be encircled with Ouroboros chains before getting slashed. Strength Messenga Sonido Using your sonido in segunda leaves a snake trail. This sonido will do damage to others who are close to it. Damage decreases depending on the amount of dashes chained. Strength Burensen M1 Passive Using light attacks in your segunda makes the last attack perform a special animation where the user steps on the target's head multiple times before knocking the enemy away with a snake. *UNLISTED: Your M1 Combo now has no endlag. This can also be moved stacked with moves such as SELF-HATRED MOVESTACKING: Before You Do Your Final M1, You Use The Move You Want to Movestack Such As (Aerial Assault, Uoaring Phalant, Ruthless Fatality Etc.) And Then Do your final M1. Strength Trivia All of the Vessel's moves reference Yuuki Terumi , the primary antagonist of the BlazBlue series. NewPP limit report

title: Vizard
content: Vizard is an end-game mode obtained by using an Impure Hogyoku . The mode allows the Shinigami to put on a Hollow mask, which buffs the user while it is worn. Becoming a Vizard also allows you to obtain some usually Hollow exclusive moves. Vizard is a pre-requisite for Vasto Rage and Horns of salvation . Description You activate your Vizard Mask by using your Skill by the same name (pictured to the right), instantly acquired upon using an Impure Hogyoku and becoming a Vizard. You cannot use your Vizard Mask with 0% Vizard Bar. You charge it by dealing damage and you get passive charge by being In Danger. When in Vizard Mode your charge will passively drop but you can still charge it by dealing damage. Your Vizard Bar depletes passively while out of combat as well. As a Vizard you gain the ability to use a select few Arrancar skills, such as Kick Flurry , Agarre Cero and Cero . ( Vastocar skills acquired as a Vasto Lorde , such as Cero Oscuras , as well as Arrancar exclusive Legendary Skills like Gran Rey Cero and Ruthless Fatality CANNOT be used and will not appear when your Soul Shell is opened, also known as choosing an ability after leveling up. Also, you do not gain the ability to use Garganta as a Vizard. Your portal ability will remain Senkaimon .) Vizard mode gives a big boost to all your stats. In exchange for that however, you get debuffed when you're not using the mask. 15% stat debuff, to be precise. The boosts while wearing the mask are listed below. Mastery 0: Returns the buffs taken as a Vizard, plus a 6% boost normally, 12.5% boost when the bar is above 50%. Mastery 1: Returns the buffs taken as a Vizard, plus a 9% boost normally, 15.5% boost when the bar is above 50%. Mastery 2: Returns the buffs taken as a Vizard, plus a 12% boost normally, 18.5% boost when the bar is above 50%. Mastery 3: Returns the buffs taken as a Vizard, plus a 15% boost normally, 21.5% boost when the bar is above 50% Prodigy is unable to be used with the Vizard Mask ability. If the mask is used when the Vizard bar is below 50% you get an extra 3% buff. If the mask is used when the Vizard bar is above 50% you get an extra 6.5% buff. Obtainment Use Impure Hogyoku as a Soul Reaper at B rank and above The level requirement is 165. Mastering Your Vizard Mask can be trained to last longer by fighting Raian Hirako , the Vizard Trainer. Fighting him costs 200 Yen, and like fighting any other trainer, your Yen is not returned if you are defeated, nor when you win. When It is fully mastered, the outline on it's mode bar will turn purple. You can see how far you are by the Mask Skill Mastery, 3 Bars means you are really close, or fully mastered.(note: you can fight Raian Hirako first a few times  prefer 15 times, then when you use Impure Hogyoku you will have max Vizard, I tested it trust) Fighting your inner spirit on strength testing mode is the best way of grinding vizard mastery. If you defeat your spirit, even if you grip it, it will get back up. There is no way

title: Vollständig
content: Vollständig is the 2nd mode exclusive to Quincies and Quincycars . The mode consists of the player obtaining a halo and wings, along with a new Vollständig move. You also keep your Schrift weapon. How to Obtain Vollständig To unlock your Vollständig form in Peroxide, you must defeat your Vollständig boss. Here are the prerequisites for engaging in this battle and attaining Vollständig: 1. Reach Level 90. 2. Accumulate 420 “Points,” which become available only after reaching level 85. 3. Obtain points through different means: Completing a Time Gates awards 75 points. Time Bubbles (Bosses) grant 1 point for each percentage of boss health you damage. Defeating a Storm Vastocar rewards 10 points if you contribute the majority of the damage (at least 60%) Invasions (only if you are level 80+) – 5 points for stealing an object, 12 points for assassinate guards, 22 points for killing a leader. You must complete the invasions to obtain the points. Once you meet all these prerequisites, initiate the process by talking to Yhwach . He will tell you to go to the mountain lab in Wandenreich, upon entering you’ll engage in a battle. If you are victorious against your Vollständig Boss , you may speak to Yhwach to obtain your Vollständig. How To Activate Vollständig Upon equipping your Schrift, activate your Vollständig by pressing the ‘G’ key once the gauge on the left side is entirely filled. Vollständig mode comes with a time limit, starting at 33 seconds and extending up to 190 seconds at its maximum. You can enhance this mode’s duration by diligently training it, which involves utilizing it frequently or engaging in sparring sessions with your Vollständig boss. Upon defeating the Vollständig Boss, you’ll immediately gain access to Vollständig moves. Furthermore, you can upgrade these moves by employing your Vollständig extensively or practicing with your Vollständig through sparring sessions. To be able to activate your Vollständig, after defeating the Vollständig Boss, talk to Yhwach to obtain your Vollständig. Benefits When in Vollständig mode, your character’s base stats receive significant enhancements: Note: this changes for each Vollständig. – Strength is boosted by 45% (1.7). – Spirit is amplified by  50% (1.8). – Vitality receives a 35% increase (1.50). Vollständig Boss (Samuel Sam) Upon meeting the point requirement, you must speak to Yhwach. He will tell you to enter a building on the outskirts of Wandenreich. When you enter, you will be teleported to a room, initiating the fight against the first adversary, the Ancient Automaton . Ancient Automaton (Samuel Sam) The Ancient Automaton boss starts off with using Quincy moves, alongside some exclusive ones. The Automaton can only be damaged by either stunning it via Perfect Blocking or M2’ing. Defeating it will open a door to the next opponent. If you are S- Rank or higher, there will be a checkpoint after defeating it. (If you are a Quincycar, you will skip this phase and immediately move on to phas

title: Wandenreich
content:
Wandenreich This is map is the home of Quincies , also the place where they can obtain Schrift and Volstanding . ( Quincies can teleport here using their ability Schatten .) It is also the place where Arrancars can become Quincycars by talking to Yhwach with positive reputation (100+) and Level 100. The General's Shop A shop found right after entering the walls of Wandenreich and taking a left, also the place where you can start invasions . Following things are sold here: The Bounty Medallion for 150 ¥ . (Used for hunts) The Quincy Hat for 100 ¥. ( Note: You must have a positive reputation to buy the Quincy Hat .) A Cake for 20 ¥ . Cybernetics You need to be a level 60 Quincy or a Quincycar and a cybernetic part to be able to use a Cybernetic . talk to Johan once you meet the requirements. Wandenreich Dojo The Wandenreich Dojo membership costs 250¥ and can train all of your stats up to 30, and can train star bonuses up to 5 stars. Yhwach Yhwach is a NPC that can be found in the wandenreich he serves multiple purposes. Yhwach is used for gaining both Schrift and Vollstanding for Quincies as he gives the quest for both of them. Yhwach is also the npc that turns arrancar into the hybrid race quincycar for more information please visit the Yhwach article. Vollständig A building that features a cannon turret on top of it with two Sternritters guarding it. By entering this place as a level 90+ Quincy with 420 points after talking to Yhwach , you are able to fight the Automation to unlock Vollständig . For more information check the main article. title: Weekly Quest
content:
Added with the Valentine Event update, weekly quest gives the player different reward when you finished the 6 quest Your rewards for beating a Weekly can range from 3000 Yen , 8 PE , A Charged Time Splitter , or a " Quality Reiatsu Crystal " Quests S-RANK INVASION QUESTS Invisible : Complete a S-Rank Invasion while only killing 13 or less guards Five for Five : Achieve a score of 5 or higher on 5 S-Rank . Rampage : Win 6 Time Gate Matches. Untouchable : Win 2 Time Gates without dying. Brutalize% Speedrun : Get a kill within the first 6 minutes, 10 times, within any Time Gates . OVERWORLD QUESTS Banisher : Partake in and defeat 2 Distorded Time Raid . Unbleached : Defeat a Time Raid in under 7 minutes, 3 times. Slayah : Slay 15 Chained Vastocars during the Storm in Hueco Mundo . Upon completing any of the quests, you will get one of the 4 rewards below. Quality Reiatsu Crystal , 8 PE , 3000 Yen, Charged Time splitter Grand Prizes By beating all 6/6 of your allotted weeklys, you can get one of the three below. Time Remnant , Unstable Time Remnant , or 25 PE . NewPP limit report

title: Xcution (Faction)
content:
Xcution is one of Peroxides biggest factions having about 9.3k Roblox players in their group and 6.3k Players in their discord server. Xcution is based off the group of Fullbringers from the anime Bleach meaning that most if not all members are going to be Fullbringers in Peroxide. Floors are groups within Xcution, there are 8 floors: Floor of Natural Sciences Floor Of Art Floor Of Technological Sciences Floor Of Philosophy Floor Of Religion Floor Of History Floor Of Literature Floor Of Natural Sciences There is a PVP based Floor you can join called Floor Of General Works (FOGW for short) that has ranked and skill requirements. Similar to divisions Gotei Xcution has floors for each floor there is usually a Proxy, 2 Sephirah and an Index, if there isn't a Proxy than the Index would lead the floor, if there isn't an index a Sephirah could be promoted to fill the mission position, or another Hr (proxy+) can take over the floor until a new proxy is chosen. Within official factions you can receive in game titles due to rank within the faction. An example of a title granted on rank in Xcution is: This title is one of the Executioners titles, Executioner is one of the many roles you can obtain within the faction. A list of all of the Executioners titles: The Black Silence The Blue Reverberation The Indigo Elder The Purple Tear The Red Gaze The Vermillion Cross The White Noise The Yellow Harpoon While there can be only 8 Proxys at a time they have the option to choose from this list of names: Possible Proxy Names: "Proxy Alpha - A" "Proxy Êta - Η" "Proxy Nu - Ν" "Proxy Tau - Τ" "Proxy Beta - B" "Proxy Thêta - Θ" "Proxy Xi - Ξ" "Proxy Upsilon - Y" "Proxy Gamma - Γ" "Proxy Iota - Ι" "Proxy Omikron - Ο" "Proxy Phi - Φ" "Proxy Delta - Δ" "Proxy Kappa - K" "Proxy Pi - Π" "Proxy Chi - Χ" "Proxy Epsilon - Ε" "Proxy Lambda - Λ" "Proxy Rho - Ρ" "Proxy Psi - Ψ" "Proxy Zêta - Ζ " "Proxy Mu - Μ" "Proxy Sigma - Σ" "Proxy Omega - Ω" There are some special roles that are completely outside of the Proxy/Executioner system, granted to high ranking individuals. There are 7 of these special roles: Echo of the Finality Echo of Origin Echo of Rebirth Head, Eye, Claw Executioner of the Claw Beholder of the Eye Arbiter of the Head There are also some roles below Executioner or Proxy  that Xcution members can obtain, these roles can be granted on their discord by obtaining a certain amount of "points" in completing trainings or origin wars, once you obtain this set amount of points you can try out for the role. A list of these obtainable roles are: Initiate Operator Vanguard Warden Additional information on Xcution can be found on their Discord Server: https://discord.gg/3pwDJHDs NewPP limit report

title: Yamamoto Raid
content:
Yamamoto is one of the five raid bosses in the game. He scales with your level and also scales with the amount of members joining a raid. He has 3 phases. He is guaranteed to drop Time relics and has 2% chance to drop his outfit as well as his beard and his cape. When killed he can also drop Soukotsu a Powerful Skill that can be used by all races in game. He can also drop his cape which is valuable. (This raid boss can only be spawned with a Time Splitter while being in Soul Society bought from Dr. Hydrogen or a charge time splitter from Dr. Hydrogen / Weekly Quests ) Phases Phase 1 : Yamamoto starts the fight using basic moves along with some Legendary Skills . He stays this way until you manage to deal enough damage to anger him. Phase 2 : Yamamoto activates his Shikai “Ryūjin Jakka” and starts being able to use Fire Shikai moves and his knowledge move Soukotsu . While his Shikai is active he also sets up a ring of fire and bursts flaming pillars out of the ground to distract you from your goal. Phase 3 : He activates his Bankai “Zanka no Tachi” where he unlocks the ability to use his ultimate, he passively summons skeletons and lights the player on fire with every hit from his moves, this fight is meant to be hard so good luck. title: Yhwach
content:
Can be found sitting on his throne in the Castle of the Wandenreich . Schrift Talk to him when you reach Lvl.15+ as a Quincy , in order to unlock a Schrift by doing the following things: You have to complete a Hunt by using the Bounty Medallion ,  and then talk to him. That's when you will receive your Schrift . There's a chance he's disappointed in your services and wants you to do it again. In that case, he will say "Pathetic" . The chance of obtaining a Schrift is 1/3 (25 - 30%) every time you don't receive a Schrift the chances of getting one gets higher by 10%. instead of doing Bounty Medallions , you can do any invasions instead and Yhwach will react the same way. Vollständig The next time you should talk with Yhwach is when you reach Lvl.90+ as a Quincy . He will give you instructions on how to prove yourself, You have to go up a large hill in the Wandenreich and enter the House on the top. There, you will be surprised to meet great Danger. Vollständig Boss . If you end up victorious, he will grant you the ultimate power, Vollständig . Quincycar Talking to Yhwach as an Arrancar (Who is also level 100+) will allow you to become a Quincy with an Arrancar clan . ( For this you will need positive Wandenreich reputation. ) NOTE: YOU DO NOT KEEP THE ARRANCAR PASSIVES WHEN YOU BECOME A QUINCYCAR EXCEPT FOR THE RESPECTIVE EXP AND LEVEL BONUSES! Notes If you provoke Yhwach through one of the responses, he will kill you for your impudence. Yhwach has many lines that when you talk to him, can reference memes and jokes placed by the devs. Its a very popular belief by many players that you don't receive arrancarr buffs however you do NewPP limit report
