title: Yoruichi
content:
Description Yoruichi is a NPC located in Urahara's Shop in Karakura Town . She leans on the table in the room where the Soul Gourd is located and teaches the player Hakuda for free, as long as they are a Soul Reaper or an Arrancar . Hakuda Obtainment When the player talks to Yoruichi as a Soul Reaper or Arrancar , she will tell the player that she will be able to teach the player Hakuda . However if they are not either of these races, she will state that only Soul Reapers and Arrancars can learn Hakuda , due to them being stronger. When the player continues to speak to her, she will tell the player that they need to prove themselves against her with a "Lesson of Strength", and when the player confirms the fight, they will be immediently be placed against her, much like a fight with Kisuke , except she uses Hakuda moves instead of Soul Reaper moves. When you defeat her, a text will appear onto your screen, stating this: " You felt a newfound ability awaken within your being, more skills have emerged on the skill shop... " This confirms you have learnt Hakuda . You must level up or use a Skill Shop Reset in order to obtain the moves. After you complete her "Lesson of Strength" you can complete her "Lesson of Agility" and "Lesson of Vitality" for the other 6 moves of Hakuda . To complete these lessons you just need to talk to and fight Yoruichi. You also have a small chance to obtain Yoruichi's Outfit . title: Yuuki Terumi
content: "Feel the Wrath! Witness the dance of death! I am the one true Susanoo! DIE!" Description Yuuki Terumi "GOD" is a Boss NPC located at the Karakura Town Fountain near the Fusionfriends (Trade Hub) NPC and the Ranburā NPC. He will always spawn at XX:35, (5 minutes after the time gate ends), and despawn after 20 minutes (XX:55). Once he spawns, a green-highlighted  message will pop up, saying " The Time Gates manifests a familiar face once again ." He is also located at the top of the tower in Hueco Mundo but this version of Yuuki Terumi can only be fought in the 2nd stage of the Horn of salvation and will say "Got something you need to take care of?" along with a red text reading "You do not qualify for this boss" if you have not started the quest or have not got to this stage of the quest yet. Yuuki Terumi, just like an Arrancar (even though he isn't due to him lacking a mask), can use Segunda Etapa . He'll use it when he's halfway through his health-bar, and will also have passive regen similar that is greater than the player's. He uses the Vessel moveset as well as Hakuda , but as other bosses do, he has a few unique skills ( some are shared with the Ulquiorra Raid Boss ), one of them being a (much) longer-lasting version of the skill called AHAHAHAHAHA, and a move named stinging seal that drains mode and reiatsu as well as allowing him to follow up with Bite. This boss is even harder than Orochi The Shura . He will Block , P-block , and Parry ALMOST every single skill and is immune to pve accessories. Using Starrk's Revolver de Los Lobos , Starrk's Metralleta or Flower Ult will make him run out of your range. He MUST BE KILLED in order to unlock Horn of Salvation (HoS) , since he's the final boss of the Quest-line stage 2. A currently existing cheese allows any domain type move (Oasis' Floodgates of Paradise or Flower Ultimate) to trap him outside, and he can be cheesed with large and ranged AoE (preferably block break) attacks, as he will be too busy trying to break your kneecaps to remember to P-Block, or that he barely has any health left. You could also just run and use  moves that bypass block.(Arrankuda moveset). No time limit, go bonkers. This has been patched, however, currently, Odyssey's extenders as well as other moves may still function. He also blocks uptilt moves less often (Odyssey, Wind, Flame). Currently, it's recommended to turtle his ass (hold block and unblock when he uses crit), usually in conjunction with block bypassing moves. Recommended moves for bypassing include Ferocity, Expression, Showstopper, Unrivaled, and Headstrong. It should be advised that he'll evasive a lot, and has a move that drains mode and reiatsu. He will also run from any block bypassing moves (including the above), so try to m1 bait him (m1s into the move). title: Zanpakutō
content:
A Zanpakutō is the weapon that all Shinigami , Arrancars , and Vizards start out with. In the game, all Zanpakutō take the form of a katana by default. They all are nearly identical, with the only difference being the color of the scabbard and hilt. It functionally acts like a normal katana, but is actually the first weapon a Soul Reaper can get their hands on to hunt and harm Hollows and other spiritual presences. It not only is the staple weapon of both races, but also houses the Soul Reaper's spirit and power in the form of their Shikai and, eventually, their Bankai power. In the case of Arrancars, it's a vessel for said Arrancar's power before they took off their mask, which is unleashed in an alternative, Shikai-like form upon usage of their Ressurectión and, when they've proven themselves, is improved upon obtainment of Segunda Etapa . Unlike Soul Reapers, they don't unlock their Ressurectión Weapon as soon as they get access to their Zanpakutō; They would need to complete the Monolith quest at The Ruins of Los Noches first. Vizards are a mixed case, where they combine the fighting spirit of their Shikai and Bankai with the power they've gotten through using their Mask to greatly improve the potency of their attacks, similarly to a Hollow. In Bleach, the Zanpakutō of Arrancars vary extremely, such as Nnorita Giliga’s Santa Teresa taking the form of a crescent scythe, or Coyote Starrk’s Los Lobos being his subordinate, Lilynette Gingerbuck. According to the official Bleach wiki, Zanpakutōs can break. However, they can easily be repairs through the use of the owner's Reiatsu, the time it would take for the owner to infuse said Reiatsu to their Zanpakutō, and by their sheer will. There are no instances of weapons breaking in the majority of Peroxide's progression as any race, bar the Bankai fight. Zanpakutōs, canonically in Bleach, are made by a blacksmith in Soul Society by the name of Ōetsu Nimaiya . The process of a Zanpakutō's creation, mentioned in the wiki, is through a technique involving the merging of multiple Soul Reaper souls into an "Empty" Zanpakutō known as an 'Asauchi'. Due to Soul Reapers immediately getting their Zanpakutō upon "talking" to Urahara at his shop, instead of interacting with a blacksmith to aquire an Asauchi which they train and improve to become a Zanpakutō, it's strongly implied the blacksmith in question does not exist or that the swords operate and works slightly differently in Peroxide, implying that it might directly be linked with the awakening of a Soul Reaper's yet-to-be-realized potential. content:
